luavifyOriginalText = new WeakMap();\n        const luavifyOriginalAttrs = new WeakMap();\n        const luavifyTranslationCache = new Map();\n        let luavifyTranslationRun = 0;\n        let luavifyTranslationObserver = null;\n        let luavifyTranslationTimer = null;\n        let luavifyTranslationBusy = false;\n        const LUAVIFY_TRANSLATE_SKIP = 'script,style,noscript,code,pre,textarea,[contenteditable=\"true\"],.cw-obf';\n        const LUAVIFY_TRANSLATE_ATTRS = ['placeholder','title','aria-label'];\n        const LUAVIFY_KEEP_WORDS = let node;\n            while ((node = walker.nextNode())) {\n                if (!luavifyOriginalText.has(node)) luavifyOriginalText.set(node, (typeof node._orig === 'string' ? node._orig : node.nodeValue));\n            }\n            if (root.nodeType === 1) {\n                const elements = [root, ...root.querySelectorAll('*')];\n                elements.forEach(el => function translateLuavifyString(value, lang) {\n            const source = (value || '').trim();\n            if (!source || lang === 'en' || LUAVIFY_KEEP_WORDS.test(source) || source.length > 900) return value;\n            const cacheKey = lang + '|' + source;\n            if (luavifyTranslationCache.has(cacheKey)) return luavifyTranslationCache.get(cacheKey);\n            try {\n                const url = 'https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single?client=gtx&sl=auto&tl=' + encodeURIComponent(lang) + '&dt=t&q=' + encodeURIComponent(source);\n                const response = await fetch(url);\n                if (!response.ok) return value;\n                const data = await response.json();\n                const translated = Array.isArray(data[0]) ? data[0].map(part => part[0] || '').join('') : source;\n                const result = translated || source;\n                luavifyTranslationCache.set(cacheKey, result);\n                try { localStorage.setItem('luavify_translation_cache', JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries([...luavifyTranslationCache].slice(-500)))); } catch (_) {}\n                return result;\n            } catch (_) { return value; }\n        }\n\n        async function translatePageNodes(lang, runId) {\n            if (runId !== luavifyTranslationRun) return;\n            if (luavifyTranslationBusy) { setTimeout(() => translatePageNodes(lang, runId), 180); return; }\n            luavifyTranslationBusy = true;\n            try {\n                const nodes = [];\n                const walker = document.createTreeWalker(document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);\n                let node;\n                while ((node = walker.nextNode())) {\n                    const parent = node.parentElement;\n                    if (!parent || parent.closest(LUAVIFY_TRANSLATE_SKIP) || parent.closest('[data-i18n]')) continue;\n                    const original = luavifyOriginalText.get(node) ?? node.nodeValue;\n                    if (!luavifyOriginalText.has(node)) luavifyOriginalText.set(node, original);\n                    const clean = original.trim();\n                    if (!clean || LUAVIFY_KEEP_WORDS.test(clean)) continue;\n                    const knownPack = landingPhrases[lang]?.text || {};\n                    if (parent.closest('#landing-page, #premiumModal, #commercialModal') && knownPack[landingNorm(clean)]) continue;\n                    nodes.push({node, original});\n                }\n                let index = 0;\n                const workers = Array.from({length: 5}, async () => {\n                    while (index < nodes.length && runId === luavifyTranslationRun) {\n                        const item = nodes[index++];\n                        const translated = await translateLuavifyString(item.original, lang);\n                        if (runId !== luavifyTranslationRun || !item.node.isConnected) continue;\n                        const match = item.original.match(/^(\\s*)([\\s\\S]*?)(\\s*)$/);\n                        item.node.nodeValue = match[1] + translated + match[3];\n                    }\n                });\n                await Promise.all(workers);\n                if (runId !== luavifyTranslationRun) return;\n                const elements = Array.from(document.body.querySelectorAll('*'));\n                for (const el of elements) {\n                    if (el.closest(LUAVIFY_TRANSLATE_SKIP) || el.matches('[data-i18n]')) continue;\n                    const saved = luavifyOriginalAttrs.get(el);\n                    if (!saved) continue;\n                    for (const attr of LUAVIFY_TRANSLATE_ATTRS) {\n                        if (!(attr in saved) || !saved[attr]) continue;\n                        el.setAttribute(attr, await translateLuavifyString(saved[attr], lang));\n                    }\n                }\n                if (lang === 'ar') document.documentElement.dir = 'rtl';\n                else document.documentElement.dir = 'ltr';\n            } finally { luavifyTranslationBusy = false; }\n        }\n\n        function queueFullPageTranslation(lang) {\n            const runId = ++luavifyTranslationRun;\n            if (!luavifyTranslationCache.size) {\n                try { Object.entries(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('luavify_translation_cache') || '{}')).forEach(([k,v]) => luavifyTranslationCache.set(k,v)); } catch (_) {}\n            }\n            rememberOriginalText(document.body);\n            clearTimeout(luavifyTranslationTimer);\n            luavifyTranslationTimer = setTimeout(() => translatePageNodes(lang, runId), 80);\n            if (!luavifyTranslationObserver) {\n                luavifyTranslationObserver = new MutationObserver(records => {\n                    if (luavifyTranslationBusy) return;\n                    let changed = false;\n                    records.forEach(record => {\n                        record.addedNodes.forEach(added => {\n                            if (added.nodeType === 3) { if (!luavifyOriginalText.has(added)) luavifyOriginalText.set(added, added.nodeValue); changed = true; }\n                            else if (added.nodeType === 1) { rememberOriginalText(added); changed = true; }\n                        });\n                    });\n                    if (changed) {\n                        const currentLang = localStorage.getItem('luavify_lang') || 'en';\n                        clearTimeout(luavifyTranslationTimer);\n                        const nextRun = ++luavifyTranslationRun;\n                        luavifyTranslationTimer = setTimeout(() => translatePageNodes(currentLang, nextRun), 250);\n                    }\n                });\n                luavifyTranslationObserver.observe(document.body, {childList:true,subtree:true});\n            }\n        }\n\n        async function redeemKey() {\n            const keyEl = document.getElementById('upgrade-redeem-input') || document.getElementById('redeem-key-input');\n            const Math.max(1, ...days.map(d => d.executions));\n            const niceStep = (v) => { const e = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(v))); const f = v / e; return (f <= 1 ? 1 : f <= 2 ? 2 : f <= 5 ? 5 : ${mx},${y(days[i][key])} ${x(i)},${y(days[i][key])}`;\n                }\n                return d;\n            };\n            const fmtDate = (iso) => new Date(iso + "obfuscateWorker.js": "// Web worker \u2014 runs the obfuscation engine off the main thread so the UI stays\n// responsive while processing large files.\nimport { obfuscateLua } from \"/engine/fictionfuscate.js\";\n\nself.onmessage = (e) => {\n  const { source, seed } = e.data || {};\n  try {\n    const result = obfuscateLua(source, {\n      seed,\n      onProgress: (stage) => self.postMessage({ type: \"progress\", stage }),\n    });\n    self.postMessage({ type: \"done\", result });\n  } catch (err) {\n    self.postMessage({ type: \"error\", message: (err && err.message) || \"Obfuscation failed.\" });\n  }\n};"};


export class NonceGuard extends DurableObject {
  async fetch(request) {
    if (request.method !== "POST") return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405 });
    const path = new URL(request.url).pathname;
    let body;
    try { body = await request.json(); } catch (_) { return new Response("Bad request", { status: 400 }); }
    const now = Date.now();

    if (path === "/rate-limit") {
      const bucket = String(body?.bucket || "");
      const max = Number(body?.max);
      const windowSec = Number(body?.windowSec);
      if (!/^[a-z0-9_-]{1,40}$/.test(bucket) || !Number.isInteger(max) || max < 1 || max > 1000 ||
          !Number.isInteger(windowSec) || windowSec < 1 || windowSec > 3600) {
        return new Response("Invalid rate limit request", { status: 400 });
      }
      const windowMs = windowSec * 1000;
      const windowStart = Math.floor(now / windowMs) * windowMs;
      const expiresAt = windowStart + windowMs + 5000;
      const key = `rate:${bucket}:${windowStart}`;
      const allowed = await this.ctx.storage.transaction(async (txn) => {
        const current = await txn.get(key);
        const count = current && Number(current.expiresAt) > now ? Number(current.count) || 0 : 0;
        if (count >= max) return false;
        await txn.put(key, { count: count + 1, expiresAt });
        return true;
      });
      const alarm = await this.ctx.storage.getAlarm();
      if (alarm === null || alarm > expiresAt) await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(expiresAt);
      return allowed ? new Response(null, { status: 204 }) : new Response("rate limit", { status: 429 });
    }

    // Short-lived delivery sessions live in Durable Object storage, not KV.
    // This removes the KV write that was failing in production at session-store.
    // Persistent OAuth account records use the existing Durable Object namespace
    // when the daily KV write quota is exhausted. Records are partitioned by key hash.
    if (path === "/auth-record-get" || path === "/auth-record-put") {
      const recordKey = String(body?.key || "");
      if (!/^(user_[0-9]{15,22}|apikey_lua_[0-9a-f]{32})$/.test(recordKey)) {
        return new Response("Invalid auth record key", { status: 400 });
      }
      const storageKey = `auth:${recordKey}`;
      if (path === "/auth-record-get") {
        const value = await this.ctx.storage.get(storageKey);
        return value === undefined ? new Response("Not found", { status: 404 })
          : new Response(JSON.stringify({ value }), { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
      }
      const value = body?.value;
      if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length > 65536) return new Response("Invalid auth record value", { status: 400 });
      await this.ctx.storage.put(storageKey, value);
      return new Response(null, { status: 204 });
    }

    if (path === "/session-store") {
      const sessionId = String(body?.sessionId || "");
      const record = body?.record;
      if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(sessionId) ||
          !record || typeof record !== "object" || Array.isArray(record) ||
          record.sessionId !== sessionId || !Number.isInteger(record.expiresAt) ||
          !/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/i.test(String(record.hash || ""))) {
        return new Response("Invalid session record", { status: 400 });
      }
      const key = `session:${sessionId}`;
      const purgeAt = now + 180000;
      const created = await this.ctx.storage.transaction(async (txn) => {
        const existing = await txn.get(key);
        if (existing && Number(existing.purgeAt) > now) return false;
        await txn.put(key, { ...record, purgeAt });
        return true;
      });
      if (!created) return new Response("Session already exists", { status: 409 });
      const alarm = await this.ctx.storage.getAlarm();
      if (alarm === null || alarm > purgeAt) await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(purgeAt);
      return new Response(null, { status: 201 });
    }

    if (path === "/hwid-bind") {
      const bindingKey = String(body?.bindingKey || "");
      const hwidHash = String(body?.hwidHash || "");
      if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(bindingKey) || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(hwidHash)) {
        return new Response("Invalid installation binding", { status: 400 });
      }
      const storageKey = `hwid:${bindingKey}`;
      const result = await this.ctx.storage.transaction(async (txn) => {
        const existing = await txn.get(storageKey);
        if (!existing) {
          await txn.put(storageKey, { hwidHash, createdAt: now });
          return "created";
        }
        return existing.hwidHash === hwidHash ? "matched" : "mismatch";
      });
      if (result === "mismatch") return new Response("Installation binding mismatch", { status: 409 });
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ bound: true, firstUse: result === "created" }), {
        status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": "no-store" }
      });
    }

    if (path === "/hwid-reset") {
      const bindingKey = String(body?.bindingKey || "");
      if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(bindingKey)) return new Response("Invalid installation binding", { status: 400 });
      await this.ctx.storage.delete(`hwid:${bindingKey}`);
      return new Response(null, { status: 204 });
    }

    if (path === "/place-ticket-store") {
      const ticketHash = String(body?.ticketHash || "");
      const hash = String(body?.hash || "");
      const placeId = String(body?.placeId || "");
      const userId = String(body?.userId || "");
      const expiresAt = Number(body?.expiresAt);
      if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(ticketHash) || !/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/i.test(hash) ||
          !/^\d{1,20}$/.test(placeId) || !/^\d{1,22}$/.test(userId) ||
          !Number.isInteger(expiresAt) || expiresAt <= Math.floor(now / 1000) || expiresAt > Math.floor(now / 1000) + 60) {
        return new Response("Invalid place ticket", { status: 400 });
      }
      const storageKey = `place-ticket:${ticketHash}`;
      const created = await this.ctx.storage.transaction(async (txn) => {
        if (await txn.get(storageKey)) return false;
        await txn.put(storageKey, { hash, placeId, userId, expiresAt });
        return true;
      });
      if (!created) return new Response("Ticket already exists", { status: 409 });
      const alarm = await this.ctx.storage.getAlarm();
      const expiryMs = expiresAt * 1000;
      if (alarm === null || alarm > expiryMs) await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(expiryMs);
      return new Response(null, { status: 201 });
    }

    if (path === "/place-ticket-consume") {
      const ticketHash = String(body?.ticketHash || "");
      const hash = String(body?.hash || "");
      const placeId = String(body?.placeId || "");
      const userId = String(body?.userId || "");
      if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(ticketHash) || !/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/i.test(hash) ||
          !/^\d{1,20}$/.test(placeId) || !/^\d{1,22}$/.test(userId)) {
        return new Response("Invalid place ticket", { status: 400 });
      }
      const storageKey = `place-ticket:${ticketHash}`;
      const consumed = await this.ctx.storage.transaction(async (txn) => {
        const value = await txn.get(storageKey);
        if (!value) return false;
        await txn.delete(storageKey);
        return value.hash === hash && value.placeId === placeId && value.userId === userId && value.expiresAt > Math.floor(now / 1000);
      });
      return consumed ? new Response(null, { status: 204 }) : new Response("Ticket invalid", { status: 404 });
    }

    if (path === "/session-revoke") {
      const sessionId = String(body?.sessionId || "");
      if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(sessionId)) {
        return new Response("Invalid session ID", { status: 400 });
      }
      const storageKey = `session:${sessionId}`;
      const record = await this.ctx.storage.get(storageKey);
      if (!record) return new Response(null, { status: 204 });
      record.revokedAt = Math.floor(now / 1000);
      await this.ctx.storage.put(storageKey, record);
      if (record.deliveryId) await this.ctx.storage.delete(`blob:${record.deliveryId}`);
      return new Response(null, { status: 204 });
    }

    if (path === "/session-read") {
      const sessionId = String(body?.sessionId || "");
      if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(sessionId)) {
        return new Response("Invalid session ID", { status: 400 });
      }
      const key = `session:${sessionId}`;
      const record = await this.ctx.storage.get(key);
      if (!record || record.revokedAt || Number(record.expiresAt) <= Math.floor(now / 1000) || Number(record.purgeAt) <= now) {
        if (record) await this.ctx.storage.delete(key);
        return new Response("Session not found or expired", { status: 404 });
      }
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ session: record }), {
        status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": "no-store" }
      });
    }

    // Short-lived encrypted delivery blobs are stored beside their session in
    // Durable Object storage, avoiding the KV value/quota/availability failure.
    if (path === "/blob-store") {
      const sessionId = String(body?.sessionId || "");
      const deliveryId = String(body?.deliveryId || "");
      const hash = String(body?.hash || "");
      const blob = body?.blob;
      if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(sessionId) ||
          !/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/i.test(deliveryId) || !/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/i.test(hash) ||
          typeof blob !== "string" || !blob || blob.length > 8 * 1024 * 1024) {
        return new Response("Invalid delivery blob", { status: 400 });
      }
      const session = await this.ctx.storage.get(`session:${sessionId}`);
      if (!session || session.hash !== hash || Number(session.expiresAt) <= Math.floor(now / 1000) || Number(session.purgeAt) <= now) {
        return new Response("Session not found or expired", { status: 403 });
      }
      const key = `blob:${deliveryId}`;
      const expiresAt = Math.min(Number(session.expiresAt) * 1000 + 120000, now + 120000);
      const created = await this.ctx.storage.transaction(async (txn) => {
        if (await txn.get(key)) return false;
        await txn.put(key, { sessionId, hash, blob, expiresAt });
        return true;
      });
      if (!created) return new Response("Delivery already stored", { status: 409 });
      const alarm = await this.ctx.storage.getAlarm();
      if (alarm === null || alarm > expiresAt) await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(expiresAt);
      return new Response(null, { status: 201 });
    }

    if (path === "/blob-read") {
      const sessionId = String(body?.sessionId || "");
      const deliveryId = String(body?.deliveryId || "");
      const hash = String(body?.hash || "");
      if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(sessionId) ||
          !/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/i.test(deliveryId) || !/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/i.test(hash)) {
        return new Response("Invalid delivery blob request", { status: 400 });
      }
      const key = `blob:${deliveryId}`;
      // Consume atomically: a delivery blob can be read once, even under concurrent requests.
      const stored = await this.ctx.storage.transaction(async (txn) => {
        const value = await txn.get(key);
        if (!value || value.sessionId !== sessionId || value.hash !== hash || Number(value.expiresAt) <= now) {
          if (value && Number(value.expiresAt) <= now) await txn.delete(key);
          return null;
        }
        await txn.delete(key);
        return value;
      });
      if (!stored) return new Response("Blob expired, missing, or already consumed", { status: 404 });
      return new Response(stored.blob, { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
    }

    if (path !== "/claim") return new Response("Not found", { status: 404 });
    const nonce = String(body?.nonce || "");
    if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(nonce)) {
      return new Response("Invalid nonce", { status: 400 });
    }
    const key = `nonce:${nonce}`;
    const nonceExpiry = now + 90000;
    const claimed = await this.ctx.storage.transaction(async (txn) => {
      const expiresAt = await txn.get(key);
      if (Number(expiresAt) > now) return false;
      await txn.put(key, nonceExpiry);
      return true;
    });
    const alarm = await this.ctx.storage.getAlarm();
    if (alarm === null || alarm > nonceExpiry) await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(nonceExpiry);
    return claimed ? new Response(null, { status: 204 }) : new Response("replay", { status: 409 });
  }

  async alarm() {
    const now = Date.now();
    let next = null;
    for (const prefix of ["nonce:", "rate:", "session:", "blob:", "place-ticket:"]) {
      const entries = await this.ctx.storage.list({ prefix });
      for (const [key, value] of entries) {
        const expiresAt = prefix === "nonce:" ? Number(value)
          : prefix === "rate:" ? Number(value && value.expiresAt)
          : prefix === "blob:" || prefix === "place-ticket:" ? Number(value && (value.expiresAt ? value.expiresAt * (prefix === "place-ticket:" ? 1000 : 1) : 0))
          : Number(value && value.purgeAt);
        if (!Number.isFinite(expiresAt) || expiresAt <= now) await this.ctx.storage.delete(key);
        else if (next === null || expiresAt < next) next = expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (next !== null) await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(next);
  }
}

// Minimal Turso (libSQL) client over HTTP ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â no npm package needed.
function makeTurso(env) {
  let base = String(env.TURSO_URL || env.TURSO_DATABASE_URL || "").trim().replace(/\/$/, "");
  const token = String(env.TURSO_TOKEN || env.TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN || "").trim();
  if (!base || !token) return null;
  base = base.replace(/^libsql:\/\//, "https://");
  if (!/^https?:\/\//.test(base)) base = "https://" + base;

  const enc = (v) => v === null || v === undefined ? { type: "null" }
    : typeof v === "number" ? { type: "integer", value: String(Math.trunc(v)) }
    : { type: "text", value: String(v) };
  const dec = (c) => !c || c.type === "null" ? null : c.type === "integer" ? Number(c.value) : c.value;

  async function run(stmts) {
    const reqs = stmts.map((s) => ({ type: "execute", stmt: { sql: s[0], args: (s[1] || []).map(enc) } }));
    reqs.push({ type: "close" });
    const res = await fetch(base + "/v2/pipeline", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + token, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ requests: reqs }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Turso HTTP " + res.status);
    const data = await res.json();
    return (data.results || []).slice(0, stmts.length).map((r) => {
      if (r.type !== "ok") throw new Error((r.error && r.error.message) || "Turso error");
      const out = r.response && r.response.result;
      const cols = ((out && out.cols) || []).map((c) => c.name);
      return ((out && out.rows) || []).map((row) => {
        const o = {};
        row.forEach((c, i) => { o[cols[i]] = dec(c); });
        return o;
      });
    });
  }

  const init = () => {
    if (!__tursoReady) {
      __tursoReady = run([
        ["CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS store (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL, metadata TEXT, expires_at INTEGER)"],
        ["CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_store_exp ON store(expires_at)"],
      ]).catch((e) => { __tursoReady = null; throw e; });
    }
    return __tursoReady;
  };

  return {
    async query(sql, args) { await init(); return (await run([[sql, args]]))[0]; },
    async exec(sql, args) { await init(); await run([[sql, args]]); },
  };
}


// Supabase Storage client (file bucket, plain HTTP). Used only for large values.
//   SUPABASE_URL (Variable), SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY (Secret), SUPABASE_BUCKET (optional, default luavify-files)
function makeSupabase(env) {
  const base = String(env.SUPABASE_URL || "").trim().replace(/\/$/, "");
  const key = String(env.SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY || env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || "").trim();
  if (!base || !key) return null;
  const bucket = String(env.SUPABASE_BUCKET || "luavify-files").trim();
  // New sb_secret_ keys go in `apikey` only; legacy JWT service_role keys also work as Bearer.
  const headers = (extra) => Object.assign({ apikey: key }, key.startsWith("sb_") ? {} : { Authorization: "Bearer " + key }, extra || {});
  const path = (k) => {
    const b = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(k))).replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_").replace(/=+$/, "");
    return `${base}/storage/v1/object/${bucket}/s/${b}`;
  };
  return {
    async put(k, v) {
      const r = await fetch(path(k), { method: "POST", headers: headers({ "Content-Type": "text/plain", "x-upsert": "true" }), body: v });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error("Supabase put " + r.status);
    },
    async get(k) {
      const r = await fetch(path(k), { headers: headers() });
      if (r.status === 404 || r.status === 400) return null;
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error("Supabase get " + r.status);
      return r.text();
    },
    async delete(k) { try { await fetch(path(k), { method: "DELETE", headers: headers() }); } catch (_) {} },
  };
}
const SB_POINTER = "\u0000SB1"; // tiny marker stored in D1/Turso/KV that says "the real value is in Supabase"

function makeStore(env) {
  const kv = env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS, db = env.DB;
  if (!db) return kv;                                   // no D1 bound ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ã‚Â¢ plain KV
  const tu = makeTurso(env);                            // null if Turso not configured
  const sb = makeSupabase(env);                         // null if Supabase not configured
  const MAX_SB_VALUE = 40000000;                        // bucket limit is 50 MB
  const MAX_D1_VALUE = 1500000;                         // D1 rows max ~2 MB
  const MAX_TURSO_VALUE = 4000000;
  const init = () => {
    if (!__storeReady) {
      __storeReady = db.batch([
        db.prepare("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS store (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL, metadata TEXT, expires_at INTEGER)"),
        db.prepare("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_store_exp ON store(expires_at)"),
      ]).catch((e) => { __storeReady = null; throw e; });
    }
    return __storeReady;
  };
  const ttlToExpiry = (o) => o && o.expirationTtl ? Date.now() + Number(o.expirationTtl) * 1000
    : o && o.expiration ? Number(o.expiration) * 1000 : null;
  const UPSERT = "INSERT INTO store (key,value,metadata,expires_at) VALUES (?1,?2,?3,?4) " +
    "ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value, metadata=excluded.metadata, expires_at=excluded.expires_at";

  // D1 ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ã‚Â¢ Turso ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ã‚Â¢ KV, no Supabase pointer resolution
  async function rawGet(key) {
    let v = null;
    try {
      await init();
      const row = await db.prepare("SELECT value FROM store WHERE key=?1 AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>?2)")
        .bind(key, Date.now()).first();
      if (row) v = row.value;
    } catch (_) { /* D1 unavailable ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ã‚Â¢ fall through */ }
    if (v === null && tu) {
      try {
        const rows = await tu.query("SELECT value FROM store WHERE key=?1 AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>?2)", [key, Date.now()]);
        if (rows.length) v = rows[0].value;
      } catch (_) { /* Turso unavailable ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ã‚Â¢ fall through to KV */ }
    }
    if (v === null) v = await kv.get(key);
    return v;
  }
  // store the tiny Supabase pointer in the first tier that accepts it (throws if none do)
  async function putPointer(key) {
    try { await init(); await db.prepare(UPSERT).bind(key, SB_POINTER, null, null).run(); return; } catch (_) {}
    if (tu) { try { await tu.exec(UPSERT, [key, SB_POINTER, null, null]); return; } catch (_) {} }
    await kv.put(key, SB_POINTER);
  }

  return {
    // Existence check without loading a potentially multi-megabyte payload.
    async has(key) {
      try {
        await init();
        const row = await db.prepare(
          "SELECT 1 AS present FROM store WHERE key=?1 AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>?2)"
        ).bind(key, Date.now()).first();
        if (row) return true;
      } catch (_) {}
      if (tu) {
        try {
          const rows = await tu.query(
            "SELECT 1 AS present FROM store WHERE key=?1 AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>?2)",
            [key, Date.now()]
          );
          if (rows.length) return true;
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      try {
        const stream = await kv.get(key, { type: "stream" });
        if (stream === null) return false;
        if (stream && typeof stream.cancel === "function") {
          try { await stream.cancel(); } catch (_) {}
        }
        return true;
      } catch (_) {
        return false;
      }
    },

    async get(key, opts) {
      let v = await rawGet(key);
      if (v === SB_POINTER) {
        v = null;
        if (sb) { try { v = await sb.get(key); } catch (_) { v = null; } }
      }
      const type = typeof opts === "string" ? opts : opts && opts.type;
      if (v !== null && type === "json") { try { return JSON.parse(v); } catch (_) { return null; } }
      return v;
    },

    async put(key, value, opts) {
      const str = typeof value === "string" ? value : String(value);
      const meta = opts && opts.metadata ? JSON.stringify(opts.metadata) : null;
      const exp = ttlToExpiry(opts);
      if (str.length <= MAX_D1_VALUE) {
        try {
          await init();
          await db.prepare(UPSERT).bind(key, str, meta, exp).run();
          if (Math.random() < 0.01) { try { await db.prepare("DELETE FROM store WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at<?1").bind(Date.now()).run(); } catch (_) {} }
          return;
        } catch (_) { /* D1 failed (quota/etc) ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ã‚Â¢ try Turso */ }
      }
      if (tu && str.length <= MAX_TURSO_VALUE) {
        try {
          await tu.exec(UPSERT, [key, str, meta, exp]);
          if (Math.random() < 0.01) { try { await tu.exec("DELETE FROM store WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at<?1", [Date.now()]); } catch (_) {} }
          return;
        } catch (_) { /* Turso failed ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ã‚Â¢ overflow to KV below */ }
      }
      if (sb && !exp && str.length <= MAX_SB_VALUE) {
        try { await sb.put(key, str); await putPointer(key); return; } catch (_) { /* ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ã‚Â¢ KV below */ }
      }
      return kv.put(key, str, opts);
    },

    async delete(key) {
      if (sb) { try { if ((await rawGet(key)) === SB_POINTER) await sb.delete(key); } catch (_) {} }
      try { await init(); await db.prepare("DELETE FROM store WHERE key=?1").bind(key).run(); } catch (_) {}
      if (tu) { try { await tu.exec("DELETE FROM store WHERE key=?1", [key]); } catch (_) {} }
      try { if ((await kv.get(key)) !== null) await kv.delete(key); } catch (_) {}
    },

    // Cursor formats: "d:<lastKey>" (D1) ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ã‚Â¢ "t:<lastKey>" (Turso) ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ã‚Â¢ "k:<kvCursor>" (KV)
    async list(opts = {}) {
      const prefix = opts.prefix || "";
      const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number(opts.limit) || 1000, 1000));
      const cur = opts.cursor || "";
      let phase = "d", after = "", kvCursor;
      if (cur.startsWith("k:")) { phase = "k"; kvCursor = cur.slice(2) || undefined; }
      else if (cur.startsWith("t:")) { phase = "t"; after = cur.slice(2); }
      else if (cur.startsWith("d:")) after = cur.slice(2);
      const keys = [];
      const seen = new Set();
      const toKey = (r) => {
        const k = { name: r.key };
        if (r.expires_at) k.expiration = Math.floor(r.expires_at / 1000);
        if (r.metadata) { try { k.metadata = JSON.parse(r.metadata); } catch (_) {} }
        return k;
      };
      const SQL = "SELECT key, metadata, expires_at FROM store WHERE key>?1 AND key>=?2 AND key<?3 AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>?4) ORDER BY key LIMIT ?5";

      if (phase === "d") {
        let rows = [];
        try {
          await init();
          rows = (await db.prepare(SQL).bind(after, prefix, prefix + "\uffff", Date.now(), limit + 1).all()).results || [];
        } catch (_) { rows = []; }
        const more = rows.length > limit;
        for (const r of rows.slice(0, limit)) { keys.push(toKey(r)); seen.add(r.key); }
        if (more) return { keys, list_complete: false, cursor: "d:" + keys[keys.length - 1].name };
        phase = "t"; after = "";
      }

      if (phase === "t" && tu) {
        const room = limit - keys.length;
        if (room > 0) {
          let rows = [];
          try { rows = await tu.query(SQL, [after, prefix, prefix + "\uffff", Date.now(), room + 1]); } catch (_) { rows = []; }
          const more = rows.length > room;
          const page = rows.slice(0, room);
          // skip keys already returned from D1
          const names = page.map((r) => r.key);
          for (let i = 0; i < names.length; i += 90) {
            const chunk = names.slice(i, i + 90);
            try {
              const r = await db.prepare(`SELECT key FROM store WHERE key IN (${chunk.map((_, j) => "?" + (j + 1)).join(",")})`).bind(...chunk).all();
              for (const x of r.results || []) seen.add(x.key);
            } catch (_) {}
          }
          for (const r of page) if (!seen.has(r.key)) { keys.push(toKey(r)); seen.add(r.key); }
          if (more) return { keys, list_complete: false, cursor: "t:" + page[page.length - 1].key };
        }
      }

      // D1 + Turso exhausted ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ã‚Â¢ continue with legacy / overflow keys in KV
      const remaining = limit - keys.length;
      if (remaining > 0) {
        let page = { keys: [], list_complete: true };
        try { page = await kv.list({ prefix, cursor: kvCursor, limit: remaining }); } catch (_) {}
        const names = page.keys.map((k) => k.name);
        for (let i = 0; i < names.length; i += 90) {
          const chunk = names.slice(i, i + 90);
          try {
            const r = await db.prepare(`SELECT key FROM store WHERE key IN (${chunk.map((_, j) => "?" + (j + 1)).join(",")})`).bind(...chunk).all();
            for (const x of r.results || []) seen.add(x.key);
          } catch (_) {}
          if (tu) {
            try {
              const r = await tu.query(`SELECT key FROM store WHERE key IN (${chunk.map((_, j) => "?" + (j + 1)).join(",")})`, chunk);
              for (const x of r) seen.add(x.key);
            } catch (_) {}
          }
        }
        for (const k of page.keys) if (!seen.has(k.name)) keys.push(k);
        if (!page.list_complete) return { keys, list_complete: false, cursor: "k:" + (page.cursor || "") };
      }
      return { keys, list_complete: true };
    },
  };
}

export default {
  async fetch(request, env, ctx) {
    // Route every KV call through the D1 + Turso + KV multi-store.
    env = { ...env, LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS: makeStore(env) };
    const corsHeaders = {
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, X-Luavify-Key",
    };

    if (request.method === "OPTIONS") return new Response(null, { headers: corsHeaders });

    const url = new URL(request.url);

      // FictionFuscate engine (browser ES modules)
      if (url.pathname.startsWith("/engine/")) {
        const name = url.pathname.slice("/engine/".length).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "");
        const body = ENGINE_ASSETS[name];
        if (!body) return new Response("Not found", { status: 404 });
        return new Response(body, {
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8",
            "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=3600",
            "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
          },
        });

Allow: /

`, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=3600" } });

</urlset>

    const cookieHeader = request.headers.get("Cookie") || "";

      const match = cookieHeader.match(new RegExp("(^| )" + name + "=([^;]+)"));
      return match ? match[2] : null;
    };

    // View Channels + Send Messages + Embed Links + Read Message History + Manage Roles (buyer role on redeem)

    const randHex = (n) => Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(n))).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
    const makeSessionId = () => {
      // Use the platform UUID API when available, with a cryptographic RFC 4122 v4 fallback.
      if (typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function") return crypto.randomUUID();
      const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
      bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
      bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;

      return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;

    let userId = null;
    {
      const raw = getCookie("session");
      const dot = raw ? raw.indexOf(".") : -1;
      if (dot > 0) {
        const cid = raw.slice(0, dot), ctok = raw.slice(dot + 1);
        if (/^\d+$/.test(cid) && ctok) {
          const s = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`user_${cid}`);
          if (s) {
            try { const cu = JSON.parse(s); if (cu.sessionToken && cu.sessionToken === ctok) userId = String(cid); } catch (e) {}
          }

    const SIGNING_SECRET = env.SIGNING_SECRET || env.AUTH_SECRET || null;

    // is the default for newly protected scripts to reduce VM overhead.

    const VOLTFUSCATOR_ALLOWED_RUNTIMES = new Set(["executor", "luau"]);
    if (!VOLTFUSCATOR_ALLOWED_RUNTIMES.has(VOLTFUSCATOR_RUNTIME)) {
      throw new Error("VOLTFUSCATOR_RUNTIME must be either 'executor' or 'luau'.");
    }
    const VOLTFUSCATOR_PRESET = String(env.VOLTFUSCATOR_PRESET || "normal").trim().toLowerCase();
    const VOLTFUSCATOR_ALLOWED_PRESETS = new Set(["normal", "max"]);
    if (!VOLTFUSCATOR_ALLOWED_PRESETS.has(VOLTFUSCATOR_PRESET)) {
      throw new Error("VOLTFUSCATOR_PRESET must be either 'normal' or 'max'.");
    }

    const PIPELINE_VERSION = "2.1.0";

    // Set VOLTFUSCATOR_PLAN in wrangler.toml / the dashboard to whichever
    // plan this key actually holds (basic | pro | elite). This does NOT
    // auto-detect the plan from voltils.cc ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â a mismatch here only makes our
    // own local guard too strict or too loose, it never changes what
    // voltils.cc itself enforces.
    const VOLTFUSCATOR_PLAN_LIMITS = {
      basic: { rolling12h: 3, daily: 6, maxSourceBytes: 1024 * 1024 },
      pro: { rolling12h: 12, daily: 24, maxSourceBytes: 1024 * 1024 },
      elite: { rolling12h: 120, daily: 240, maxSourceBytes: 1024 * 1024 },
    };
    const VOLTFUSCATOR_PLAN = VOLTFUSCATOR_PLAN_LIMITS[(env.VOLTFUSCATOR_PLAN || "basic").toLowerCase()]
      || VOLTFUSCATOR_PLAN_LIMITS.basic;

    // Luavify app-side Voltfuscator source cap: 1 MB for every plan.
    // The upstream Voltfuscator service may enforce a separate provider-side cap.

    // Render the protection notice as a leading Lua block comment in generated
    // Shield bootstrap output. It is comment text only and does not change execution.
    const LUAVIFY_PROTECTION_NOTICE_LUA_COMMENT =
      "--[[\n" + LUAVIFY_PROTECTION_NOTICE.replace(/\]\]/g, "] ]") + "\n]]\n";

    function makeVoltfuscatorNoticeInput(source) {
      // The long-string delimiter is escaped defensively so arbitrary notice text
      // cannot terminate the Lua string and alter the user's script.
      const embeddedNotice = LUAVIFY_PROTECTION_NOTICE.replace(/]=]/g, "] =]");
      return [
        "do",
        "  local __luavify_protection_notice = [=[" + embeddedNotice + "]=]",
        "  pcall(function() return #__luavify_protection_notice end)",
        "end",
        "",
        source,
      ].join("\n");
    }

    function addVoltfuscatorNoticeHeader(output) {
      const safeNotice = LUAVIFY_PROTECTION_NOTICE.replace(/\]\]/g, "] ]");
      const header = "--[[\n" + safeNotice + "\n]]\n";
      const body = String(output || "").replace(/^\uFEFF/, "").trimStart();
      return body.startsWith(header.trimEnd()) ? body : header + body;
    }

    // 196 reversible byte transforms plus eleven distinct stacked text encoders for per-response Shield source packing.
    // These transformations are obfuscation, not encryption or anti-dump guarantees.
    function wrapShieldBootstrap(source) {
      const notice = LUAVIFY_PROTECTION_NOTICE_LUA_COMMENT;
      const fullSource = String(source || "");
      const body = fullSource.startsWith(notice) ? fullSource.slice(notice.length) : fullSource;

      const keyA = new Uint8Array(16);
      const keyB = new Uint8Array(16);
      crypto.getRandomValues(keyA);
      crypto.getRandomValues(keyB);

      let data = new Uint8Array(new TextEncoder().encode(body));
      const reverseBytes = bytes => Uint8Array.from(Array.from(bytes).reverse());
      const rotateLeft = (value, amount) => ((value << amount) | (value >>> (8 - amount))) & 255;
      const swapNibbles = value => ((value & 15) << 4) | (value >>> 4);

      // Existing transforms 01-14.
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] ^= keyA[i % keyA.length];
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = (data[i] + keyB[i % keyB.length]) & 255;
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = rotateLeft(data[i], 3);
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = swapNibbles(data[i]);
      data = reverseBytes(data);
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] ^= 0xA7;
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = (data[i] + 61) & 255;
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = rotateLeft(data[i], 1);
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] ^= keyB[i % keyB.length];
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = (data[i] + ((i * 17 + 43) & 255)) & 255;
      data = reverseBytes(data);
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = swapNibbles(data[i]);
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = rotateLeft(data[i], 3);
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] ^= 0x5C;

      // Additional transforms 15-32, each with a matching inverse below.
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] ^= keyA[(i * 7 + 3) % keyA.length];
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = (data[i] + ((i * 7 + 19) & 255)) & 255;
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = rotateLeft(data[i], 2);
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = swapNibbles(data[i]);
      data = reverseBytes(data);
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] ^= 0xD3;
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = (data[i] + 29) & 255;
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = rotateLeft(data[i], 5);
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] ^= keyB[(i * 5 + 1) % keyB.length];
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = (data[i] + ((i * 11 + 7) & 255)) & 255;
      data = reverseBytes(data);
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = swapNibbles(data[i]);
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = rotateLeft(data[i], 1);
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] ^= 0x6B;
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = (data[i] - 37 + 256) & 255;
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] ^= ((i * 13 + 0x39) & 255);
      data = reverseBytes(data);
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = (data[i] + keyA[(i * 3 + 2) % keyA.length]) & 255;

      // Additional 100 reversible transforms (33-132). Keep operations
      // byte-local so the matching Lua inverses remain simple and portable.
      const extraOps = [];
      for (let n = 0; n < 100; n++) {
        const seed = (n * 73 + 41) & 255;
        const kind = n % 5;
        if (kind === 0) extraOps.push({ type: "xor", value: seed });
        else if (kind === 1) extraOps.push({ type: "add", value: (seed % 251) + 1 });
        else if (kind === 2) extraOps.push({ type: "rol", value: (seed % 7) + 1 });
        else if (kind === 3) extraOps.push({ type: "swap" });
        else extraOps.push({ type: "reverse" });
      }
      for (const op of extraOps) {
        if (op.type === "xor") {
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] ^= op.value;
        } else if (op.type === "add") {
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = (data[i] + op.value) & 255;
        } else if (op.type === "rol") {
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = rotateLeft(data[i], op.value);
        } else if (op.type === "swap") {
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = swapNibbles(data[i]);
        } else {
          data = reverseBytes(data);
        }
      }
      const luaExtraDecode = extraOps.slice().reverse().map(op => {
        if (op.type === "xor") return `__d = __map(__d, function(v) return __xor(v, ${op.value}) end)`;
        if (op.type === "add") return `__d = __map(__d, function(v) return (v - ${op.value}) % 256 end)`;
        if (op.type === "rol") return `__d = __map(__d, function(v) return __ror(v, ${op.value}) end)`;
        if (op.type === "swap") return `__d = __map(__d, function(v) return (v % 16) * 16 + math.floor(v / 16) end)`;
        return `__d = __d:reverse()`;
      }).join("\n");

      // 64 additional polymorphic layers (133-196). Unlike the fixed base
      // transforms, each response gets a fresh operation order and parameters.
      // The operation set includes position masks, keyed masks, affine byte
      // maps, position-dependent rotations, and pair swaps.
      const randomByte = () => crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(1))[0];
      const inverseOddMod256 = (a) => {
        for (let x = 1; x < 256; x += 2) if (((a * x) & 255) === 1) return x;
        throw new Error("No inverse for odd byte multiplier");
      };
      const polymorphicOps = [];
      for (let n = 0; n < 64; n++) {
        const kind = randomByte() % 12;
        if (kind === 0) polymorphicOps.push({ type: "xor", value: randomByte() });
        else if (kind === 1) polymorphicOps.push({ type: "add", value: (randomByte() % 255) + 1 });
        else if (kind === 2) polymorphicOps.push({ type: "rol", value: (randomByte() % 7) + 1 });
        else if (kind === 3) polymorphicOps.push({ type: "swap" });
        else if (kind === 4) polymorphicOps.push({ type: "reverse" });
        else if (kind === 5) polymorphicOps.push({ type: "posxor", mult: randomByte(), add: randomByte() });
        else if (kind === 6) polymorphicOps.push({ type: "posadd", mult: randomByte(), add: randomByte() });
        else if (kind === 7) polymorphicOps.push({ type: "keyxor", mult: (randomByte() % 15) + 1, add: randomByte() % 16 });
        else if (kind === 8) {
          const a = (randomByte() | 1) & 255;
          polymorphicOps.push({ type: "affine", a, b: randomByte(), inv: inverseOddMod256(a) });
        } else if (kind === 9) polymorphicOps.push({ type: "pairswap" });
        else if (kind === 10) polymorphicOps.push({ type: "posrol", mult: randomByte() % 8, add: randomByte() % 8 });
        else {
          const a = (randomByte() | 1) & 255;
          polymorphicOps.push({ type: "posaffine", a, b: randomByte(), mult: randomByte(), inv: inverseOddMod256(a) });
        }
      }
      for (const op of polymorphicOps) {
        if (op.type === "xor") {
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] ^= op.value;
        } else if (op.type === "add") {
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = (data[i] + op.value) & 255;
        } else if (op.type === "rol") {
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = rotateLeft(data[i], op.value);
        } else if (op.type === "swap") {
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = swapNibbles(data[i]);
        } else if (op.type === "reverse") {
          data = reverseBytes(data);
        } else if (op.type === "posxor") {
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] ^= ((i * op.mult + op.add) & 255);
        } else if (op.type === "posadd") {
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = (data[i] + ((i * op.mult + op.add) & 255)) & 255;
        } else if (op.type === "keyxor") {
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] ^= keyA[(i * op.mult + op.add) % keyA.length];
        } else if (op.type === "affine") {
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = (data[i] * op.a + op.b) & 255;
        } else if (op.type === "pairswap") {
          for (let i = 0; i + 1 < data.length; i += 2) { const t = data[i]; data[i] = data[i + 1]; data[i + 1] = t; }
        } else if (op.type === "posrol") {
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = rotateLeft(data[i], ((i * op.mult + op.add) % 7) + 1);
        } else if (op.type === "posaffine") {
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = (data[i] * op.a + op.b + ((i * op.mult) & 255)) & 255;
        }
      }
      const luaPolymorphicDecode = polymorphicOps.slice().reverse().map(op => {
        if (op.type === "xor") return `__d = __map(__d, function(v) return __xor(v, ${op.value}) end)`;
        if (op.type === "add") return `__d = __map(__d, function(v) return (v - ${op.value}) % 256 end)`;
        if (op.type === "rol") return `__d = __map(__d, function(v) return __ror(v, ${op.value}) end)`;
        if (op.type === "swap") return `__d = __map(__d, function(v) return (v % 16) * 16 + math.floor(v / 16) end)`;
        if (op.type === "reverse") return `__d = __d:reverse()`;
        if (op.type === "posxor") return `__d = __map(__d, function(v, i) return __xor(v, (((i - 1) * ${op.mult} + ${op.add}) % 256)) end)`;
        if (op.type === "posadd") return `__d = __map(__d, function(v, i) return (v - (((i - 1) * ${op.mult} + ${op.add}) % 256)) % 256 end)`;
        if (op.type === "keyxor") return `__d = __map(__d, function(v, i) return __xor(v, __a[(((i - 1) * ${op.mult} + ${op.add}) % #__a) + 1]) end)`;
        if (op.type === "affine") return `__d = __map(__d, function(v) return ((v - ${op.b}) * ${op.inv}) % 256 end)`;
        if (op.type === "pairswap") return `do local __t = {}; for __i = 1, #__d, 2 do if __i < #__d then __t[#__t + 1] = __d:sub(__i + 1, __i + 1); __t[#__t + 1] = __d:sub(__i, __i) else __t[#__t + 1] = __d:sub(__i, __i) end end; __d = table.concat(__t) end`;
        if (op.type === "posrol") return `__d = __map(__d, function(v, i) return __ror(v, ((((i - 1) * ${op.mult} + ${op.add}) % 7) + 1)) end)`;
        return `__d = __map(__d, function(v, i) return (((v - ${op.b} - (((i - 1) * ${op.mult}) % 256)) * ${op.inv}) % 256) end)`;
      }).join("\n");

      // Eight distinct reversible text encoders are stacked after the byte transforms.
      // The final Base64 wrapper below is only the transport container.
      const textEncoder = new TextEncoder();
      const encodeHex = (bytes) => Array.from(bytes, b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
      const encodeBase32 = (bytes) => {
        const alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567";
        let out = "", buffer = 0, bits = 0;
        for (const byte of bytes) {
          buffer = (buffer << 8) | byte;
          bits += 8;
          while (bits >= 5) {
            bits -= 5;
            out += alphabet[(buffer >>> bits) & 31];
            buffer %= (2 ** bits);
          }
        }
        if (bits > 0) out += alphabet[(buffer << (5 - bits)) & 31];
        while (out.length % 8) out += "=";
        return out;
      };
      const encodeAscii85 = (bytes) => {
        let out = "";
        for (let offset = 0; offset < bytes.length; offset += 4) {
          const count = Math.min(4, bytes.length - offset);
          let value = 0n;
          for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) value = (value << 8n) | BigInt(j < count ? bytes[offset + j] : 0);
          const digits = new Array(5);
          for (let j = 4; j >= 0; j--) {
            digits[j] = Number(value % 85n) + 33;
            value /= 85n;
          }
          for (let j = 0; j < count + 1; j++) out += String.fromCharCode(digits[j]);
        }
        return out;
      };
      const BASE45_ALPHABET = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ $%*+-./:";
      const encodeBase45 = (bytes) => {
        let out = "";
        for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 2) {
          if (i + 1 < bytes.length) {
            let value = bytes[i] * 256 + bytes[i + 1];
            const c = value % 45; value = Math.floor(value / 45);
            const d = value % 45; value = Math.floor(value / 45);
            const e = value % 45;
            out += BASE45_ALPHABET[e] + BASE45_ALPHABET[d] + BASE45_ALPHABET[c];
          } else {
            const value = bytes[i];
            out += BASE45_ALPHABET[Math.floor(value / 45)] + BASE45_ALPHABET[value % 45];
          }
        }
        return out;
      };
      const Z85_ALPHABET = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ.-:+=^!/*?&<>()[]{}@%$#";
      const RFC1924_BASE85_ALPHABET = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz!#$%&()*+-;<=>?@^_`{|}~";
      const encodeBase85Variant = (bytes, alphabet) => {
        const remainder = bytes.length % 4;
        const out = [String(remainder)];
        for (let offset = 0; offset < bytes.length; offset += 4) {
          let value = 0;
          for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) value = value * 256 + (bytes[offset + j] || 0);
          const digits = new Array(5);
          for (let j = 4; j >= 0; j--) { digits[j] = value % 85; value = Math.floor(value / 85); }
          for (const digit of digits) out.push(alphabet[digit]);
        }
        return out.join("");
      };
      const encodeUrlPercent = (bytes) => {
        let out = "";
        const hex = "0123456789ABCDEF";
        for (const byte of bytes) {
          const safe = (byte >= 48 && byte <= 57) || (byte >= 65 && byte <= 90) ||
            (byte >= 97 && byte <= 122) || byte === 45 || byte === 95 || byte === 46 || byte === 126;
          out += safe ? String.fromCharCode(byte) : "%" + hex[(byte >>> 4) & 15] + hex[byte & 15];
        }
        return out;
      };
      const BASE58_ALPHABET = "123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz";
      const encodeBase58Chunk = (bytes) => {
        let zeroes = 0;
        while (zeroes < bytes.length && bytes[zeroes] === 0) zeroes++;
        if (zeroes === bytes.length) return "1".repeat(zeroes);
        const digits = [0];
        for (let i = zeroes; i < bytes.length; i++) {
          let carry = bytes[i];
          for (let j = 0; j < digits.length; j++) {
            carry += digits[j] * 256;
            digits[j] = carry % 58;
            carry = Math.floor(carry / 58);
          }
          while (carry > 0) {
            digits.push(carry % 58);
            carry = Math.floor(carry / 58);
          }
        }
        while (digits.length && digits[digits.length - 1] === 0) digits.pop();
        return "1".repeat(zeroes) + digits.reverse().map(d => BASE58_ALPHABET[d]).join("");
      };
      // Chunking keeps Base58 work bounded for larger scripts; '.' is not in the alphabet.
      const encodeBase58 = (bytes) => {
        const parts = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 32) parts.push(encodeBase58Chunk(bytes.subarray(i, i + 32)));
        return parts.join(".");
      };
      const BASE91_ALPHABET = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789!#$%&()*+,./:;<=>?@[]^_`{|}~\"";
      const encodeBase91 = (bytes) => {
        let out = "", buffer = 0, bits = 0;
        for (const byte of bytes) {
          buffer += byte * (2 ** bits);
          bits += 8;
          if (bits > 13) {
            let value = buffer % 8192;
            if (value > 88) {
              buffer = Math.floor(buffer / 8192);
              bits -= 13;
            } else {
              value = buffer % 16384;
              buffer = Math.floor(buffer / 16384);
              bits -= 14;
            }
            out += BASE91_ALPHABET[value % 91] + BASE91_ALPHABET[Math.floor(value / 91)];
          }
        }
        if (bits > 0) {
          out += BASE91_ALPHABET[buffer % 91];
          if (bits > 7 || buffer > 90) out += BASE91_ALPHABET[Math.floor(buffer / 91)];
        }
        return out;
      };
      // Generic byte-preserving radix encoders. Each codec has a matching
      // decoder in the generated Lua bootstrap. Leading zero bytes are preserved.
      const encodeRadix = (bytes, alphabet) => {
        const base = alphabet.length;
        let zeroes = 0;
        while (zeroes < bytes.length && bytes[zeroes] === 0) zeroes++;
        if (zeroes === bytes.length) return alphabet[0].repeat(zeroes);
        const digits = [0];
        for (let i = zeroes; i < bytes.length; i++) {
          let carry = bytes[i];
          for (let j = 0; j < digits.length; j++) {
            carry += digits[j] * 256;
            digits[j] = carry % base;
            carry = Math.floor(carry / base);
          }
          while (carry > 0) {
            digits.push(carry % base);
            carry = Math.floor(carry / base);
          }
        }
        while (digits.length && digits[digits.length - 1] === 0) digits.pop();
        return alphabet[0].repeat(zeroes) + digits.reverse().map(d => alphabet[d]).join("");
      };
      // Positional Base-N alphabets. These are Luavify-defined digit orders,
      // not claims that every Base-N label has one universal standard.
      const RADIX_DIGITS = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz";
      const RADIX_ALPHABETS = {
        base2: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 2),
        base3: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 3),
        base4: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 4),
        base5: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 5),
        base6: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 6),
        base7: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 7),
        base8: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 8),
        base9: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 9),
        base10: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 10),
        base11: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 11),
        base12: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 12),
        base13: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 13),
        base14: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 14),
        base15: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 15),
        base16: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 16),
        base17: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 17),
        base18: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 18),
        base19: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 19),
        base20: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 20),
        base21: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 21),
        base22: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 22),
        base23: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 23),
        base24: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 24),
        base25: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 25),
        base26: "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ",
        base27: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 27),
        base28: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 28),
        base29: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 29),
        base30: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 30),
        base31: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 31),
        base32: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 32),
        base33: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 33),
        base34: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 34),
        base35: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 35),
        base36: "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ",
        base37: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 37),
        base38: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 38),
        base39: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 39),
        base40: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 40),
        base41: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 41),
        base42: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 42),
        base43: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 43),
        base44: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 44),
        base45: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 45),
        base46: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 46),
        base47: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 47),
        base48: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 48),
        base49: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 49),
        base50: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 50),
        base51: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 51),
        base52: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 52),
        base53: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 53),
        base54: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 54),
        base55: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 55),
        base56: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 56),
        base57: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 57),
        base59: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 59),
        base60: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 60),
        base61: RADIX_DIGITS.slice(0, 61),
        base62: "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz",
      };
      const encoderRegistry = {
        base2: (bytes) => textEncoder.encode(encodeRadix(bytes, RADIX_ALPHABETS.base2)),
        base3: (bytes) => textEncoder.encode(encodeRadix(bytes, RADIX_ALPHABETS.base3)),
        base4: (bytes) => textEncoder.encode(encodeRadix(bytes, RADIX_ALPHABETS.base4)),
        base5: (bytes) => textEncoder.encode(encodeRadix(bytes, RADIX_ALPHABETS.base5)),
        base6: (bytes) => textEncoder.encode(encodeRadix(bytes, RADIX_ALPHABETS.base6)),
        base7: (bytes) => textEncoder.encode(encodeRadix(bytes, RADIX_ALPHABETS.base7)),
        base8: (bytes) => textEncoder.encode(encodeRadix(bytes, RADIX_ALPHABETS.base8)),

      // Keep every supported encoder/decoder registered, but do not randomly
      // run the arbitrary low-radix Base-N codecs in the per-request Shield
      // bootstrap. Their repeated-division implementation is quadratic for
      // large byte strings; a random Base2/Base3 stage could expand a small
      // bootstrap into a huge payload and exhaust the Cloudflare Worker CPU.
      // The full Base2-Base62 encoders remain available to the protection
      // pipeline, while this latency-sensitive route uses bounded linear codecs.
      const fastCodecNames = [
        "base64", "base64url", "hex", "base32",
        "ascii85", "base45", "z85", "rfc1924base85", "urlpercent"
      ];
      const maxCodecStages = data.length <= 64 * 1024 ? 3
        : data.length <= 256 * 1024 ? 2
        : 1;
      for (let i = fastCodecNames.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        const j = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(1))[0] % (i + 1);
        [fastCodecNames[i], fastCodecNames[j]] = [fastCodecNames[j], fastCodecNames[i]];
      }
      const codecOrder = fastCodecNames.slice(0, maxCodecStages);
      for (const name of codecOrder) data = encoderRegistry[name](data);
      const luaCodecDecode = codecOrder.slice().reverse().map(name => luaCodecDecoders[name]).join("\n");

local function __xor(a, b)
    local result, bit = 0, 1
    while a > 0 or b > 0 do
        local x, y = a % 2, b % 2
        if x ~= y then result = result + bit end
        a = math.floor(a / 2)
        b = math.floor(b / 2)
        bit = bit * 2
    end
    return result
end
local function __map(s, fn)
    local out = {}
    for i = 1, #s do out[i] = string.char(fn(string.byte(s, i), i)) end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local function __ror(v, n)
    local m = 2 ^ n
    return math.floor(v / m) + (v % m) * (2 ^ (8 - n))
end
local function __un64(s)
    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    local out, buffer, bits = {}, 0, 0
    for i = 1, #s do
        local ch = s:sub(i, i)
        if ch == "-" then ch = "+" elseif ch == "_" then ch = "/" end
        if ch ~= "=" then
            local value = alphabet:find(ch, 1, true)
            if value then
                buffer = buffer * 64 + value - 1
                bits = bits + 6
                if bits >= 8 then
                    bits = bits - 8
                    out[#out + 1] = string.char(math.floor(buffer / (2 ^ bits)) % 256)
                    buffer = buffer % (2 ^ bits)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local function __un45(s)
    local alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ $%*+-./:"
    local out, i = {}, 1
    while i <= #s do
        local remaining = #s - i + 1
        if remaining == 1 then error("Luavify Base45 payload is truncated") end
        if remaining >= 3 then
            local a = alphabet:find(s:sub(i, i), 1, true)
            local b = alphabet:find(s:sub(i + 1, i + 1), 1, true)
            local c = alphabet:find(s:sub(i + 2, i + 2), 1, true)
            if not a or not b or not c then error("Luavify Base45 payload is invalid") end
            local value = ((a - 1) * 45 + (b - 1)) * 45 + (c - 1)
            if value > 65535 then error("Luavify Base45 pair is out of range") end
            out[#out + 1] = string.char(math.floor(value / 256), value % 256)
            i = i + 3
        else
            local a = alphabet:find(s:sub(i, i), 1, true)
            local b = alphabet:find(s:sub(i + 1, i + 1), 1, true)
            if not a or not b then error("Luavify Base45 payload is invalid") end
            local value = (a - 1) * 45 + (b - 1)
            if value > 255 then error("Luavify Base45 byte is out of range") end
            out[#out + 1] = string.char(value)
            i = i + 2
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local function __un85(s, alphabet)
    if #s < 1 then error("Luavify Base85 payload is empty") end
    local remainder = tonumber(s:sub(1, 1))
    if not remainder or remainder < 0 or remainder > 3 then error("Luavify Base85 length marker is invalid") end
    local payload = s:sub(2)
    if (#payload % 5) ~= 0 then error("Luavify Base85 payload length is invalid") end
    local out = {}
    for i = 1, #payload, 5 do
        local value = 0
        for j = 0, 4 do
            local digit = alphabet:find(payload:sub(i + j, i + j), 1, true)
            if not digit then error("Luavify Base85 payload is invalid") end
            value = value * 85 + digit - 1
        end
        if value > 4294967295 then error("Luavify Base85 block is out of range") end
        out[#out + 1] = string.char(
            math.floor(value / 16777216) % 256,
            math.floor(value / 65536) % 256,
            math.floor(value / 256) % 256,
            value % 256
        )
    end
    local decoded = table.concat(out)
    if remainder == 0 then return decoded end
    return decoded:sub(1, #decoded - (4 - remainder))
end
local function __unradix(s, alphabet)
    local base = #alphabet
    if base < 2 then error("Luavify radix alphabet is invalid") end
    local zeroes = 0
    while zeroes < #s and s:sub(zeroes + 1, zeroes + 1) == alphabet:sub(1, 1) do
        zeroes = zeroes + 1
    end
    local bytes = {0}
    for i = zeroes + 1, #s do
        local digit = alphabet:find(s:sub(i, i), 1, true)
        if not digit then error("Luavify radix payload is invalid") end
        local carry = digit - 1
        for j = 1, #bytes do
            local value = bytes[j] * base + carry
            bytes[j] = value % 256
            carry = math.floor(value / 256)
        end
        while carry > 0 do
            bytes[#bytes + 1] = carry % 256
            carry = math.floor(carry / 256)
        end
    end
    local out = {}
    for i = 1, zeroes do out[#out + 1] = string.char(0) end
    if #s > zeroes then
        while #bytes > 1 and bytes[#bytes] == 0 do table.remove(bytes) end
        for i = #bytes, 1, -1 do out[#out + 1] = string.char(bytes[i]) end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local function __unhex(s)
    if (#s % 2) ~= 0 then error("Luavify hex payload has odd length") end
    local out = {}
    for i = 1, #s, 2 do
        local value = tonumber(s:sub(i, i + 1), 16)
        if not value then error("Luavify hex payload is invalid") end
        out[#out + 1] = string.char(value)
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local function __un32(s)
    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567"
    local out, buffer, bits = {}, 0, 0
    for i = 1, #s do
        local ch = s:sub(i, i)
        if ch ~= "=" then
            local value = alphabet:find(ch, 1, true)
            if not value then error("Luavify Base32 payload is invalid") end
            buffer = buffer * 32 + value - 1
            bits = bits + 5
            if bits >= 8 then
                bits = bits - 8
                out[#out + 1] = string.char(math.floor(buffer / (2 ^ bits)) % 256)
                buffer = buffer % (2 ^ bits)
            end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local function __unascii85(s)
    local out = {}
    local i = 1
    while i <= #s do
        local take = math.min(5, #s - i + 1)
        if take == 1 then error("Luavify ASCII85 payload is truncated") end
        local value = 0
        for j = 0, 4 do
            local digit = j < take and (string.byte(s, i + j) - 33) or 84
            if digit < 0 or digit > 84 then error("Luavify ASCII85 payload is invalid") end
            value = value * 85 + digit
        end
        if value > 4294967295 then error("Luavify ASCII85 block is out of range") end
        local b1 = math.floor(value / 16777216) % 256
        local b2 = math.floor(value / 65536) % 256
        local b3 = math.floor(value / 256) % 256
        local b4 = value % 256
        out[#out + 1] = string.char(b1)
        if take >= 5 or take >= 3 then out[#out + 1] = string.char(b2) end
        if take >= 5 or take >= 4 then out[#out + 1] = string.char(b3) end
        if take >= 5 then out[#out + 1] = string.char(b4) end
        i = i + take
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local function __unurl(s)
    return (s:gsub("%%(%x%x)", function(hex) return string.char(tonumber(hex, 16)) end))
end
local function __un58chunk(s)
    local alphabet = "123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    local zeroes = 0
    while zeroes < #s and s:sub(zeroes + 1, zeroes + 1) == "1" do zeroes = zeroes + 1 end
    local bytes = {}
    for i = zeroes + 1, #s do
        local digit = alphabet:find(s:sub(i, i), 1, true)
        if not digit then error("Luavify Base58 payload is invalid") end
        local carry = digit - 1
        if #bytes == 0 then bytes[1] = 0 end
        for j = 1, #bytes do
            local value = bytes[j] * 58 + carry
            bytes[j] = value % 256
            carry = math.floor(value / 256)
        end
        while carry > 0 do
            bytes[#bytes + 1] = carry % 256
            carry = math.floor(carry / 256)
        end
    end
    local out = {}
    for i = 1, zeroes do out[#out + 1] = string.char(0) end
    if #bytes > 0 then
        while #bytes > 1 and bytes[#bytes] == 0 do table.remove(bytes) end
        for i = #bytes, 1, -1 do out[#out + 1] = string.char(bytes[i]) end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local function __un58(s)
    if #s == 0 then return "" end
    local out = {}
    for part in (s .. "."):gmatch("(.-)%.") do
        if #part == 0 then error("Luavify Base58 chunk is empty") end
        out[#out + 1] = __un58chunk(part)
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local function __un91(s)
    local alphabet = [=[ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789!#$%&()*+,./:;<=>?@[]^_\`{|}~"]=]
    local out, value, buffer, bits = {}, -1, 0, 0
    for i = 1, #s do
        local digit = alphabet:find(s:sub(i, i), 1, true)
        if not digit then error("Luavify Base91 payload is invalid") end
        digit = digit - 1
        if value < 0 then
            value = digit
        else
            value = value + digit * 91
            buffer = buffer + value * (2 ^ bits)
            bits = bits + ((value % 8192) > 88 and 13 or 14)
            while bits >= 8 do
                out[#out + 1] = string.char(buffer % 256)
                buffer = math.floor(buffer / 256)
                bits = bits - 8
            end
            value = -1
        end
    end
    if value >= 0 then
        buffer = buffer + value * (2 ^ bits)
        out[#out + 1] = string.char(buffer % 256)
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local __d = __un64(__p)
${luaCodecDecode}
${luaPolymorphicDecode}
${luaExtraDecode}
__d = __map(__d, function(v, i) return (v - __a[((i - 1) * 3 + 2) % #__a + 1]) % 256 end)
__d = __d:reverse()
__d = __map(__d, function(v, i) return __xor(v, ((i - 1) * 13 + 0x39) % 256) end)
