    async function sha256HexBytes(bytes) {
      const dig = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes);
      return Array.from(new Uint8Array(dig)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
    }
    async function sha256HexStr(str) {
      return sha256HexBytes(new TextEncoder().encode(str));
    }

    function bytesToB64(bytes) {
      let s = "";
      const arr = bytes instanceof Uint8Array ? bytes : new Uint8Array(bytes);
      for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) s += String.fromCharCode(arr[i]);
      return btoa(s);
    }
    function b64ToBytes(b64) {
      const s = atob(b64);
      const out = new Uint8Array(s.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) out[i] = s.charCodeAt(i);
      return out;
    }
    async function deriveDeliveryXorKey(sessionId, token) {
      // Client derives the same key from sessionId+token (no AUTH_SECRET needed).
      // Payload body alone is not plain Luau; scrapers must implement the runtime.
      const dig = await crypto.subtle.digest(
        "SHA-256",
        new TextEncoder().encode(`luavify-delivery-xor-v1|${sessionId}|${token}`)
      );
      return new Uint8Array(dig);
    }
    async function xorEncryptToB64(plaintext, keyBytes) {
      const src = new TextEncoder().encode(plaintext);
      const out = new Uint8Array(src.length);
      const kl = keyBytes.length;
      for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i++) out[i] = src[i] ^ keyBytes[i % kl];
      return bytesToB64(out);
    }


    async function hmacHex(msg, secret) {
      const enc = new TextEncoder();
      const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
        "raw", enc.encode(secret), { name: "HMAC", hash: "SHA-256" }, false, ["sign"]
      );
      const sig = await crypto.subtle.sign("HMAC", key, enc.encode(msg));
      return Array.from(new Uint8Array(sig)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
    }

    async function serverSecretVaultKey() {
      if (!AUTH_SECRET || AUTH_SECRET.length < 32) throw new Error("AUTH_SECRET is unavailable");
      const raw = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode("luavify-place-secret-v1|" + AUTH_SECRET));
      return crypto.subtle.importKey("raw", raw, "AES-GCM", false, ["encrypt", "decrypt"]);
    }

    async function sealServerSecret(value) {
      const key = await serverSecretVaultKey();
      const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
      const cipher = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: "AES-GCM", iv }, key, new TextEncoder().encode(String(value))));
      const out = new Uint8Array(iv.length + cipher.length);
      out.set(iv, 0); out.set(cipher, iv.length);
      return bytesToB64(out);
    }

    async function openServerSecret(value) {
      try {
        const raw = b64ToBytes(String(value || ""));
        if (raw.length < 29) return null;
        const key = await serverSecretVaultKey();
        const plain = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: "AES-GCM", iv: raw.slice(0, 12) }, key, raw.slice(12));
        return new TextDecoder().decode(plain);
      } catch (_) { return null; }
    }

    // Per https://voltils.cc/docs/api (confirmed with the provider, Nov 2026):
    //   - 400 invalid code/preset/request   -> NOT retryable
    //   - 401 invalid/expired/revoked key   -> NOT retryable
    //   - 413 source exceeds size limit     -> NOT retryable
    //   - 429 quota, attempt limit, or compiler busy -> retryable, but the
    //     docs explicitly say to "follow the response's retry guidance and
    //     avoid sending repeated requests while a job is processing" ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â i.e.
    //     do NOT blind-retry on a fixed schedule. Only retry when the
    //     response gives us a Retry-After header, and only once.
    //   - 5xx compiler/connection/confirmation unavailable -> same as 429.
    // Basic/Pro/Elite plans cap SUCCESSFUL obfuscations at 3/12/120 per
    // rolling 12h and 6/24/240 per UTC day. Because this Worker shares one
    // key across every dashboard user, those caps are easy to blow through
    // with real traffic, and every failed attempt still likely counts
    // against the "attempt limit" the docs mention for 429s ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â so retrying
    // blindly (like the previous version of this function did) makes an
    // exhausted quota worse, not better. We instead track our own usage in
    // KV and refuse locally, before spending an attempt, once we're at the
    // configured plan's limit.
    const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
    const VOLTFUSCATOR_RETRYABLE_STATUS = new Set([429, 500, 502, 503, 504]);
    const VOLTFUSCATOR_MAX_RETRY_AFTER_MS = 20000; // never block a Worker request longer than this

    // Rolling-12h window approximated as two overlapping 12h-aligned buckets
    // checked together (bucket N and N-1), which is close enough for a soft
    // local guard ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â the authoritative count is always voltils.cc's own.
    function voltfuscatorBucketKeys() {
      const now = Date.now();
      const bucketMs = 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
      const bucket = Math.floor(now / bucketMs);
      const day = new Date(now).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      return {
        twelveHourKeys: [`voltf_quota_12h_${bucket}`, `voltf_quota_12h_${bucket - 1}`],
        dayKey: `voltf_quota_day_${day}`,
      };
    }
    async function voltfuscatorQuotaRemaining() {
      const { twelveHourKeys, dayKey } = voltfuscatorBucketKeys();
      const [b1, b0, d] = await Promise.all([
        env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(twelveHourKeys[0]),
        env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(twelveHourKeys[1]),
        env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(dayKey),
      ]);
      const twelveHourCount = (parseInt(b1 || "0", 10) || 0) + (parseInt(b0 || "0", 10) || 0);
      const dayCount = parseInt(d || "0", 10) || 0;
      const remaining12h = VOLTFUSCATOR_PLAN.rolling12h - twelveHourCount;
      const remainingDay = VOLTFUSCATOR_PLAN.daily - dayCount;
      return Math.min(remaining12h, remainingDay);
    }
    async function voltfuscatorRecordSuccess() {
      const { twelveHourKeys, dayKey } = voltfuscatorBucketKeys();
      const key12h = twelveHourKeys[0];
      const [c12, cd] = await Promise.all([
        env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(key12h),
        env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(dayKey),
      ]);
      await Promise.all([
        env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(key12h, String((parseInt(c12 || "0", 10) || 0) + 1), { expirationTtl: 60 * 60 * 25 }),
        env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(dayKey, String((parseInt(cd || "0", 10) || 0) + 1), { expirationTtl: 60 * 60 * 25 }),
      ]);
    }

    async function callVoltfuscatorOnce(code, apiKey) {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 120000);
      let voltilsResponse;
      try {
        voltilsResponse = await fetch("https://voltils.cc/v1/obfuscate", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Authorization": `Bearer ${apiKey}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          // These are the documented API request fields. Runtime is configurable
          // only so a staging deployment can compare Executor vs standard Luau.
          body: JSON.stringify({
            code,
            preset: VOLTFUSCATOR_PRESET,
            runtime: VOLTFUSCATOR_RUNTIME,
          }),
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
      } catch (e) {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        if (e && e.name === "AbortError") throw new Error("Voltfuscator timed out after 120s. Try a smaller script, preset Normal, or retry in a minute.");
        throw new Error("Voltfuscator 7.7 network error: " + (e.message || String(e)));
      }
      clearTimeout(timer);

      const rawText = await voltilsResponse.text();
      let result;
      try {
        result = JSON.parse(rawText);
      } catch (_) {
        /** @type {PipelineError} */
        const err = new Error("Voltfuscator 7.7 returned non-JSON (status " + voltilsResponse.status + ")");
        err.voltfuscatorStatus = voltilsResponse.status;
        err.voltfuscatorRawBody = rawText.slice(0, 2000);
        throw err;
      }
      if (!voltilsResponse.ok) {
        const detail = result.error || result.message || result.detail || result.reason || "";
        /** @type {PipelineError} */
        const err = new Error(
          (detail ? String(detail) : ("Voltfuscator HTTP " + voltilsResponse.status)) +
          (voltilsResponse.status === 401 ? " (invalid API key)" :
           voltilsResponse.status === 413 ? " (script too large for plan)" :
           voltilsResponse.status === 429 ? " (quota / rate limit Ã¢â‚¬â€ wait and retry)" :
           voltilsResponse.status >= 500 ? " (Voltfuscator server error Ã¢â‚¬â€ retry)" : "")
        );
        err.voltfuscatorStatus = voltilsResponse.status;
        err.voltfuscatorRawBody = rawText.slice(0, 2000);
        const retryAfterHeader = voltilsResponse.headers.get("Retry-After");
        if (retryAfterHeader != null) {
          const asSeconds = Number(retryAfterHeader);
          err.voltfuscatorRetryAfterMs = Number.isFinite(asSeconds)
            ? asSeconds * 1000
            : Math.max(0, Date.parse(retryAfterHeader) - Date.now());
        }
        throw err;
      }
      return result;
    }

    async function callVoltfuscator(code, apiKey) {
      if (!apiKey) {
        throw new Error("VOLTILS_API_KEY is not configured. Cannot run Voltfuscator 7.7.");
      }

      // Soft local guard: don't spend a real attempt against voltils.cc's
      // own attempt-limited 429 bucket if we already know, from our own
      // bookkeeping, that this key is at its plan limit for the window.
      const remaining = await voltfuscatorQuotaRemaining();
      if (remaining <= 0) {
        const planName = (env.VOLTFUSCATOR_PLAN || "basic").toLowerCase();
        throw new Error(
          `Voltfuscator 7.7 local quota guard: the shared API key has used its ${planName} obfuscation allowance for this window. Try again later, or upgrade the voltils.cc plan.`
        );
      }

      let result;
      try {
        result = await callVoltfuscatorOnce(code, apiKey);
      } catch (e) {
        const status = e && e.voltfuscatorStatus;
        const canRetry = VOLTFUSCATOR_RETRYABLE_STATUS.has(status) &&
          Number.isFinite(e.voltfuscatorRetryAfterMs) &&
          e.voltfuscatorRetryAfterMs <= VOLTFUSCATOR_MAX_RETRY_AFTER_MS;
        if (!canRetry) throw e;
        // The server told us explicitly how long to wait ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â honor that,
        // don't invent our own schedule, and only do this once.
        await sleep(e.voltfuscatorRetryAfterMs);
        result = await callVoltfuscatorOnce(code, apiKey); // let a second failure propagate as-is
      }

      await voltfuscatorRecordSuccess();
      let rawOut = result.obfuscated;
      if (typeof rawOut !== "string" || !rawOut.trim()) {
        throw new Error("Voltfuscator 7.7 returned empty obfuscated output");
      }

      // Some API/proxy responses wrap the generated source as a JSON string.
      // Unwrap only known source fields. Never store a JSON response as Luau.
      const trimmedOut = rawOut.trim();
      if (trimmedOut.startsWith("{")) {
        let wrapped;
        try { wrapped = JSON.parse(trimmedOut); } catch (_) { wrapped = null; }
        if (wrapped && typeof wrapped === "object") {
          const candidate = [wrapped.obfuscated, wrapped.code, wrapped.output, wrapped.source]
            .find((value) => typeof value === "string" && value.trim());
          if (candidate) rawOut = candidate;
          else {
            const reason = wrapped.error || wrapped.message || wrapped.detail;
            throw new Error("Voltfuscator 7.7 returned JSON instead of Luau" + (reason ? ": " + String(reason).slice(0, 240) : ""));
          }
        }
      }

      // No watermark handling: return the obfuscated output exactly as
      // voltils.cc sent it back, with no comment stripped and no marker
      // check applied.
      const out = rawOut.trim();
      if (!out) {
        throw new Error("Voltfuscator 7.7 returned empty obfuscated output");
      }
      if (out.startsWith("{")) {
        let parsedOutput = null;
        try { parsedOutput = JSON.parse(out); } catch (_) {}
        if (parsedOutput && typeof parsedOutput === "object") {
          throw new Error("Voltfuscator 7.7 output is JSON, not executable Luau. Check the API response format.");
        }
        throw new Error("Voltfuscator 7.7 output starts with an invalid Luau block ('{'). Refusing to publish a broken script.");
      }
      return out;
    }

    // Optional Luavify bytecode compiler (alternative to Voltfuscator).
    // Set both secrets/vars in Cloudflare:
    //   LUAVIFY_BYTECODE_COMPILER_URL  e.g. https://compiler.example.com/compile
    //   LUAVIFY_BYTECODE_COMPILER_KEY  API key / bearer token
    const BYTECODE_COMPILER_URL = String(env.LUAVIFY_BYTECODE_COMPILER_URL || env.BYTECODE_COMPILER_URL || "").trim();
    const BYTECODE_COMPILER_KEY = String(env.LUAVIFY_BYTECODE_COMPILER_KEY || env.BYTECODE_COMPILER_KEY || "").trim();

    async function callBytecodeCompiler(source) {
      if (!BYTECODE_COMPILER_URL || !BYTECODE_COMPILER_KEY) {
        throw new Error("Luavify bytecode compiler is not configured. Set LUAVIFY_BYTECODE_COMPILER_URL and LUAVIFY_BYTECODE_COMPILER_KEY.");
      }
      let res;
      try {
        res = await fetch(BYTECODE_COMPILER_URL, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Accept": "application/json, text/plain;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8",
            "Authorization": "Bearer " + BYTECODE_COMPILER_KEY,
            "X-Api-Key": BYTECODE_COMPILER_KEY,
            "X-Luavify-Key": BYTECODE_COMPILER_KEY,
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            code: source,
            source: source,
            script: source,
            lua: source,
            preset: VOLTFUSCATOR_PRESET,
            runtime: VOLTFUSCATOR_RUNTIME,
          }),
        });
      } catch (e) {
        throw new Error("Bytecode compiler unreachable: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : e));
      }
      const rawText = await res.text();
      if (!res.ok) {
        /** @type {PipelineError} */
        const err = new Error("Bytecode compiler failed (" + res.status + "): " + rawText.slice(0, 300));
        err.voltfuscatorStatus = res.status;
        err.voltfuscatorRawBody = rawText.slice(0, 2000);
        throw err;
      }
      let out = rawText;
      const ct = (res.headers.get("content-type") || "").toLowerCase();
      if (ct.includes("json") || (rawText.trim().startsWith("{") && rawText.trim().endsWith("}"))) {
        try {
          const j = JSON.parse(rawText);
          out = j.obfuscated || j.code || j.output || j.result || j.bytecode || j.data || j.script || j.source || "";
          if (typeof out !== "string" && out && typeof out.code === "string") out = out.code;
        } catch (_) { /* keep rawText */ }
      }
      if (typeof out !== "string" || !out.trim()) {
        throw new Error("Bytecode compiler returned empty output");
      }
      return out;
    }

    async function runProtectionPipeline(originalCode) {
      if (typeof originalCode !== "string") throw new Error("Source must be a string");
      const source = originalCode;
      if (!source.trim()) throw new Error("Source is empty");
      const byteLen = new TextEncoder().encode(source).length;
      if (byteLen > MAX_SOURCE_BYTES) throw new Error("Source exceeds " + MAX_SOURCE_BYTES + " bytes");
      if (!AUTH_SECRET || AUTH_SECRET.length < 32) {
        throw new Error("AUTH_SECRET is required (minimum 32 characters) for secure delivery.");
      }

      const hasVolt = !!VOLTILS_API_KEY;
      const hasBytecode = !!(BYTECODE_COMPILER_URL && BYTECODE_COMPILER_KEY);
      if (!hasVolt && !hasBytecode) {
        throw new Error(
          "Obfuscation is not configured. Set VOLTILS_API_KEY (Voltfuscator), or both LUAVIFY_BYTECODE_COMPILER_URL and LUAVIFY_BYTECODE_COMPILER_KEY."
        );
      }

      let finalCode;
      let pipelineStages;
      let pipelineVersion;

      // Prefer Voltfuscator when available; otherwise use Luavify bytecode compiler.
      if (hasVolt) {
        // The notice is part of the source submitted to Voltfuscator, so its
        // string literal is processed by the obfuscator together with the script.
        const voltfuscatorInput = makeVoltfuscatorNoticeInput(source);
        const obfuscatedOutput = await callVoltfuscator(voltfuscatorInput, VOLTILS_API_KEY);
        if (obfuscatedOutput === voltfuscatorInput && voltfuscatorInput.length > 64) {
          throw new Error("Voltfuscator returned the input unchanged; refusing to publish unprotected source.");
        }
        // Keep a readable notice at byte zero of the delivered Lua output too.
        finalCode = addVoltfuscatorNoticeHeader(obfuscatedOutput);
        pipelineVersion = "5.2.2-voltfuscator-notice";
        pipelineStages = [`voltfuscator-7.7-${VOLTFUSCATOR_PRESET}`, "embedded-protection-notice", "top-level-protection-notice", "protected-output-only", `runtime-${VOLTFUSCATOR_RUNTIME}`, "final-content-hash"];
      } else {
        finalCode = await callBytecodeCompiler(source);
        pipelineVersion = "5.3.0-bytecode-compiler";
        pipelineStages = ["luavify-bytecode-compiler", "protected-output-only", "final-content-hash"];
      }

      if (typeof finalCode !== "string" || !finalCode.trim()) {
        throw new Error("Voltfuscator returned empty output");
      }
      if (finalCode.length > Math.max(MAX_SOURCE_BYTES * 12, 6 * 1024 * 1024)) {
        throw new Error("Protected output too large (" + Math.round(finalCode.length/1024) + " KB)");
      }
      // Allow output equal to source only if extremely short (API no-op); still accept
      if (finalCode === source && source.length > 64) {
        throw new Error("Voltfuscator returned unprotected source. Check API key / preset / script syntax.");
      }
      const contentHash = await sha256HexStr(finalCode);
      return {
        finalCode,
        contentHash,
        pipelineVersion,
        superflowVersion: null,
        buildId: randHex(8),
        pipelineStages,
      };
    }

    // Only deliver builds that were produced by the protection pipeline.
    // The metadata is written by this Worker alongside the protected KV payload.
    function hasVoltfuscatorProtectionMetadata(meta) {
      if (!meta || typeof meta !== "object" || meta.obfuscated !== true) return false;
      const version = String(meta.pipelineVersion || "");
      const stages = Array.isArray(meta.pipelineStages) ? meta.pipelineStages : [];
      // Raw/none uploads are never eligible for protected runtime delivery.
      // FictionFuscate and Voltfuscator remain legacy protected formats; bytecode
      // is accepted only when the build metadata explicitly identifies it.
      if (/voltfuscator|bytecode|fictionfuscate|fiction/i.test(version)) return true;
      return stages.some((stage) => typeof stage === "string" &&
        /voltfuscator|bytecode|fictionfuscate|fiction/i.test(stage));
    }

    function constantTimeEqual(a, b) {
      if (typeof a !== "string" || typeof b !== "string" || a.length !== b.length) return false;
      let diff = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) diff |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
      return diff === 0;
    }

    // The owner project record is authoritative for delivery policy. KV's
    // keyless_<hash> value is only a compatibility mirror and MUST NOT grant
    // public delivery on its own.
    async function getDeliveryScriptMetadata(hash) {
      const ownerId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`script_owner_${hash}`);
      if (!ownerId) return { ok: false, reason: "script_owner_missing" };

      const projectsDoc = await getProjectsDoc(ownerId);
      if (!projectsDoc || !Array.isArray(projectsDoc.projects)) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "script_metadata_missing" };
      }

      const matches = [];
      for (const project of projectsDoc.projects) {
        for (const script of (project.scripts || [])) {
          if (String(script.hash || "").toLowerCase() === String(hash).toLowerCase()) {
            matches.push({ project, script });
          }
        }
      }
      // Missing or duplicated ownership metadata is ambiguous: fail closed.
      if (matches.length !== 1) {
        return { ok: false, reason: matches.length ? "script_metadata_ambiguous" : "script_metadata_missing" };
      }

      const { project, script } = matches[0];
      const accessMode = ["public", "shared_key", "buyer_key"].includes(script.accessMode)
        ? script.accessMode : (script.keyless === true ? "public" : "buyer_key");
      const keyless = accessMode === "public"; // Legacy compatibility alias.
      // Parallelize KV read + lock check ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â was two sequential await calls.
      const [disabledVal, locked, securityRaw] = await Promise.all([
        env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`disabled_${hash}`),
        isScriptLocked(hash),
        env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`security_${hash}`),
      ]);
      const disabled = disabledVal === "true" || script.active === false;
      let security = {};
      try { security = securityRaw ? JSON.parse(securityRaw) : {}; } catch (_) { security = {}; }
      if (!security || typeof security !== "object" || Array.isArray(security)) security = {};

      // keyless_<hash> is only a legacy display mirror. Security policy is stored
      // separately so dashboard project saves cannot silently erase it.
      return { ok: true, ownerId, project, script, keyless, accessMode, security,
        sharedKeyHash: script.sharedKeyHash || null, disabled, locked };
    }

    async function isScriptExplicitlyPublic(hash, scriptOwnerId) {
      const metadata = await getDeliveryScriptMetadata(hash);
      return !!metadata.ok && metadata.ownerId === String(scriptOwnerId) && metadata.keyless === true &&
        metadata.disabled !== true && metadata.locked !== true;
    }

    async function validateDeliveryKey(hash, runtimeKey, metadata = null) {
      const scriptMeta = metadata || await getDeliveryScriptMetadata(hash);
      if (!scriptMeta.ok) return { ok: false, reason: scriptMeta.reason || "script_metadata_missing" };
      if (scriptMeta.disabled) return { ok: false, reason: "script_disabled" };
      if (scriptMeta.locked) return { ok: false, reason: "script_locked" };

      // Per-script creator-owned access policy.
      const accessMode = scriptMeta.accessMode || (scriptMeta.keyless ? "public" : "buyer_key");
      if (accessMode === "public") {
        return { ok: true, keyless: true, accessMode: "public", digest: "public",
          ownerId: scriptMeta.ownerId, projectId: String(scriptMeta.project.id), discordUserId: "", tokenDoc: null };
      }
      if (accessMode === "shared_key") {
        const suppliedKey = typeof runtimeKey === "string" ? runtimeKey.trim() : "";
        if (!suppliedKey || suppliedKey.length > 512) return { ok: false, reason: "missing_shared_key" };
        if (!scriptMeta.sharedKeyHash) return { ok: false, reason: "shared_key_not_configured" };
        const suppliedHash = await sha256HexStr("luavify-shared-script-key-v1|" + hash + "|" + suppliedKey);
        if (!constantTimeEqual(suppliedHash, scriptMeta.sharedKeyHash)) return { ok: false, reason: "bad_shared_key" };
        return { ok: true, keyless: false, accessMode: "shared_key", digest: suppliedHash,
          ownerId: scriptMeta.ownerId, projectId: String(scriptMeta.project.id), discordUserId: "", tokenDoc: null };
      }
      if (typeof runtimeKey !== "string" || !runtimeKey.trim() || runtimeKey.length > 512) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "missing_key" };
      }

      const digest = await sha256HexStr(runtimeKey);
      const tokenDocRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`usertoken_${digest}`);
      let tokenDoc = null;
      try { tokenDoc = tokenDocRaw ? JSON.parse(tokenDocRaw) : null; } catch (_) {}
      const expectedProjectId = String(scriptMeta.project.id);
      if (!tokenDoc || String(tokenDoc.hash || "").toLowerCase() !== String(hash).toLowerCase() ||
          String(tokenDoc.ownerId || "") !== String(scriptMeta.ownerId) ||
          String(tokenDoc.projectId || "") !== expectedProjectId ||
          !/^\d+$/.test(String(tokenDoc.projectId || "")) ||
          !/^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(tokenDoc.discordUserId || ""))) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "bad_key" };
      }

      // Null means a non-expiring owner-issued whitelist token. Missing, malformed,
      // or elapsed expiry values are invalid and fail closed.
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(tokenDoc, "expiresAt")) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "invalid_key_expiry" };
      }
      if (tokenDoc.expiresAt !== null) {
        const expiry = typeof tokenDoc.expiresAt === "string" ? Date.parse(tokenDoc.expiresAt) : NaN;
        if (!Number.isFinite(expiry) || expiry <= Date.now()) return { ok: false, reason: "expired_key" };
      }

      const deniedRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`accessbl_${tokenDoc.ownerId}_${tokenDoc.projectId}_${tokenDoc.discordUserId}`);
      let denied = null;
      try { denied = deniedRaw ? JSON.parse(deniedRaw) : null; } catch (_) {}
      const deniedExpiry = denied && denied.expiresAt ? Date.parse(denied.expiresAt) : null;
      if (denied && (!denied.expiresAt || !Number.isFinite(deniedExpiry) || deniedExpiry > Date.now())) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "blacklisted" };
      }

      return { ok: true, keyless: false, accessMode: "buyer_key", digest, ownerId: scriptMeta.ownerId,
        projectId: expectedProjectId, discordUserId: String(tokenDoc.discordUserId), tokenDoc };
    }

    async function authRecordStub(recordKey) {
      if (!env.NONCE_GUARD) throw new Error("NONCE_GUARD binding is missing");
      const digest = await sha256HexStr(`luavify-auth-record-v1|${recordKey}`);
      return env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(`auth-${digest.slice(0, 2)}`));
    }
    async function authRecordGet(recordKey) {
      const stub = await authRecordStub(recordKey);
      const response = await stub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/auth-record-get", {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ key: recordKey })
      });
      if (response.status === 404) return null;
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Auth record read failed (HTTP ${response.status})`);
      const data = await response.json();
      return typeof data.value === "string" ? data.value : null;
    }
    async function authRecordPut(recordKey, value) {
      const stub = await authRecordStub(recordKey);
      const response = await stub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/auth-record-put", {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ key: recordKey, value: String(value) })
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Auth record write failed (HTTP ${response.status})`);
    }

    async function rateLimit(ip, bucket, max, windowSec) {
      const ipKey = ip || "unknown-client";
      const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
      const windowStart = now - (now % windowSec);
      const key = `rl_${bucket}_${ipKey}_${windowStart}`;
      const cur = parseInt((await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(key)) || "0");
      if (cur >= max) return false;
      await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(key, String(cur + 1), { expirationTtl: windowSec + 10 });
      return true;
    }

    // Session creation uses the Durable Object limiter so a failing KV rate-limit
    // counter cannot produce an opaque pre-validation HTTP 500. Failure stays closed.
    async function durableSessionRateLimit(ip, bucket, max, windowSec) {
      if (!env.NONCE_GUARD) throw new Error("NONCE_GUARD binding is missing");
      const identity = await sha256HexStr(`luavify-rate-v1|${bucket}|${ip || "unknown-client"}`);
      const stub = env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(`rate-${identity}`));
      const response = await stub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/rate-limit", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ bucket, max, windowSec })
      });
      if (response.status === 204) return true;
      if (response.status === 429) return false;
      const detail = (await response.text().catch(() => "")).slice(0, 120);
      throw new Error(`Durable session rate limiter failed (HTTP ${response.status})${detail ? `: ${detail}` : ""}`);
    }

    async function durableScopedRateLimit(scope, identityValue, max, windowSec) {
      if (!env.NONCE_GUARD) throw new Error("NONCE_GUARD binding is missing");
      const identity = await sha256HexStr(`luavify-rate-scope-v1|${String(scope)}|${String(identityValue || "unknown")}`);
      const stub = env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(`scope-${identity}`));
      const response = await stub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/rate-limit", {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ bucket: "scoped", max, windowSec })
      });
      if (response.status === 204) return true;
      if (response.status === 429) return false;
      throw new Error(`Scoped rate limiter failed (HTTP ${response.status})`);
    }

    async function claimHwidBinding(hash, keyDigest, rawHwid) {
      const hwid = String(rawHwid || "").trim();
      if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9._:+/=-]{8,256}$/.test(hwid)) return { ok: false, reason: "missing_hwid" };
      const hwidHash = await sha256HexStr(`luavify-hwid-v1|${hwid}`);
      const bindingKey = await sha256HexStr(`luavify-hwid-binding-v1|${hash}|${keyDigest}`);
      const stub = env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(`hwid-${hash.slice(0, 2)}`));
      const response = await stub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/hwid-bind", {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ bindingKey, hwidHash })
      });
      if (response.status === 409) return { ok: false, reason: "hwid_mismatch" };
      if (!response.ok) return { ok: false, reason: "hwid_service_unavailable" };
      return { ok: true, hwidHash, bindingKey };
    }

    async function consumeTrustedPlaceTicket(hash, placeId, userId, ticket) {
      const rawTicket = String(ticket || "").trim();
      if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(rawTicket)) return false;
      const ticketHash = await sha256HexStr(`luavify-place-ticket-v1|${rawTicket}`);
      const stub = env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(`tickets-${hash.slice(0, 2)}`));
      const response = await stub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/place-ticket-consume", {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ ticketHash, hash, placeId: String(placeId), userId: String(userId) })
      });
      return response.status === 204;
    }

    async function audit(env, type, detail) {

          { expirationTtl: 60 * 60 * 24 * 30 }
        );
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    async function hasStoredValue(key) {
      const store = env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS;
      if (store && typeof store.has === "function") return store.has(key);
      const stream = await store.get(key, { type: "stream" });
      if (stream === null) return false;
      if (stream && typeof stream.cancel === "function") {
        try { await stream.cancel(); } catch (_) {}
      }
      return true;
    }

    function isPremiumActive(u) {
      if (!u || !PAID_PLANS.includes(u.plan)) return false;
      if (!u.premiumExpiry || u.premiumExpiry === "lifetime") return true;
      return new Date(u.premiumExpiry) >= new Date();

    async function getUser(id) {
      let str = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`user_${id}`);
      if (!str) str = await authRecordGet(`user_${id}`);
      return str ? JSON.parse(str) : null;

    async function getProjectsDoc(id) {
      const str = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`projects_data_${id}`);

    async function putProjectsDoc(id, doc) {

    function computeLocks(user, doc) {
      const none = { required: 0, lockedIds: [], pending: false, chosen: false };
      if (!user || !doc || !Array.isArray(doc.projects)) return none;
      if (user.isAdmin || OWNER_IDS.has(user.id) || isPremiumActive(user)) return none;
      const keep = PLAN_LIMITS.Basic.projects;
      const projects = doc.projects;
      const required = Math.max(0, projects.length - keep);
      if (required === 0) return none;
      const existing = new Set(projects.map((p) => p.id));
      let locked;
      let chosen = false;
      if (Array.isArray(user.lockChoice)) {
        chosen = true;
        locked = user.lockChoice.filter((id) => existing.has(id));
        const unlocked = projects.filter((p) => !locked.includes(p.id));
        if (unlocked.length > keep) locked = locked.concat(unlocked.slice(keep).map((p) => p.id));
      } else {
        locked = projects.slice(keep).map((p) => p.id);
      }
      return { required, lockedIds: locked, pending: !chosen, chosen };
    }
    async function lockInfoForUser(id) {
      const user = await getUser(id);
      const doc = await getProjectsDoc(id);
      return { user, doc, locks: computeLocks(user, doc) };
    }
    async function isScriptLocked(hash, knownOwnerId = null) {
      const ownerId = knownOwnerId || await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`script_owner_${hash}`);
      if (!ownerId || OWNER_IDS.has(ownerId)) return false;
      const { doc, locks } = await lockInfoForUser(ownerId);
      if (!doc || locks.lockedIds.length === 0) return false;
      const proj = doc.projects.find((p) => (p.scripts || []).some((sc) => sc.hash === hash));
      return !!proj && locks.lockedIds.includes(proj.id);
    }
    async function requireScriptAccess(hash) {
      if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
      if (!hash || !HASH_RE.test(hash)) return json({ error: "Invalid script" }, 400);
      const ownerId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`script_owner_${hash}`);
      if (!ownerId) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);
      if (ownerId !== userId && !OWNER_IDS.has(userId)) return json({ error: "Forbidden" }, 403);
      if (await isScriptLocked(hash)) return json({ error: "This project is locked. Rebuy Premium on Discord to unlock it.", locked: true }, 403);
      return null;
    }
    async function wipeScript(hash) {
      await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(hash);
      await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`original_${hash}`);
      await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`disabled_${hash}`);
      await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`script_owner_${hash}`);
      await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`meta_${hash}`);
      await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`keyless_${hash}`);
    }

    async function bumpDailyExec(ownerId) {
      const day = dayStr(new Date());
      const month = day.slice(0, 7);
      const doc = await readStatsDoc("e", ownerId, month);

      await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`stats_e_${ownerId}_${month}`, JSON.stringify(doc), { expirationTtl: 60 * 60 * 24 * 100 });
    }
    async function touchLive(ownerId, sid) {
      await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`live_${ownerId}_${sid}`, "1", { expirationTtl: LIVE_TTL });
      const list = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: `live_${ownerId}_` });
      const live = list.keys.length;
      const day = dayStr(new Date());
      const month = day.slice(0, 7);
      const doc = await readStatsDoc("p", ownerId, month);
      if (live > (doc[day] || 0)) {
        doc[day] = live;
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`stats_p_${ownerId}_${month}`, JSON.stringify(doc), { expirationTtl: 60 * 60 * 24 * 75 });
      }
    }
