    function bannedPage(ban, kind) {
      const esc = (v) => String(v == null ? "" : v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));
      const reason = esc((ban && ban.reason) || "No reason given");
      const title = kind === "ip" ? "Your IP address is banned" : "You are banned";
      const html = `<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Banned - Luavify</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#07070a;color:#f4f4f5;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;padding:20px}
.card{max-width:460px;width:100%;text-align:center;padding:40px 32px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.35);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(239,68,68,.12)}
.ico{width:64px;height:64px;margin:0 auto 18px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(239,68,68,.12);color:#ef4444;font-size:30px;font-weight:800}
h1{font-size:1.5rem;margin:0 0 8px}p{color:#a1a1aa;margin:0 0 18px;line-height:1.5}
.reason{background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;color:#fca5a5;font-size:.95rem;word-break:break-word}
.small{margin-top:18px;font-size:.8rem;color:#71717a}</style></head><body><div class="card"><div class="ico">!</div>
<h1>${title}</h1><p>You have been banned from this website and can no longer use it.</p>
<div class="reason"><strong>Reason:</strong> ${reason}</div>
<div class="small">If you think this is a mistake, contact the site owner.</div></div></body></html>`;
      return html;
    }
    function respondBannedPage(ban, kind) {
      return new Response(bannedPage(ban, kind), { status: 403, headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
    }
    function respondBanned(ban, kind) {
      const wantsHtml = request.method === "GET" && (request.headers.get("Accept") || "").includes("text/html");
      if (wantsHtml) {
        return new Response(bannedPage(ban, kind), { status: 403, headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
      }
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "You are banned from this website.", banned: true, ipBanned: kind === "ip", reason: (ban && ban.reason) || "No reason given", loggedIn: false }), {
        status: 403,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": "no-store" },
      });
    }
    // Remember which IPs an account has used (max 25, newest first). Returns true when the user object changed.
    function recordUserIp(u, ip, force) {
      ip = normIp(ip);
      if (!u || !ip || !IP_RE.test(ip)) return false;
      if (!Array.isArray(u.ips)) u.ips = [];
      const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
      const hit = u.ips.find((e) => e && e.ip === ip);
      if (hit) {
        // Don't write to KV on every request: refresh "lastSeen" at most every 10 minutes.
        if (!force && Date.now() - new Date(hit.lastSeen || 0).getTime() < 10 * 60 * 1000) return false;
        hit.lastSeen = nowIso;
        hit.count = (hit.count || 1) + 1;
      } else {
        u.ips.unshift({ ip, firstSeen: nowIso, lastSeen: nowIso, count: 1 });
      }
      u.ips.sort((a, b) => String(b.lastSeen).localeCompare(String(a.lastSeen)));
      if (u.ips.length > 25) u.ips.length = 25;
      return true;
    }

    // Gate: runs before every route. Admin is never blocked. Script delivery (loaders / payloads / heartbeat)
    // and the bot-secret API are not part of the website, so they stay reachable.
    {
      const pth = url.pathname;
      const gateExempt =
        pth === "/auth/login" || pth === "/auth/callback" ||
        pth.startsWith("/files/") || pth.startsWith("/example.shield/protector/") || pth === "/api/get-payload" || pth === "/log-execution" ||
        pth === "/api/heartbeat" || pth === "/api/integrity-report" || pth.startsWith("/api/bot/");
      if (!gateExempt && !OWNER_IDS.has(userId)) {
        const ub = userId ? await getUserBan(userId) : null;
        if (ub) return respondBanned(ub, "user");
        const ib = await getIpBan(clientIp);
        if (ib) return respondBanned(ib, "ip");
      }
    }

    try {
      // ==========================================
      // 1. AUTH
      // ==========================================
      if (url.pathname === "/auth/login") {
        // The state cookie only reaches the callback if login starts on the same host Discord returns to,
        // so bounce any other address (e.g. *.workers.dev) to the canonical site first.
        let siteHost = ""; try { siteHost = new URL(SITE_URL).host; } catch (_) {}
        if (siteHost && url.host !== siteHost && !/^(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)(:|$)/.test(url.host)) {
          return Response.redirect(`${SITE_URL}/auth/login${url.search}`, 302);
        }
        // "r" = this is already a retry (the callback won't auto-retry again, so a broken cookie setup can't loop).
        const state = (url.searchParams.get("r") === "1" ? "r" : "n") + randHex(24);
        const discordAuthUrl = `https://discord.com/api/oauth2/authorize?client_id=${env.DISCORD_CLIENT_ID}&redirect_uri=${encodeURIComponent(env.DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI)}&response_type=code&scope=identify&state=${state}`;
        const loginHeaders = new Headers({
          "Location": discordAuthUrl,
          "Cache-Control": "no-store",
        });
        // One cookie per attempt, so a second tab / double click no longer overwrites the first attempt's state.
        loginHeaders.append("Set-Cookie", `oauthstate_${state.slice(1, 13)}=${state}; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=600`);
        // Only a fixed whitelist is allowed as a return target (no open redirect).
        if (url.searchParams.get("next") === "tickets") loginHeaders.append("Set-Cookie", `loginnext=tickets; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=900`);
        return new Response(null, { status: 302, headers: loginHeaders });
      }

      // "Add bot" button on the Discord Bot page. Sends the (already logged-in) user through
      // Discord's bot-invite screen. Discord redirects back to the normal /auth/callback with
      // `guild_id`, which we verify and then link to the account automatically.
      if (url.pathname === "/auth/bot-add") {
        if (!userId) return Response.redirect(`${url.origin}/auth/login`, 302);
        const st = randHex(16);
        // Persist state in KV so OAuth still works if the botstate cookie is dropped (Safari / cross-site).
        try {
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(
            `botaddstate_${st}`,
            JSON.stringify({ userId: String(userId), at: Date.now() }),
            { expirationTtl: 900 }
          );
        } catch (_) {}
        const botAuthUrl = `https://discord.com/api/oauth2/authorize?client_id=${env.DISCORD_CLIENT_ID}`
          + `&redirect_uri=${encodeURIComponent(env.DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI)}`
          + `&response_type=code&scope=${encodeURIComponent("bot identify guilds")}`
          + `&permissions=${BOT_INVITE_PERMISSIONS}&state=botadd_${st}`;
        return new Response(null, {
          status: 302,
          headers: {
            "Location": botAuthUrl,
            "Set-Cookie": `botstate=${st}; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=900`,
          },
        });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/auth/callback" && (url.searchParams.get("state") || "").startsWith("botadd_")) {
        const back = (q) => new Response(null, {
          status: 302,
          headers: {
            "Location": `/discordbot?botadd=${q}`,
            "Set-Cookie": "botstate=; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=0",
          },
        });
        const stateVal = (url.searchParams.get("state") || "").slice("botadd_".length);
        if (!userId) return back("login");

        // Accept cookie OR KV state (cookie alone is unreliable after Discord redirect).
        let stateOk = !!(stateVal && stateVal === getCookie("botstate"));
        if (!stateOk && stateVal) {
          try {
            const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`botaddstate_${stateVal}`);
            if (raw) {
              const rec = JSON.parse(raw);
              if (rec && String(rec.userId) === String(userId)) stateOk = true;
            }
          } catch (_) {}
        }
        if (stateVal) {
          try { await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`botaddstate_${stateVal}`); } catch (_) {}
        }
        if (!stateVal || !stateOk) return back("state");

        const discErr = url.searchParams.get("error");
        if (discErr) {
          if (discErr === "access_denied") return back("cancelled");
          return back("failed");
        }
        const code = url.searchParams.get("code");
        if (!code) return back("nocode");

        const tokenResponse = await fetch("https://discord.com/api/oauth2/token", {
          method: "POST",
          body: new URLSearchParams({
            client_id: env.DISCORD_CLIENT_ID,
            client_secret: env.DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET,
            grant_type: "authorization_code",
            code,
            redirect_uri: env.DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI,
          }),
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
        });
        const tokenData = await tokenResponse.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (!tokenData.access_token) return back("failed");

        const auth = { Authorization: `Bearer ${tokenData.access_token}` };
        const [meRes, guildsRes] = await Promise.all([
          fetch("https://discord.com/api/users/@me", { headers: auth }),
          fetch("https://discord.com/api/users/@me/guilds", { headers: auth }),
        ]);
        const me = await meRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
        const myGuilds = await guildsRes.json().catch(() => []);
        // The person completing the invite must be the person logged in here.
        if (!me.id || me.id !== userId) return back("mismatch");

        const guildId = String(url.searchParams.get("guild_id") || tokenData.guild?.id || "");
        if (!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(guildId)) return back("failed");
        // ...and must actually be allowed to manage that server (owner / Administrator / Manage Server).
        const entry = Array.isArray(myGuilds) ? myGuilds.find(g => g.id === guildId) : null;
        let canManage = false;
        if (entry) {
          try { const p = BigInt(entry.permissions || "0"); canManage = !!entry.owner || (p & 0x8n) !== 0n || (p & 0x20n) !== 0n; } catch (_) {}
        }
        if (!canManage && !OWNER_IDS.has(userId)) return back("noperm");

        // Make sure the bot this site controls (DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN) is really in that server. If the invite added a
        // different application's bot, linking would only create a card that says "Bot was removed".
        if (env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN) {
          let check = await discordApi(`/guilds/${guildId}`);
          if (!check.ok && check.status !== 404 && check.status !== 403) { // temporary hiccup: one more try
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700)); check = await discordApi(`/guilds/${guildId}`);
          }
          if (!check.ok && (check.status === 404 || check.status === 403)) {
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); check = await discordApi(`/guilds/${guildId}`); // Discord can lag a second after the invite
            if (!check.ok && (check.status === 404 || check.status === 403)) return back(botAppMismatch() ? "wrongbot" : "notfound");
          }
        }
        await linkGuildToOwner(guildId, userId);
        return back(`ok&guild=${guildId}`);
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/auth/callback") {
        const oauthState = url.searchParams.get("state") || "";
        const stateKey = /^[rn][0-9a-f]{48}$/.test(oauthState) ? oauthState.slice(1, 13) : "";
        const savedOAuthState = (stateKey && getCookie(`oauthstate_${stateKey}`)) || getCookie("oauthstate") || "";
        const clearStateCookies = [
          "oauthstate=; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=0",
          ...(stateKey ? [`oauthstate_${stateKey}=; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=0`] : []),
        ];
        if (!oauthState || !savedOAuthState || oauthState !== savedOAuthState) {
          const h = new Headers({ "Cache-Control": "no-store" });
          for (const c of clearStateCookies) h.append("Set-Cookie", c);
          // First failure (stale tab, reloaded callback URL, overlapping logins): quietly start a fresh sign-in once.
          if (!oauthState.startsWith("r")) {
            h.set("Location", "/auth/login?r=1");
            return new Response(null, { status: 302, headers: h });
          }
          // Second failure in a row: cookies really are not getting through, so explain instead of looping.
          h.set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8");
          return new Response(`<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Sign-in failed - Luavify</title><style>body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#050508;color:#f4f4f5;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;padding:20px}.c{max-width:460px;width:100%;background:#0f1115;border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.35);border-radius:16px;padding:28px}h1{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:1.3rem}p,li{color:#a1a1aa;line-height:1.6;font-size:.95rem}a{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px;background:#ef4444;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:10px}</style></head><body><div class="c"><h1>Sign-in could not be completed</h1><p>Your browser did not keep the sign-in cookie. Please check:</p><ul><li>Cookies are allowed for this site (no blocker or private-mode restriction).</li><li>You start from <b>${SITE_URL.replace(/^https?:\/\//, "")}</b> and use a single tab.</li></ul><a href="/auth/login">Try again</a></div></body></html>`, { status: 403, headers: h });
        }
        const code = url.searchParams.get("code");
        if (!code) return new Response("No code provided", { status: 400 });

        // Define helpers BEFORE any early return that uses them (TDZ-safe).
        const authFail = (status, msg, detail) => {
          console.error("OAuth callback failed:", msg, detail || "");
          const h = new Headers({ "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store" });
          for (const c of clearStateCookies) h.append("Set-Cookie", c);
          return new Response(`<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Sign-in failed - Luavify</title><style>body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#050508;color:#f4f4f5;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;padding:20px}.c{max-width:460px;width:100%;background:#0f1115;border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.35);border-radius:16px;padding:28px}h1{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:1.3rem}p{color:#a1a1aa;line-height:1.6;font-size:.95rem}a{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px;background:#ef4444;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:10px}</style></head><body><div class="c"><h1>Sign-in failed</h1><p>${msg}</p><a href="/auth/login">Try again</a></div></body></html>`, { status, headers: h });
        };
        const readJson = async (res) => {
          const bodyText = await res.text();
          try { return { data: JSON.parse(bodyText), text: bodyText }; } catch (_) { return { data: null, text: bodyText }; }
        };

        const oauthRedirectUri = String(env.DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI || (SITE_URL + "/auth/callback")).replace(/\/$/, "");
        const oauthClientId = String(env.DISCORD_CLIENT_ID || "").trim();
        if (!oauthClientId) {
          return authFail(500, "Discord client ID is not configured on the server (DISCORD_CLIENT_ID).", "client_id missing");
        }
        if (!env.DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET) {
          return authFail(500, "The server is missing its Discord client secret (DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET).", "secret not set");
        }
        const tokenResponse = await fetch("https://discord.com/api/oauth2/token", {
          method: "POST",
          body: new URLSearchParams({
            client_id: oauthClientId,
            client_secret: String(env.DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET),
            grant_type: "authorization_code",
            code: code,
            redirect_uri: oauthRedirectUri,
          }),
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
        });
        const tokenParsed = await readJson(tokenResponse);
        const tokenData = tokenParsed.data;
        if (!tokenResponse.ok || !tokenData || tokenData.error || !tokenData.access_token) {
          return authFail(400, "Discord rejected the sign-in (the link may have expired or been used already). Please try again.",
            `token status=${tokenResponse.status} body=${tokenParsed.text.slice(0, 300)}`);
        }

        const userResponse = await fetch("https://discord.com/api/users/@me", {
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${tokenData.access_token}`, "User-Agent": "DiscordBot (https://luavify.dpdns.org, 1.0)" },
        });
        const userParsed = await readJson(userResponse);
        const user = userParsed.data;
        if (!userResponse.ok || !user || !/^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(user.id || ""))) {
          return authFail(502, "Could not read your Discord profile. Please try again in a moment.",
            `user status=${userResponse.status} body=${userParsed.text.slice(0, 300)}`);
        }

        const isAdmin = OWNER_IDS.has(user.id);
        if (!isAdmin) {
          const loginUserBan = await getUserBan(user.id);
          if (loginUserBan) {
            // Banned account: also remember the IP they tried from so the admin can see / ban it.
            const bu = await getUser(user.id);
            if (bu && recordUserIp(bu, clientIp, true)) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`user_${user.id}`, JSON.stringify(bu));
            return respondBannedPage(loginUserBan, "user");
          }
          const loginIpBan = await getIpBan(clientIp);
          if (loginIpBan) return respondBannedPage(loginIpBan, "ip");
        }
        let apiKey = "lua_" + Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16))).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");

        let existingPlan = "Basic";
        let sessionToken = randHex(32);
        let existingExpiry = null;
        let existingLockChoice;
        let existingExpiredAt;
        let existingIps;
        let existingRole;
        const existingUser = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`user_${user.id}`) || await authRecordGet(`user_${user.id}`);
        if (existingUser) {
            let parsed = {};
            try { parsed = JSON.parse(existingUser) || {}; } catch (_) { parsed = {}; }
            if (Array.isArray(parsed.ips)) existingIps = parsed.ips;
            if (parsed.role) existingRole = parsed.role;
            if (parsed.plan) existingPlan = parsed.plan;
            if (parsed.apiKey) apiKey = parsed.apiKey;
            if (parsed.premiumExpiry) existingExpiry = parsed.premiumExpiry;
            if (Array.isArray(parsed.lockChoice)) existingLockChoice = parsed.lockChoice;
            if (parsed.premiumExpiredAt) existingExpiredAt = parsed.premiumExpiredAt;
        }

        const userData = {
          id: user.id,
          username: user.username,
          avatar: user.avatar,
          apiKey,
          sessionToken,
          plan: isAdmin ? "Premium" : existingPlan,
          premiumExpiry: existingExpiry,
          joinedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          isAdmin,
        };
        if (existingLockChoice) userData.lockChoice = existingLockChoice;
        if (existingExpiredAt) userData.premiumExpiredAt = existingExpiredAt;
        if (existingIps) userData.ips = existingIps;
        if (existingRole) userData.role = existingRole;
        recordUserIp(userData, clientIp, true);
        // OAuth must remain available after the KV daily write quota is exhausted.
        // Durable Object is authoritative for newly-created login records; KV mirrors are best-effort.
        await authRecordPut(`user_${user.id}`, JSON.stringify(userData));
        await authRecordPut(`apikey_${apiKey}`, user.id);
        try { await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`user_${user.id}`, JSON.stringify(userData)); } catch (_) {}
        try { await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`apikey_${apiKey}`, user.id); } catch (_) {}

        const backToTickets = getCookie("loginnext") === "tickets";
        const okHeaders = new Headers({ "Location": backToTickets ? "/tickets" : "/", "Cache-Control": "no-store" });
        if (backToTickets) okHeaders.append("Set-Cookie", "loginnext=; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=0");
        okHeaders.append("Set-Cookie", `session=${user.id}.${sessionToken}; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=86400`);
        for (const c of clearStateCookies) okHeaders.append("Set-Cookie", c);
        return new Response(null, { status: 302, headers: okHeaders });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/auth/apikey" && request.method === "POST") {
        let body = {};
        try { body = await request.json(); } catch (e) {}
        const key = typeof body.apiKey === "string" ? body.apiKey.trim() : "";
        if (!/^lua_[0-9a-f]{32}$/.test(key)) return json({ error: "Invalid API key" }, 401);

        let ownerId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`apikey_${key}`) || await authRecordGet(`apikey_${key}`);
        let owner = null;
        if (ownerId) owner = await getUser(ownerId);
        if (!owner || owner.apiKey !== key) {
          ownerId = null; owner = null;
          let cursor;
          do {
            const page = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: "user_", cursor });
            for (const k of page.keys) {
              const s = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(k.name);
              if (!s) continue;
              let u; try { u = JSON.parse(s); } catch (e) { continue; }
              if (u && u.apiKey === key) { owner = u; ownerId = u.id || k.name.slice(5); break; }
            }
            cursor = (!owner && !page.list_complete) ? page.cursor : undefined;
          } while (cursor);
          if (!owner) return json({ error: "Invalid API key" }, 401);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`apikey_${key}`, ownerId);
        }

        if (!OWNER_IDS.has(ownerId)) {
          const keyUserBan = await getUserBan(ownerId);
          if (keyUserBan) {
            if (recordUserIp(owner, clientIp, true)) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`user_${ownerId}`, JSON.stringify(owner));
            return respondBanned(keyUserBan, "user");
          }
        }
        let ownerDirty = recordUserIp(owner, clientIp, true);
        if (!owner.sessionToken) {
          owner.sessionToken = randHex(16);
          ownerDirty = true;
        }
        if (ownerDirty) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`user_${ownerId}`, JSON.stringify(owner));
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true }), {
          status: 200,
          headers: {
            ...corsHeaders,
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Set-Cookie": `session=${ownerId}.${owner.sessionToken}; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=86400`,
          },
        });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/auth/logout") {
        return new Response(null, {
          status: 302,
          headers: { "Location": "/", "Set-Cookie": `session=; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=0` },
        });
      }

      // ==========================================
      // 2. USER API
      // ==========================================
      if (url.pathname === "/api/apikey/reset" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const rs = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`user_${userId}`);
        if (!rs) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const ru = JSON.parse(rs);
        const oldKey = ru.apiKey;
        const newKey = "lua_" + randHex(16);
        const newToken = randHex(16);
        ru.apiKey = newKey;
        ru.sessionToken = newToken;
        ru.apiKeyResetAt = new Date().toISOString();
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`user_${userId}`, JSON.stringify(ru));
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`apikey_${newKey}`, userId);
        if (oldKey) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`apikey_${oldKey}`);
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, apiKey: newKey }), {
          status: 200,
          headers: {
            ...corsHeaders,
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Set-Cookie": `session=${userId}.${newToken}; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=86400`,
          },
        });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/api/me") {
        if (!userId) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ loggedIn: false }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

        const userDataStr = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`user_${userId}`);
        if (!userDataStr) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ loggedIn: false }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

        const user = JSON.parse(userDataStr);
        if (user.apiKey && !(await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`apikey_${user.apiKey}`))) {
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`apikey_${user.apiKey}`, userId);
        }
        if (user.premiumExpiry && user.premiumExpiry !== "lifetime" && new Date(user.premiumExpiry) < new Date()) {
            user.premiumExpiredAt = user.premiumExpiry;
            user.plan = "Basic";
            user.premiumExpiry = null;
            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`user_${userId}`, JSON.stringify(user));
        }
        if (recordUserIp(user, clientIp, false)) {
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`user_${userId}`, JSON.stringify(user));
        }
        delete user.ips;
        user.totalExecutions = await getTotalExecutions(userId);
        user.monthlyObfuscations = await getMonthlyObfuscations(userId);
        user.projectCount = await getProjectCount(userId);
        user.limits = limitsForPlan(user.plan);
        user.role = OWNER_IDS.has(userId) ? "owner" : (user.role === "staff" ? "staff" : "user");
        const meDoc = await getProjectsDoc(userId);
        const meLocks = computeLocks(user, meDoc);
        user.lock = {
          required: meLocks.required,
          lockedIds: meLocks.lockedIds,
          pending: meLocks.pending,
          chosen: meLocks.chosen,
          keep: PLAN_LIMITS.Basic.projects,
          expired: !!user.premiumExpiredAt,
        };

        delete user.sessionToken;
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ loggedIn: true, user }), {
          headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        });
      }

      // ==========================================
      // 3. PROJECT COUNTERS
      // ==========================================
      if (url.pathname === "/api/project/increment" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return new Response("Unauthorized", { status: 401, headers: corsHeaders });
        const cur = await getProjectCount(userId);
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`projects_user_${userId}`, String(cur + 1));
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, count: cur + 1 }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }
      if (url.pathname === "/api/project/decrement" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return new Response("Unauthorized", { status: 401, headers: corsHeaders });
        const cur = await getProjectCount(userId);
        const next = Math.max(0, cur - 1);
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`projects_user_${userId}`, String(next));
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, count: next }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }

      // ==========================================
      // 3b. PROJECTS (server-side source of truth) + LOCK CHOICE
      // ==========================================
      const lockPayload = (user, locks) => ({
        required: locks.required,
        lockedIds: locks.lockedIds,
        pending: locks.pending,
        chosen: locks.chosen,
        keep: PLAN_LIMITS.Basic.projects,
        expired: !!(user && user.premiumExpiredAt),
      });

      if (url.pathname === "/api/projects" && request.method === "GET") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const { user, doc, locks } = await lockInfoForUser(userId);
        if (!user) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        return json({
          exists: !!doc,
          projects: doc ? doc.projects : [],
          projectIdCounter: doc ? doc.projectIdCounter : 1,
          lock: lockPayload(user, locks),
        });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/api/projects" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        let body;
        try { body = await request.json(); } catch (_) { return json({ error: "Bad request" }, 400); }
        const { user, doc: stored, locks } = await lockInfoForUser(userId);
        if (!user) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);

        const isAdminUser = OWNER_IDS.has(userId);
        const limits = limitsForPlan(effectivePlan(user));
        const storedProjects = stored ? stored.projects : [];
        const storedById = new Map(storedProjects.map((p) => [p.id, p]));
        const lockedSet = new Set(locks.lockedIds);

        const lockedHashes = new Set();
        for (const p of storedProjects) {
          if (lockedSet.has(p.id)) for (const sc of p.scripts || []) lockedHashes.add(sc.hash);
        }

        if (!Array.isArray(body.projects) || body.projects.length > 50) return json({ error: "Invalid projects" }, 400);

        const incomingById = new Map();
        const incomingOrder = [];
        const seenHashes = new Set(lockedHashes);
        for (const raw of body.projects) {
          const id = Number(raw && raw.id);
          if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0 || incomingById.has(id)) return json({ error: "Invalid project id" }, 400);
          if (lockedSet.has(id)) { incomingById.set(id, null); continue; }
          const scriptsRaw = Array.isArray(raw.scripts) ? raw.scripts : [];
          if (scriptsRaw.length > 20) return json({ error: "Too many scripts" }, 400);
          const scripts = [];
          for (const sc of scriptsRaw) {
            const hash = String((sc && sc.hash) || "").toLowerCase();
            if (!HASH_RE.test(hash) || seenHashes.has(hash)) continue;
            seenHashes.add(hash);
            scripts.push({
              id: Number(sc.id) || Date.now(),
              name: cleanName(sc.name, "script.lua"),
              hash,
              active: sc.active !== false,
              // Preserve per-script access policy while keeping legacy records compatible.
              keyless: sc.keyless === true,
              accessMode: ["public", "shared_key", "buyer_key"].includes(sc.accessMode)
                ? sc.accessMode : (sc.keyless === true ? "public" : "buyer_key"),
              sharedKeyHash: typeof sc.sharedKeyHash === "string" && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(sc.sharedKeyHash)
                ? sc.sharedKeyHash.toLowerCase() : null,
            });
          }
          const hashOk = HASH_RE.test(String(raw.hash || ""));
          const proj = {
            id,
            name: cleanName(raw.name, "Project"),
            hash: hashOk ? String(raw.hash).toLowerCase() : Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16))).map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join(""),
            scripts,
          };
          incomingById.set(id, proj);
          incomingOrder.push(id);
        }

        const delProjects = new Set((Array.isArray(body.deletedProjectIds) ? body.deletedProjectIds : []).map(Number).filter((n) => Number.isInteger(n)).slice(0, 50));
        const delScripts = new Set((Array.isArray(body.deletedScriptHashes) ? body.deletedScriptHashes : []).map((h) => String(h).toLowerCase()).filter((h) => HASH_RE.test(h) && !lockedHashes.has(h)).slice(0, 50));

        const finalProjects = [];
        const toWipe = [];
        for (const p of storedProjects) {
          if (lockedSet.has(p.id)) { finalProjects.push(p); continue; }
          if (delProjects.has(p.id)) { for (const sc of p.scripts || []) toWipe.push(sc.hash); continue; }
          const inc = incomingById.get(p.id);
          if (!inc) { finalProjects.push({ ...p, scripts: (p.scripts || []).filter((sc) => !delScripts.has(sc.hash)) }); continue; }
          const have = new Set(inc.scripts.map((sc) => sc.hash));
          const carried = (p.scripts || []).filter((sc) => !have.has(sc.hash) && !delScripts.has(sc.hash) && !seenHashes.has(sc.hash));
          finalProjects.push({ ...inc, scripts: inc.scripts.filter((sc) => !delScripts.has(sc.hash)).concat(carried) });
        }
        for (const id of incomingOrder) {
          if (storedById.has(id)) continue;
          const inc = incomingById.get(id);
          finalProjects.push({ ...inc, scripts: inc.scripts.filter((sc) => !delScripts.has(sc.hash)) });
        }
        for (const h of delScripts) toWipe.push(h);

        if (stored && !isAdminUser) {
          const storedUnlocked = storedProjects.filter((p) => !lockedSet.has(p.id)).length;
          const finalUnlocked = finalProjects.filter((p) => !lockedSet.has(p.id)).length;
          if (finalUnlocked > Math.max(limits.projects, storedUnlocked)) {
            return json({ error: `Project limit reached (${limits.projects} max).`, limit: true }, 400);
          }
          for (const p of finalProjects) {
            if (lockedSet.has(p.id)) continue;
            const prevCount = storedById.has(p.id) ? (storedById.get(p.id).scripts || []).length : 0;
            if ((p.scripts || []).length > Math.max(limits.scriptsPerProject, prevCount)) {
              return json({ error: `Maximum ${limits.scriptsPerProject} scripts per project.`, limit: true }, 400);
            }
          }
        }

        for (const hash of toWipe.slice(0, 40)) {
          const owner = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`script_owner_${hash}`);
          if (owner === userId) await wipeScript(hash);
        }

        const maxId = finalProjects.reduce((m, p) => Math.max(m, p.id), 0);
        const counter = Math.max(Number(body.projectIdCounter) || 1, maxId + 1, stored ? stored.projectIdCounter || 1 : 1);
        const newDoc = { projects: finalProjects, projectIdCounter: counter };
        await putProjectsDoc(userId, newDoc);

        return json({ success: true, projects: finalProjects, projectIdCounter: counter, lock: lockPayload(user, computeLocks(user, newDoc)) });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/api/projects/lock-choice" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        let body;
        try { body = await request.json(); } catch (_) { return json({ error: "Bad request" }, 400); }
        const { user, doc, locks } = await lockInfoForUser(userId);
        if (!user || !doc) return json({ error: "Nothing to lock." }, 400);
        if (locks.required === 0) return json({ error: "No projects need to be locked." }, 400);
        if (locks.chosen) return json({ error: "You already chose your locked projects. Rebuy Premium on Discord to unlock them." }, 403);

        const ids = Array.isArray(body.lockIds) ? body.lockIds.map(Number) : [];
        const existing = new Set(doc.projects.map((p) => p.id));
        const unique = new Set(ids);
        if (unique.size !== ids.length || ids.some((id) => !existing.has(id))) return json({ error: "Invalid selection." }, 400);
        if (ids.length !== locks.required) return json({ error: `Choose exactly ${locks.required} project${locks.required === 1 ? "" : "s"} to lock.` }, 400);

        user.lockChoice = ids;
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`user_${userId}`, JSON.stringify(user));
        return json({ success: true, lock: lockPayload(user, computeLocks(user, doc)) });
      }

      // ==========================================
      // 4. OBFUSCATE / UPLOAD / EDIT / TOGGLE / DELETE
      // ==========================================
      if (url.pathname === "/obfuscate" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        let body;
        try { body = await request.json(); } catch (_) { return json({ error: "Invalid JSON" }, 400); }
        const code = body && body.code;
        if (typeof code !== "string" || !code.trim()) return json({ error: "code must be a non-empty string" }, 400);
        if (new TextEncoder().encode(code).length > MAX_SOURCE_BYTES) return json({ error: "Source too large" }, 400);
        try {
          // Keep the limit lookup inside this try block. KV/JSON failures here
          // must be logged as an obfuscation error instead of becoming a generic 500.
          if (await monthlyLimitReached(userId)) {
            return json({ error: "Monthly obfuscation limit reached." }, 429);
          }

          const built = await runProtectionPipeline(code);
          const key = `obfs_user_${userId}_${currentMonthKey()}`;
          const cur = parseInt((await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(key)) || "0", 10);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(key, String((Number.isFinite(cur) ? cur : 0) + 1));

          return json({
            obfuscated: built.finalCode,
            pipelineVersion: built.pipelineVersion,
            superflowVersion: built.superflowVersion,
            pipelineStages: built.pipelineStages,
            contentHash: built.contentHash,
            buildId: built.buildId,
          });
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("[Luavify] /obfuscate failed:", e && e.stack ? e.stack : e);
          await audit(env, "pipeline_obfuscate_fail", {
            error: String(e && e.message ? e.message : e),
            voltfuscatorStatus: e && e.voltfuscatorStatus,
            voltfuscatorRawBody: e && e.voltfuscatorRawBody,
            ip: clientIp
          });
          return json({
            error: e && e.message ? e.message : "Protection pipeline failed"
          }, 502);
        }
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/upload" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return new Response("Unauthorized", { status: 401, headers: corsHeaders });
        let body;
        try { body = await request.json(); } catch (_) { return json({ error: "Invalid JSON" }, 400); }
        const originalCode = body && body.originalCode;
        const scriptName = cleanName(body && body.scriptName, "script.lua");
        if (typeof originalCode !== "string" || !originalCode.trim()) {
          return json({ error: "originalCode must be a non-empty string" }, 400);
        }
        // Size limit depends on engine (decided below). Peek engine early for the check.
        const _enginePeek = String(body.engine || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        const _isFiction = _enginePeek === "fiction" || _enginePeek === "fictionfuscate";
        // FictionFuscate: up to ~2048 KB input ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ã‚Â¢ ~3.3x output. Allow 8 MB payload.
        // Voltfuscator / none: 1 MB MAX_SOURCE_BYTES.
        const _maxUpload = _isFiction ? (8 * 1024 * 1024) : MAX_SOURCE_BYTES;
        const _codeBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(originalCode).length;
        if (_codeBytes > _maxUpload) {
          return json({
            error: _isFiction
              ? `Source too large (${Math.round(_codeBytes / 1024)} KB). FictionFuscate max is 2048 KB in / ~8 MB protected out.`
              : `Source too large (${Math.round(_codeBytes / 1024)} KB). Max for Voltfuscator is ${Math.round(MAX_SOURCE_BYTES / 1024)} KB.`
          }, 400);
        }
        const pid = Number(body.projectId);
        if (!Number.isInteger(pid)) return json({ error: "Missing project. Reload the page and try again." }, 400);
        const { user: upUser, doc: upDoc, locks: upLocks } = await lockInfoForUser(userId);
        const upProject = upDoc && upDoc.projects.find((p) => p.id === pid);
        if (!upProject) return json({ error: "Project not found. Reload the page and try again." }, 404);
        if (upLocks.lockedIds.includes(pid)) return json({ error: "This project is locked. Rebuy Premium on Discord to unlock it.", locked: true }, 403);
        if (!OWNER_IDS.has(userId)) {
          const maxScripts = limitsForPlan(effectivePlan(upUser)).scriptsPerProject;
          if ((upProject.scripts || []).length >= maxScripts) return json({ error: `Maximum ${maxScripts} scripts per project.` }, 403);
        }

        // Default true for backward compatibility; client can send obfuscate: false for raw upload
        // engine: "voltfuscator" | "fiction" | "none"  (legacy: obfuscate true/false)
        const engineRaw = String(body.engine || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        let engine;
        if (engineRaw === "fiction" || engineRaw === "fictionfuscate") engine = "fiction";
        else if (engineRaw === "none" || engineRaw === "raw") engine = "none";
        else if (engineRaw === "voltfuscator" || engineRaw === "volt") engine = "voltfuscator";
        else {
          // backward compatible
          const legacyObf = body.obfuscate !== false && body.obfuscate !== 0 && body.obfuscate !== "0" && body.obfuscate !== "false";
          engine = legacyObf ? "voltfuscator" : "none";
        }
        const doObfuscate = engine === "voltfuscator" || engine === "fiction";

        if (!OWNER_IDS.has(userId) && doObfuscate) {
          if (await monthlyLimitReached(userId)) return json({ error: "Monthly obfuscation limit reached." }, 429);
        }

        let built;
        if (engine === "voltfuscator") {
          try {
            built = await runProtectionPipeline(originalCode);
          } catch (e) {
            await audit(env, "pipeline_upload_fail", {
              error: String(e.message || e),
              voltfuscatorStatus: e && e.voltfuscatorStatus,
              voltfuscatorRawBody: e && e.voltfuscatorRawBody,
              ip: clientIp
            });
            const msg = String(e && e.message ? e.message : e || "Protection pipeline failed");
            // Avoid generic "Obfuscation failed" without context
            const nice = /obfuscation failed/i.test(msg)
              ? (msg + " Ã¢â‚¬â€ check script is valid Luau, under 1 MB, and VOLTILS_API_KEY is valid")
              : msg;
            return json({
              error: nice,
              voltfuscatorStatus: e && e.voltfuscatorStatus || null,
            }, 502);
          }
        } else if (engine === "fiction") {
          // Client already ran FictionFuscate; store protected payload + metadata
          if (typeof originalCode !== "string" || !originalCode.trim()) {
            return json({ error: "FictionFuscate output missing" }, 400);
          }
          const contentHash = await sha256HexStr(originalCode);
          built = {
            finalCode: originalCode,
            contentHash,
            pipelineVersion: "5.4.0-fictionfuscate",
            superflowVersion: null,
            buildId: randHex(8),
            pipelineStages: ["fictionfuscate-client", "protected-output-only", "final-content-hash"],
          };
        } else {
          const contentHash = await sha256HexStr(originalCode);
          built = {
            finalCode: originalCode,
            contentHash,
            pipelineVersion: "none-raw-1.0",
            superflowVersion: null,
            buildId: randHex(8),
            pipelineStages: ["none-obfuscate", "raw-upload"],
          };
        }

        const hash = Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16))).map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");

        // When obfuscating: store protected output only (no original). When none: store raw source as the payload.
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(hash, built.finalCode);
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`script_owner_${hash}`, userId);
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`meta_${hash}`, JSON.stringify({
          contentHash: built.contentHash,
          pipelineVersion: built.pipelineVersion,
          superflowVersion: built.superflowVersion,
          pipelineStages: built.pipelineStages,
          buildId: built.buildId,
          obfuscated: doObfuscate,
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        }));

        const scriptId = Date.now();
        upProject.scripts = Array.isArray(upProject.scripts) ? upProject.scripts : [];
        const keyless = body.keyless === true;
        const accessMode = keyless ? "public" : "buyer_key";
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`keyless_${hash}`, keyless ? "true" : "false");
        upProject.scripts.push({ id: scriptId, name: scriptName, hash, active: true, keyless, accessMode, sharedKeyHash: null, obfuscated: doObfuscate });
        await putProjectsDoc(userId, upDoc);

        if (doObfuscate) {
          const key = `obfs_user_${userId}_${currentMonthKey()}`;
          const cur = parseInt((await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(key)) || "0");
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(key, String(cur + 1));
        }

        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ hash, scriptId, scriptName, contentHash: built.contentHash, pipelineVersion: built.pipelineVersion, superflowVersion: built.superflowVersion, pipelineStages: built.pipelineStages, obfuscated: doObfuscate }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
      }

      if (url.pathname.startsWith("/get-original/")) {
        // SECURITY: Original source is never stored or served.
        // This prevents session theft / KV leaks / hook-based extraction of plaintext.
        await audit(env, "get_original_disabled", { ip: clientIp });
        return new Response("Original source is not stored on the server for security.", {
          status: 404,
          headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff" }
        });
      }

      if (url.pathname.startsWith("/get-obfuscated/")) {
        // Owner-only download of protected payload. Still not the original source.
        // Prefer using the public loader + payload API; this endpoint is for dashboard convenience only.
        const hash = url.pathname.split("/").pop();
        const denied = await requireScriptAccess(hash);
        if (denied) return denied;
        const ok = await rateLimit(clientIp, "getobf", 20, 60);
        if (!ok) return new Response("Too many requests", { status: 429, headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff" } });
        const [obf, metaRaw] = await Promise.all([
          env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(hash),
          env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`meta_${hash}`),
        ]);
        if (!obf) return new Response("Not found", { status: 404, headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff" } });
        let buildMeta = null;
        try { buildMeta = metaRaw ? JSON.parse(metaRaw) : null; } catch (_) {}
        if (!hasVoltfuscatorProtectionMetadata(buildMeta)) {
          await audit(env, "get_obfuscated_unprotected_build_denied", { hash, ip: clientIp, userId });
          return new Response("This script must be re-obfuscated with the current protection pipeline.", { status: 409, headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff" } });
        }
        await audit(env, "get_obfuscated_served", { hash, ip: clientIp, userId });
        return new Response(obf, {
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "text/plain",
            "Cache-Control": "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, private",
            "Content-Security-Policy": "default-src 'none'",
            "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff",
            "X-Robots-Tag": "noindex, nofollow"
          }
        });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/edit-script" && request.method === "POST") {
        let body;
        try { body = await request.json(); } catch (_) { return json({ error: "Invalid JSON" }, 400); }
        const hash = body && body.hash;
        const originalCode = body && body.originalCode;
        const denied = await requireScriptAccess(hash);
        if (denied) return denied;
        if (typeof originalCode !== "string" || !originalCode.trim()) {
          return json({ error: "originalCode must be a non-empty string" }, 400);
        }
        if (new TextEncoder().encode(originalCode).length > MAX_SOURCE_BYTES) {
          return json({ error: "Source too large" }, 400);
        }
        if (await monthlyLimitReached(userId)) {
          return json({ error: "Monthly obfuscation limit reached." }, 429);
        }

        let built;
        try {
          built = await runProtectionPipeline(originalCode);
        } catch (e) {
          await audit(env, "pipeline_edit_fail", {
            error: String(e.message || e),
            voltfuscatorStatus: e && e.voltfuscatorStatus,
            voltfuscatorRawBody: e && e.voltfuscatorRawBody,
            hash, ip: clientIp
          });
          return json({ error: e.message || "Protection pipeline failed" }, 502);
        }

        // SECURITY: original source is NOT stored on server to prevent leaks / hooks
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(hash, built.finalCode);
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`meta_${hash}`, JSON.stringify({
          contentHash: built.contentHash,
          pipelineVersion: built.pipelineVersion,
          superflowVersion: built.superflowVersion,
          pipelineStages: built.pipelineStages,
          buildId: built.buildId,
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        }));

        const key = `obfs_user_${userId}_${currentMonthKey()}`;
        const cur = parseInt((await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(key)) || "0");
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(key, String(cur + 1));

        return json({ success: true, contentHash: built.contentHash, pipelineVersion: built.pipelineVersion, superflowVersion: built.superflowVersion, pipelineStages: built.pipelineStages });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/toggle" && request.method === "POST") {
        const body = await request.json().catch(() => null);
        if (!body) return json({ error: "Invalid JSON" }, 400);
        const { hash, active } = body;
        const denied = await requireScriptAccess(hash);
        if (denied) return denied;
        if (active) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`disabled_${hash}`);
        else await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`disabled_${hash}`, "true");
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }

      // Creator-managed per-script access policy. POST {hash, mode, sharedKey?}
      if (url.pathname === "/api/script-access" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const body = await request.json().catch(() => null);
        if (!body) return json({ error: "Invalid JSON" }, 400);
        const hash = String(body.hash || "").toLowerCase();
        const mode = String(body.mode || "");
        if (!HASH_RE.test(hash) || !["public", "shared_key", "buyer_key"].includes(mode)) return json({ error: "Invalid script access settings" }, 400);
        const denied = await requireScriptAccess(hash);
        if (denied) return denied;
        const ownerId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`script_owner_${hash}`);
        if (!ownerId) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);
        const doc = await getProjectsDoc(ownerId);
        if (!doc || !Array.isArray(doc.projects)) return json({ error: "Project record not found" }, 404);
        const project = doc.projects.find((p) => (p.scripts || []).some((x) => x.hash === hash));
        const script = project && (project.scripts || []).find((x) => x.hash === hash);
        if (!script) return json({ error: "Script record not found" }, 404);
        let sharedKeyHash = null;
        if (mode === "shared_key") {
          const sharedKey = typeof body.sharedKey === "string" ? body.sharedKey.trim() : "";
          if (sharedKey.length < 12 || sharedKey.length > 512) return json({ error: "Shared key must be between 12 and 512 characters" }, 400);
          sharedKeyHash = await sha256HexStr("luavify-shared-script-key-v1|" + hash + "|" + sharedKey);
        }
        script.accessMode = mode;
        script.keyless = mode === "public";
        script.sharedKeyHash = sharedKeyHash;
        await putProjectsDoc(ownerId, doc);
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`keyless_${hash}`, mode === "public" ? "true" : "false");
        await audit(env, "script_access_policy_changed", { hash, ownerId, mode, actor: userId });
        return json({ success: true, hash, mode });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/toggle-keyless" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const body = await request.json().catch(() => null);
        if (!body || typeof body.keyless !== "boolean") return json({ error: "Invalid access mode" }, 400);
        const hash = String(body.hash || "").toLowerCase();
        const denied = await requireScriptAccess(hash);
        if (denied) return denied;
        const ownerId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`script_owner_${hash}`);
        if (!ownerId) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);
        const doc = await getProjectsDoc(ownerId);
        if (!doc || !Array.isArray(doc.projects)) return json({ error: "Project record not found" }, 404);
        const project = doc.projects.find((p) => (p.scripts || []).some((s) => s.hash === hash));
        const script = project && (project.scripts || []).find((s) => s.hash === hash);
        if (!script) return json({ error: "Script record not found" }, 404);
        script.keyless = body.keyless;
        script.accessMode = body.keyless ? "public" : "buyer_key";
        script.sharedKeyHash = null;
        await putProjectsDoc(ownerId, doc);
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`keyless_${hash}`, body.keyless ? "true" : "false");
        await audit(env, "script_access_mode_changed", { hash, ownerId, keyless: body.keyless, actor: userId });
        return json({ success: true, keyless: body.keyless });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/delete-script" && request.method === "POST") {
        const body = await request.json().catch(() => null);
        if (!body) return json({ error: "Invalid JSON" }, 400);
        const { hash } = body;
        const denied = await requireScriptAccess(hash);
        if (denied) return denied;
        await wipeScript(hash);
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/log-execution") {
        const hash = url.searchParams.get("hash") || "";
        const sid = url.searchParams.get("sid") || "";
        if (!HASH_RE.test(hash) || !SID_RE.test(sid)) return new Response("Bad request", { status: 400 });
        if (!(await rateLimit(clientIp, "logexec", 12, 60))) return new Response("Too many requests", { status: 429, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
        // Roblox-only identity fields: a real client always has a JobId (server
        // instances) or an empty one (Studio); PlaceId/GameId are always numeric
        // when present. These can't be produced by a bare HTTP client without
        // having actually been inside a live Roblox session at least once.
        const jobId = (url.searchParams.get("jobId") || "").slice(0, 64);
        const placeId = (url.searchParams.get("placeId") || "").slice(0, 32);
        const gameId = (url.searchParams.get("gameId") || "").slice(0, 32);
        const jobIdOk = jobId === "" || /^[0-9a-f-]{8,64}$/i.test(jobId);
        const placeIdOk = placeId === "" || /^[0-9]{1,20}$/.test(placeId);
        const gameIdOk = gameId === "" || /^[0-9]{1,20}$/.test(gameId);
        if (!jobIdOk || !placeIdOk || !gameIdOk) {
          await audit(env, "log_execution_suspicious_identity", { hash, ip: clientIp, jobId, placeId, gameId });
        }
        const ownerId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`script_owner_${hash}`);
        if (ownerId) {
          const cur = parseInt((await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`execs_user_${ownerId}`)) || "0");
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`execs_user_${ownerId}`, String(cur + 1));
          try {
            await bumpDailyExec(ownerId);
            await touchLive(ownerId, sid);
          } catch (_) {}
        }
        // sid is the delivery session's own sessionId (see /runtime/v1/init.lua).
        // If a matching session_delivery_ marker exists, this confirms that
        // specific delivery actually ran in Roblox, not just that someone
        // fetched it over HTTP.
        try {
          const pendingRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`session_delivery_${sid}`);
          if (pendingRaw) {
            const pending = JSON.parse(pendingRaw);
            if (pending && pending.hash === hash) {
              await audit(env, "execution_confirmed", {
                hash, deliveryId: pending.deliveryId, ip: clientIp,
                ipMatchesDelivery: pending.ip === clientIp, jobId, placeId, gameId
              });
            }
            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`session_delivery_${sid}`);
          }
        } catch (_) {}
        return new Response("ok", { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff" } });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/api/integrity-report") {
        const hash = url.searchParams.get("hash") || "";
        const reason = (url.searchParams.get("reason") || "").slice(0, 80);
        if (!HASH_RE.test(hash)) return new Response("bad request", { status: 400 });
        if (!(await rateLimit(clientIp, "integrity", 12, 60))) return new Response("slow down", { status: 429 });
        const ownerId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`script_owner_${hash}`);
        await audit(env, "integrity_check_failed", { hash, ownerId: ownerId || null, reason, ip: clientIp });
        return new Response("ok", { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff" } });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/api/heartbeat") {
        if (request.method !== "POST") return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405, headers: { "Allow": "POST", "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
        const raw = await request.text();
        if (!raw || raw.length > 8192) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 400);
        let body; try { body = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) { return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 400); }
        const hash = String(body.hash || "");
        const sid = String(body.sessionId || "");
        const token = String(body.token || "");
        if (!HASH_RE.test(hash) || !SID_RE.test(sid) || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(token)) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 400);
        try {
          if (!(await durableSessionRateLimit(clientIp, "heartbeat", 30, 60))) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 429);
          const stub = env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(`sessions-${sid.slice(0, 2)}`));
          const read = await stub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/session-read", {
            method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId: sid })
          });
          if (!read.ok) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 403);
          const data = await read.json();
          const session = data && data.session;
          if (!session || session.hash !== hash || session.ip !== (clientIp || "") || session.expiresAt <= Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 403);
          const message = Number(session.version) >= 56
            ? `luavify-v5.6.4|${hash}|${session.ownerId}|${session.projectId || ""}|${session.discordUserId || ""}|${session.keyDigest}|${sid}|${session.issuedAt}|${session.expiresAt}|${session.ip || ""}|${session.hwidHash || ""}|${session.placeId || ""}|${session.placeUserId || ""}|${session.placeVerified ? "1" : "0"}`
            : `luavify-v5.2|${hash}|${session.ownerId}|${session.projectId || ""}|${session.discordUserId || ""}|${session.keyDigest}|${sid}|${session.issuedAt}|${session.expiresAt}|${session.ip || ""}`;
          const expected = await hmacHex(message, AUTH_SECRET);
          if (!expected || !constantTimeEqual(expected, token)) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 403);
          const ownerId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`script_owner_${hash}`);
          if (ownerId) { try { await touchLive(ownerId, sid); } catch (_) {} }
          return json({ ok: true });
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Heartbeat validation failed:", String(error?.message || error).slice(0, 180));
          return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 503);
        }
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/api/stats" && request.method === "GET") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const allowedRanges = [7, 30, 90];
        const reqRange = parseInt(url.searchParams.get("range") || "30", 10);
        const range = allowedRanges.includes(reqRange) ? reqRange : 30;
        const days = [];
        const now = new Date();
        for (let i = range - 1; i >= 0; i--) days.push(dayStr(new Date(now.getTime() - i * 86400000)));
        const months = [...new Set(days.map((d) => d.slice(0, 7)))];
        const execDocs = {};
        for (const m of months) {
          execDocs[m] = await readStatsDoc("e", userId, m);
        }
        return json({
          range,
          days: days.map((d) => ({ date: d, executions: execDocs[d.slice(0, 7)][d] || 0 })),
        });
      }

      //
