â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬
      // Owner-managed security policy. The place-server secret is shown only when created/rotated.
      if (url.pathname === "/api/script-security" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const raw = await request.text();
        if (!raw || raw.length > 12000) return json({ error: "Invalid request" }, 400);
        let body; try { body = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) { return json({ error: "Invalid request" }, 400); }
        const hash = String(body.hash || "").toLowerCase();
        if (!HASH_RE.test(hash)) return json({ error: "Invalid request" }, 400);
        const denied = await requireScriptAccess(hash);
        if (denied) return denied;
        const ownerId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`script_owner_${hash}`);
        if (ownerId !== userId && !OWNER_IDS.has(userId)) return json({ error: "Not authorized" }, 403);
        const doc = await getProjectsDoc(ownerId);
        if (!doc || !Array.isArray(doc.projects)) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);
        const project = doc.projects.find((p) => (p.scripts || []).some((x) => x.hash === hash));
        const script = project && (project.scripts || []).find((x) => x.hash === hash);
        if (!script) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);
        const hwidRequired = body.hwidRequired === true;
        const requirePlaceTicket = body.requirePlaceTicket === true;
        const scriptAccessMode = ["public", "shared_key", "buyer_key"].includes(script.accessMode)
          ? script.accessMode : (script.keyless === true ? "public" : "buyer_key");
        // A single shared/public credential cannot safely identify an individual
        // installation. HWID locking is available only for per-buyer keys.
        if (hwidRequired && scriptAccessMode !== "buyer_key") {
          return json({ error: "HWID locking requires buyer-key access mode." }, 400);
        }
        const allowedPlaceIds = Array.isArray(body.allowedPlaceIds)
          ? [...new Set(body.allowedPlaceIds.map((v) => String(v)).filter((v) => /^\d{1,20}$/.test(v) && v !== "0"))].slice(0, 64)
          : [];
        if (requirePlaceTicket && !allowedPlaceIds.length) return json({ error: "Add at least one allowed PlaceId." }, 400);
        let newServerSecret = null;
        let current = {};
        try { current = JSON.parse((await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`security_${hash}`)) || "{}"); } catch (_) { current = {}; }
        let placeSecretEnc = current && current.placeSecretEnc || null;
        if (requirePlaceTicket && (!placeSecretEnc || body.rotatePlaceSecret === true)) {
          newServerSecret = randHex(32);
          placeSecretEnc = await sealServerSecret(newServerSecret);
        }
        const security = {
          version: 1,
          hwidRequired,
          requirePlaceTicket,
          allowedPlaceIds: requirePlaceTicket ? allowedPlaceIds : [],
          placeSecretEnc: requirePlaceTicket ? placeSecretEnc : null,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        };
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`security_${hash}`, JSON.stringify(security));
        await audit(env, "script_security_policy_updated", { hash, ownerId, hwidRequired, requirePlaceTicket, allowedPlaceCount: allowedPlaceIds.length, actor: userId });
        return json({ success: true, hash, hwidRequired, requirePlaceTicket, allowedPlaceIds: security.allowedPlaceIds,
          ...(newServerSecret ? { placeServerSecret: newServerSecret, warning: "Store this secret only in your Roblox server script. It will not be shown again." } : {}) });
      }

      // A game server mints short-lived, one-use tickets. The secret stays server-side.
      if (url.pathname === "/api/place-ticket") {
        if (request.method !== "POST") return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405, headers: { "Allow": "POST", "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
        const raw = await request.text();
        if (!raw || raw.length > 8192) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 400);
        let body; try { body = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) { return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 400); }
        const hash = String(body.hash || "").toLowerCase();
        const placeId = String(body.placeId || "");
        const targetUserId = String(body.userId || "");
        if (!HASH_RE.test(hash) || !/^\d{1,20}$/.test(placeId) || !/^\d{1,22}$/.test(targetUserId)) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 400);
        try {
          if (!(await durableSessionRateLimit(clientIp, "place_ticket_ip", 30, 60)) ||
              !(await durableScopedRateLimit("place-script", hash, 120, 60))) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 429);
          const meta = await getDeliveryScriptMetadata(hash);
          const security = meta && meta.ok && meta.security || {};
          if (!meta.ok || meta.disabled || meta.locked || security.requirePlaceTicket !== true ||
              !Array.isArray(security.allowedPlaceIds) || !security.allowedPlaceIds.includes(placeId)) {
            await audit(env, "place_ticket_denied", { hash, ip: clientIp, placeId });
            return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 403);
          }
          const expectedSecret = await openServerSecret(security.placeSecretEnc);
          const auth = request.headers.get("Authorization") || "";
          const suppliedSecret = auth.startsWith("Bearer ") ? auth.slice(7).trim() : "";
          if (!expectedSecret || !constantTimeEqual(expectedSecret, suppliedSecret)) {
            await audit(env, "place_ticket_auth_failed", { hash, ip: clientIp });
            return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 403);
          }
          const ticket = randHex(32);
          const ticketHash = await sha256HexStr(`luavify-place-ticket-v1|${ticket}`);
          const expiresAt = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 45;
          const stub = env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(`tickets-${hash.slice(0, 2)}`));
          const stored = await stub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/place-ticket-store", {
            method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ ticketHash, hash, placeId, userId: targetUserId, expiresAt })
          });
          if (stored.status !== 201) throw new Error(`Place ticket store failed (${stored.status})`);
          return json({ ok: true, ticket, expiresAt }, 200);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Place ticket issuance failed:", String(error?.message || error).slice(0, 180));
          return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 503);
        }
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/api/hwid/reset" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const body = await request.json().catch(() => null);
        const hash = String(body?.hash || "").toLowerCase();
        const scriptKey = typeof body?.scriptKey === "string" ? body.scriptKey : "";
        if (!HASH_RE.test(hash) || !scriptKey.trim()) return json({ error: "Invalid request" }, 400);
        const denied = await requireScriptAccess(hash);
        if (denied) return denied;
        const ownerId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`script_owner_${hash}`);
        if (ownerId !== userId && !OWNER_IDS.has(userId)) return json({ error: "Not authorized" }, 403);
        const meta = await getDeliveryScriptMetadata(hash);
        const access = await validateDeliveryKey(hash, scriptKey, meta);
        if (!access.ok || access.keyless) return json({ error: "Invalid key" }, 403);
        const bindingKey = await sha256HexStr(`luavify-hwid-binding-v1|${hash}|${access.digest}`);
        const stub = env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(`hwid-${hash.slice(0, 2)}`));
        const response = await stub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/hwid-reset", {
          method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ bindingKey })
        });
        if (!response.ok) return json({ error: "Reset failed" }, 503);
        await audit(env, "hwid_binding_reset", { hash, keyTag: access.digest.slice(0, 12), actor: userId });
        return json({ success: true });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/api/session/revoke" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const body = await request.json().catch(() => null);
        const sessionId = String(body?.sessionId || "");
        if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(sessionId)) return json({ error: "Invalid request" }, 400);
        const prefix = `sessions-${sessionId.slice(0, 2)}`;
        const stub = env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(prefix));
        const read = await stub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/session-read", {
          method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId })
        });
        if (!read.ok) return json({ success: true });
        const data = await read.json();
        const session = data && data.session;
        const ownerId = session && await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`script_owner_${session.hash}`);
        if (!session || (ownerId !== userId && !OWNER_IDS.has(userId))) return json({ error: "Not authorized" }, 403);
        const revoked = await stub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/session-revoke", {
          method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId })
        });
        if (!revoked.ok) return json({ error: "Revoke failed" }, 503);
        await audit(env, "delivery_session_revoked", { hash: session.hash, sessionId, actor: userId });
        return json({ success: true });
      }

      // Combined single-roundtrip endpoint: session + payload + blob in one call.
      // Client sends {hash, scriptKey}; receives {sessionId, token, deliveryKey,
      // deliveryId, blobBytes} ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â eliminates the previous 3 sequential HTTP calls
      // (/api/session ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ã‚Â¢ /api/get-payload ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ã‚Â¢ /api/delivery-blob) that caused 40-47s
      // load times on 20 KB scripts. Blob fetch is still a second call but it is
      // the only remaining call; delivery-blob now runs client-side after init.
      if (url.pathname === "/api/init") {
        if (request.method !== "POST") return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405, headers: { "Allow": "POST", "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
        let initStage = "configuration";
        try {
          if (!AUTH_SECRET || AUTH_SECRET.length < 32 || !env.NONCE_GUARD) {
            return json({ error: "Security configuration unavailable", stage: "configuration" }, 503);
          }
          initStage = "rate-limit";
          const [sessionAllowed, payloadAllowed] = await Promise.all([
            durableSessionRateLimit(clientIp, "delivery_session", 12, 60).catch(() => null),
            durableSessionRateLimit(clientIp, "getpayload", 12, 60).catch(() => null),
          ]);
          if (sessionAllowed === null || payloadAllowed === null) {
            return json({ error: "Security service temporarily unavailable", stage: initStage }, 503);
          }
          if (!sessionAllowed || !payloadAllowed) {
            await audit(env, "init_ratelimit", { ip: clientIp });
            return json({ error: "Too many requests" }, 429);
          }
          initStage = "request-validation";
          const contentLength = Number(request.headers.get("Content-Length") || 0);
          if (contentLength > 16384) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 413);
          const rawBody = await request.text();
          if (!rawBody || rawBody.length > 16384) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 400);
          let body; try { body = JSON.parse(rawBody); } catch (_) { return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 400); }
          const hash = String(body?.hash || "");
          if (!HASH_RE.test(hash)) return json({ error: "Invalid hash" }, 400);
          // Script-key and payload authorization checks remain active.
          // Parallel: metadata + code + meta in one shot.
          const [scriptMeta, code, metaRaw] = await Promise.all([
            getDeliveryScriptMetadata(hash),
            env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(hash),
            env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`meta_${hash}`),
          ]);
          if (!scriptMeta.ok) {
            await audit(env, "init_metadata_denied", { hash, ip: clientIp, reason: scriptMeta.reason });
            return json({ error: "Script metadata unavailable" }, 403);
          }
          if (scriptMeta.disabled || scriptMeta.locked) {
            await audit(env, "init_script_unavailable", { hash, ip: clientIp });
            return json({ error: "Script unavailable" }, 403);
          }
          if (!code) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);
          if (!metaRaw) return json({ error: "Payload metadata missing" }, 403);
          let meta;
          try { meta = JSON.parse(metaRaw); } catch (_) { return json({ error: "Payload metadata corrupt" }, 403); }
          if (!meta || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(String(meta.contentHash || ""))) return json({ error: "Payload metadata invalid" }, 403);
          if (!hasVoltfuscatorProtectionMetadata(meta)) {
            await audit(env, "init_unprotected_build_denied", { hash, ip: clientIp });
            return json({ error: "This script must be re-obfuscated with the current protection pipeline", stage: "protection-validation" }, 409);
          }

          initStage = "key-validation";
          const headerKey = request.headers.get("X-Luavify-Key") || "";
          const bodyKey = typeof body?.scriptKey === "string" ? body.scriptKey : "";
          const runtimeKey = headerKey.trim() ? headerKey : bodyKey;
          const access = await validateDeliveryKey(hash, runtimeKey, scriptMeta);
          if (!access.ok) {
            const allowed = await durableSessionRateLimit(clientIp, "delivery_badkey", 8, 60);
            await audit(env, access.reason === "missing_key" ? "init_missing_key" : "init_bad_key", { hash, ip: clientIp, reason: access.reason });
            return json({ error: allowed ? "Invalid or missing script key" : "Too many invalid keys" }, allowed ? 403 : 429);
          }
          if (!access.keyless && !(typeof runtimeKey === "string" && runtimeKey.trim())) {
            return json({ error: "Invalid or missing script key" }, 403);
          }
          initStage = "scoped-rate-limit";
          const [scriptAllowed, keyAllowed] = await Promise.all([
            durableScopedRateLimit("script-init", hash, 60, 60),
            durableScopedRateLimit("key-init", access.digest, 20, 60),
          ]);
          if (!scriptAllowed || !keyAllowed) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 429);

          initStage = "device-binding";
          const securityPolicy = scriptMeta.security || {};
          const clientPlaceId = String(body?.placeId || "");
          const clientUserId = String(body?.userId || "");
          let hwidHash = null;
          if (securityPolicy.hwidRequired === true) {
            if (access.accessMode !== "buyer_key") {
              await audit(env, "init_hwid_policy_invalid", { hash, ip: clientIp, accessMode: access.accessMode || "unknown" });
              return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 403);
            }
            const binding = await claimHwidBinding(hash, access.digest, body?.hwid);
            if (!binding.ok) {
              await audit(env, "init_hwid_denied", { hash, ip: clientIp, reason: binding.reason, keyTag: access.digest.slice(0, 12) });
              return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 403);
            }
            hwidHash = binding.hwidHash;
          }

          let placeVerified = false;
          if (securityPolicy.requirePlaceTicket === true) {
            if (!/^\d{1,20}$/.test(clientPlaceId) || !/^\d{1,22}$/.test(clientUserId) ||
                !Array.isArray(securityPolicy.allowedPlaceIds) || !securityPolicy.allowedPlaceIds.includes(clientPlaceId)) {
              return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 403);
            }
            const ticketOk = await consumeTrustedPlaceTicket(hash, clientPlaceId, clientUserId, body?.placeTicket);
            if (!ticketOk) {
              await audit(env, "init_place_ticket_denied", { hash, ip: clientIp, placeId: clientPlaceId });
              return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 403);
            }
            placeVerified = true;
          }

          initStage = "session-mint";
          const sessionId = makeSessionId();
          const issuedAt = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
          const expiresAt = issuedAt + 90;
          const ipBinding = clientIp || "";
          const boundProjectId = access.keyless ? "" : String(access.projectId);
          const boundDiscordUserId = access.keyless ? "" : String(access.discordUserId);
          const deliveryKeyBytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
          const deliveryKey = bytesToB64(deliveryKeyBytes);
          const message = `luavify-v5.6.4|${hash}|${access.ownerId}|${boundProjectId}|${boundDiscordUserId}|${access.digest}|${sessionId}|${issuedAt}|${expiresAt}|${ipBinding}|${hwidHash || ""}|${clientPlaceId}|${clientUserId}|${placeVerified ? "1" : "0"}`;
          const token = await hmacHex(message, AUTH_SECRET);
          if (!token) return json({ error: "Session signing unavailable", stage: initStage }, 503);
          // Bind the one-time blob identifier to this exact session. The blob
          // endpoint checks this value again before consuming the stored blob.
          const deliveryId = randHex(16);
          const sessionRecord = {
            sessionId, version: 56, hash, keyDigest: access.digest, keyless: !!access.keyless,
            ownerId: access.ownerId, projectId: boundProjectId, discordUserId: boundDiscordUserId,
            issuedAt, expiresAt, ip: ipBinding, deliveryKey, deliveryId,
            hwidHash, placeId: clientPlaceId, placeUserId: clientUserId, placeVerified
          };

          initStage = "integrity-check";
          const codeHash = await sha256HexStr(code);
          if (codeHash !== meta.contentHash) {
            await audit(env, "init_integrity_fail", { hash, ip: clientIp });
            return json({ error: "Payload integrity check failed" }, 403);
          }

          initStage = "encrypt-and-store";
          const deliveredCode = `-- Luavify delivery-id: ${deliveryId}\n${code}\n-- Luavify end-delivery-id: ${deliveryId}\n`;
          const xorKey = b64ToBytes(deliveryKey);
          const blob = await xorEncryptToB64(deliveredCode, xorKey);
          // Same DO instance for both records. blob-store validates that the session
          // already exists, so these MUST run sequentially (session first, then blob).
          const stub = env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(`sessions-${sessionId.slice(0, 2)}`));
          const sessionStoreResp = await stub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/session-store", {
            method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId, record: sessionRecord })
          });
          if (sessionStoreResp.status !== 201) {
            const d = (await sessionStoreResp.text().catch(() => "")).slice(0, 160);
            throw new Error(`Session store rejected (HTTP ${sessionStoreResp.status})${d ? `: ${d}` : ""}`);
          }
          const blobStoreResp = await stub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/blob-store", {
            method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ blob, hash, sessionId, deliveryId })
          });
          if (blobStoreResp.status !== 201) {
            const d = (await blobStoreResp.text().catch(() => "")).slice(0, 160);
            throw new Error(`Blob store rejected (HTTP ${blobStoreResp.status})${d ? `: ${d}` : ""}`);
          }

          // Fire-and-forget: delivery record + audit ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â don't block the response.
          Promise.all([
            env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`delivery_${deliveryId}`, JSON.stringify({
              deliveryId, hash, deliveredAt: new Date().toISOString(), ip: clientIp,
              keyless: !!access.keyless, keyTag: access.keyless ? "keyless" : access.digest.slice(0, 12),
              contentHash: meta.contentHash
            }), { expirationTtl: 2592000 }).catch(() => {}),
            env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`session_delivery_${sessionId}`, JSON.stringify({ hash, deliveryId, ip: clientIp }), { expirationTtl: 300 }).catch(() => {}),
            audit(env, "init_served", { hash, ip: clientIp, deliveryId, keyTag: access.keyless ? "keyless" : access.digest.slice(0, 12) }),
          ]).catch(() => {});

          return json({ sessionId, token, deliveryKey, expiresAt, deliveryId, blobBytes: blob.length }, 200);
        } catch (error) {
          const requestId = randHex(8);
          console.error(`Luavify /api/init failure [${initStage}] [${requestId}]:`, String(error?.stack || error).slice(0, 1200));
          await audit(env, "init_internal_error", { stage: initStage, requestId, ip: clientIp, error: String(error?.message || error).slice(0, 240) });
          return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED", requestId }, 500);
        }
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/api/session") {
        if (request.method !== "POST") {
          await audit(env, "delivery_session_method_denied", { ip: clientIp, method: request.method });
          return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405, headers: { "Allow": "POST", "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
        }
        let sessionStage = "configuration";
        try {
          if (!AUTH_SECRET || AUTH_SECRET.length < 32 || !env.NONCE_GUARD) {
            await audit(env, "delivery_session_security_config_missing", { ip: clientIp });
            return json({ error: "Security configuration unavailable", stage: "configuration" }, 503);
          }
          sessionStage = "session-rate-limit";
          let sessionAllowed;
          try {
            sessionAllowed = await durableSessionRateLimit(clientIp, "delivery_session", 12, 60);
          } catch (rateError) {
            await audit(env, "delivery_session_rate_limit_unavailable", {
              ip: clientIp, error: String(rateError?.message || rateError).slice(0, 180)
            });
            return json({ error: "Session service temporarily unavailable", stage: sessionStage }, 503);
          }
          if (!sessionAllowed) {
            await audit(env, "delivery_session_ratelimit", { ip: clientIp });
            return json({ error: "Too many requests" }, 429);
          }
          sessionStage = "request-validation";
          const body = await request.json();
          const hash = String(body?.hash || "");
          if (!HASH_RE.test(hash)) return json({ error: "Invalid hash" }, 400);
          // Parallel: metadata (owner+lock+disabled) and code fetch together ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â was 4+ sequential KV ops.
          const [scriptMeta, storedCode] = await Promise.all([
            getDeliveryScriptMetadata(hash),
            env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(hash),
          ]);
          if (!scriptMeta.ok) {
            await audit(env, "delivery_session_metadata_denied", { hash, ip: clientIp, reason: scriptMeta.reason });
            return json({ error: "Script metadata unavailable" }, 403);
          }
          if (scriptMeta.disabled || scriptMeta.locked) {
            await audit(env, "delivery_session_script_unavailable", { hash, ip: clientIp,
              disabled: !!scriptMeta.disabled, locked: !!scriptMeta.locked });
            return json({ error: "Script unavailable" }, 403);
          }
          if (!storedCode) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);

          sessionStage = "key-validation";
          const headerKey = request.headers.get("X-Luavify-Key") || "";
          const bodyKey = typeof body?.scriptKey === "string" ? body.scriptKey : "";
          const runtimeKey = headerKey.trim() ? headerKey : bodyKey;
          const access = await validateDeliveryKey(hash, runtimeKey, scriptMeta);
          if (!access.ok) {
            const allowed = await durableSessionRateLimit(clientIp, "delivery_badkey", 8, 60);
            await audit(env, access.reason === "missing_key" ? "delivery_missing_key" : "delivery_bad_key", {
              hash, ip: clientIp, reason: access.reason, keyTag: "not-logged"
            });
            return json({ error: allowed ? "Invalid or missing script key" : "Too many invalid keys" }, allowed ? 403 : 429);
          }
          // Belt-and-suspenders: never mint a session without a verified key unless this
          // access is explicitly keyless (which also requires ALLOW_KEYLESS=true).
          if (!access.keyless && !(typeof runtimeKey === "string" && runtimeKey.trim())) {
            await audit(env, "delivery_session_keyless_denied", { hash, ip: clientIp });
            return json({ error: "Invalid or missing script key" }, 403);
          }
          sessionStage = "session-id";
          const sessionId = makeSessionId();
          const issuedAt = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
          const expiresAt = issuedAt + 90;
          const ipBinding = clientIp || "";
          const boundProjectId = access.keyless ? "" : String(access.projectId);
          const boundDiscordUserId = access.keyless ? "" : String(access.discordUserId);
          const message = `luavify-v5.2|${hash}|${access.ownerId}|${boundProjectId}|${boundDiscordUserId}|${access.digest}|${sessionId}|${issuedAt}|${expiresAt}|${ipBinding}`;

          sessionStage = "session-sign";
          const token = await hmacHex(message, AUTH_SECRET);
          if (!token) return json({ error: "Session signing unavailable", stage: sessionStage }, 503);

          sessionStage = "session-store-do";
          const deliveryKeyBytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
          const deliveryKey = bytesToB64(deliveryKeyBytes);
          const sessionRecord = {
            sessionId, version: 53, hash, keyDigest: access.digest, keyless: !!access.keyless,
            ownerId: access.ownerId, projectId: boundProjectId, discordUserId: boundDiscordUserId,
            issuedAt, expiresAt, ip: ipBinding, deliveryKey
          };
          const sessionStub = env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(`sessions-${sessionId.slice(0, 2)}`));
          const sessionStoreResponse = await sessionStub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/session-store", {
            method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId, record: sessionRecord })
          });
          if (sessionStoreResponse.status !== 201) {
            const detail = (await sessionStoreResponse.text().catch(() => "")).slice(0, 160);
            throw new Error(`Durable session store rejected write (HTTP ${sessionStoreResponse.status})${detail ? `: ${detail}` : ""}`);
          }

          sessionStage = "session-audit";
          await audit(env, "delivery_session_issued", {
            hash, ip: clientIp, keyTag: access.keyless ? "keyless" : access.digest.slice(0, 12)
          });
          return json({ sessionId, token, expiresAt, deliveryKey }, 200);
        } catch (error) {
          const requestId = randHex(8);
          const errorName = String(error?.name || "Error").slice(0, 80);
          console.error("Luavify session failure [" + sessionStage + "] [" + requestId + "]:", String(error?.stack || error).slice(0, 1200));
          await audit(env, "delivery_session_error", {
            stage: sessionStage, requestId, errorName,
            error: String(error?.message || error).slice(0, 240), ip: clientIp
          });
          // Expose a safe failure stage and opaque request ID, not secrets or stack traces.
          return json({ error: "Session issuance failed", stage: sessionStage, requestId }, 500);
        }
      }

      
      if (url.pathname === "/api/delivery-blob") {
        if (request.method !== "POST") {
          return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405, headers: { "Allow": "POST", "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
        }
        try {
          // Fail with a clear service-configuration response instead of letting
          // WebCrypto throw while importing a missing HMAC secret.
          if (!AUTH_SECRET || AUTH_SECRET.length < 32 || !env.NONCE_GUARD) {
            return json({ error: "Security configuration unavailable", stage: "delivery-blob" }, 503);
          }
          const contentLength = Number(request.headers.get("Content-Length") || 0);
          if (contentLength > 16384) return json({ error: "Request body too large" }, 413);
          const rawBody = await request.text();
          if (!rawBody || rawBody.length > 16384) return json({ error: "Invalid blob request" }, 400);
          let body;
          try { body = JSON.parse(rawBody); } catch (_) { return json({ error: "Invalid JSON body" }, 400); }
          const hash = String(body?.hash || "");
          const sessionId = String(body?.sessionId || "");
          const token = String(body?.token || "");
          const deliveryId = String(body?.deliveryId || "");
          if (!HASH_RE.test(hash) ||
              !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(sessionId) ||
              !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(token) ||
              !/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/i.test(deliveryId)) {
            return json({ error: "Invalid blob request" }, 400);
          }
          const sessionStub = env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(`sessions-${sessionId.slice(0, 2)}`));
          const sessionReadResponse = await sessionStub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/session-read", {
            method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId })
          });
          if (!sessionReadResponse.ok) return json({ error: "Session expired or invalid" }, 403);
          const sessionReadBody = await sessionReadResponse.json().catch(() => null);
          const session = sessionReadBody && sessionReadBody.session;
          if (!session || session.hash !== hash ||
              (session.deliveryId && session.deliveryId !== deliveryId)) {
            return json({ error: "Session expired or invalid" }, 403);
          }
          const message = Number(session.version) >= 56
            ? `luavify-v5.6.4|${hash}|${session.ownerId}|${session.projectId || ""}|${session.discordUserId || ""}|${session.keyDigest}|${sessionId}|${session.issuedAt}|${session.expiresAt}|${session.ip || ""}|${session.hwidHash || ""}|${session.placeId || ""}|${session.placeUserId || ""}|${session.placeVerified ? "1" : "0"}`
            : `luavify-v5.2|${hash}|${session.ownerId}|${session.projectId || ""}|${session.discordUserId || ""}|${session.keyDigest}|${sessionId}|${session.issuedAt}|${session.expiresAt}|${session.ip || ""}`;
          const expectedToken = await hmacHex(message, AUTH_SECRET);
          if (!expectedToken || !constantTimeEqual(expectedToken, token)) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 403);
          if (session.expiresAt <= Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) || session.ip !== (clientIp || "")) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 403);
          const liveMeta = await getDeliveryScriptMetadata(hash);
          if (!liveMeta.ok || liveMeta.disabled || liveMeta.locked) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 403);
          const liveBuildRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`meta_${hash}`);
          let liveBuild = null;
          try { liveBuild = liveBuildRaw ? JSON.parse(liveBuildRaw) : null; } catch (_) { liveBuild = null; }
          if (!hasVoltfuscatorProtectionMetadata(liveBuild)) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 403);
          const liveAccess = await validateDeliveryKey(hash, typeof body.scriptKey === "string" ? body.scriptKey : "", liveMeta);
          if (!liveAccess.ok || liveAccess.digest !== session.keyDigest) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 403);
          if (session.hwidHash) {
            const suppliedHwid = String(body.hwid || "").trim();
            const suppliedHwidHash = suppliedHwid ? await sha256HexStr(`luavify-hwid-v1|${suppliedHwid}`) : "";
            if (!constantTimeEqual(suppliedHwidHash, session.hwidHash)) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 403);
          }
          if (!(await durableScopedRateLimit("delivery-session", sessionId, 6, 60)) ||
              !(await durableScopedRateLimit("delivery-key", session.keyDigest, 30, 60))) return json({ error: "REQUEST_FAILED" }, 429);
          const blobStub = env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(`sessions-${sessionId.slice(0, 2)}`));
          const blobReadResponse = await blobStub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/blob-read", {
            method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId, deliveryId, hash })
          });
          if (blobReadResponse.status === 404) return json({ error: "Blob expired or missing" }, 404);
          if (!blobReadResponse.ok) {
            const detail = (await blobReadResponse.text().catch(() => "")).slice(0, 120);
            throw new Error(`Durable delivery blob read failed (HTTP ${blobReadResponse.status})${detail ? `: ${detail}` : ""}`);
          }
          const blobText = await blobReadResponse.text();
          if (!blobText) return json({ error: "Blob empty" }, 503);
          // Return opaque blob only (not nested in huge JSON for the client to re-decode).
          return new Response(blobText, {
            status: 200,
            headers: {
              "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
              "Cache-Control": "no-store",
              "X-Luavify-Format": "xorb64"
            }
          });
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("delivery-blob error", String(e).slice(0, 400));
          return json({ error: "Blob request failed" }, 500);
        }
      }

if (url.pathname === "/api/get-payload") {
        if (request.method !== "POST") {
          let methodAllowed;
          try {
            methodAllowed = await durableSessionRateLimit(clientIp, "delivery_method_denied", 20, 60);
          } catch (_) {
            await audit(env, "get_payload_method_rate_limit_unavailable", { ip: clientIp });
            return new Response("Delivery security service temporarily unavailable", {
              status: 503, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store", "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" }
            });
          }
          await audit(env, "get_payload_method_denied", { ip: clientIp, method: request.method });
          if (!methodAllowed) return new Response("Too many requests", { status: 429, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
          return new Response("POST with an authorized script mode and fresh session required", {
            status: 405, headers: { "Allow": "POST", "Cache-Control": "no-store", "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" }
          });
        }
        let payloadStage = "configuration";
        try {
          if (!AUTH_SECRET || AUTH_SECRET.length < 32 || !env.NONCE_GUARD) {
            await audit(env, "get_payload_security_config_missing", { ip: clientIp });
            return json({ error: "Security configuration unavailable" }, 503);
          }
          // The previous KV rateLimit() ran while payloadStage was still
          // "configuration", so KV errors were misreported as configuration 500s.
          // Delivery throttles now use the existing Durable Object, not KV.
          payloadStage = "payload-rate-limit";
          if (!(await durableSessionRateLimit(clientIp, "getpayload", 12, 60))) {
            await audit(env, "get_payload_ratelimit", { ip: clientIp });
            return json({ error: "Too many requests" }, 429);
          }
          payloadStage = "request-validation";
          const body = await request.json();
          const hash = String(body?.hash || "");
          const sessionId = String(body?.sessionId || "");
          const token = String(body?.token || "");
          if (!HASH_RE.test(hash) || !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(sessionId) || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(token)) {
            await audit(env, "get_payload_missing_session", { hash: HASH_RE.test(hash) ? hash : "", ip: clientIp });
            const tokenAttemptsAllowed = await durableSessionRateLimit(clientIp, "delivery_badtoken", 8, 60);
            if (!tokenAttemptsAllowed) return json({ error: "Too many invalid session tokens" }, 429);
            return json({ error: "Valid delivery session required" }, 403);
          }
          const scriptMeta = await getDeliveryScriptMetadata(hash);
          if (!scriptMeta.ok || scriptMeta.disabled || scriptMeta.locked) {
            await audit(env, "get_payload_script_unavailable", { hash, ip: clientIp,
              reason: scriptMeta.reason || (scriptMeta.disabled ? "disabled" : "locked") });
            return json({ error: "Script unavailable" }, 403);
          }

          payloadStage = "key-validation";
          const headerKey = request.headers.get("X-Luavify-Key") || "";
          const bodyKey = typeof body?.scriptKey === "string" ? body.scriptKey : "";
          const runtimeKey = headerKey.trim() ? headerKey : bodyKey;
          const access = await validateDeliveryKey(hash, runtimeKey, scriptMeta);
          if (!access.ok) {
            const allowed = await durableSessionRateLimit(clientIp, "delivery_badkey", 8, 60);
            await audit(env, access.reason === "missing_key" ? "get_payload_missing_key" : "get_payload_bad_key", {
              hash, ip: clientIp, reason: access.reason
            });
            return json({ error: allowed ? (access.reason === "missing_key" ? "script key required" : "invalid or expired script key") : "Too many invalid keys" }, allowed ? 403 : 429);
          }
          if (!access.keyless && !(typeof runtimeKey === "string" && runtimeKey.trim())) {
            await audit(env, "get_payload_missing_key", { hash, ip: clientIp, reason: "empty_after_validate" });
            return json({ error: "script key required" }, 403);
          }

          payloadStage = "session-validation";
          const sessionStub = env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(`sessions-${sessionId.slice(0, 2)}`));
          const sessionReadResponse = await sessionStub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/session-read", {
            method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId })
          });
          let session = null;
          if (sessionReadResponse.ok) {
            const sessionReadBody = await sessionReadResponse.json().catch(() => null);
            session = sessionReadBody && sessionReadBody.session || null;
          } else if (sessionReadResponse.status !== 404) {
            const detail = (await sessionReadResponse.text().catch(() => "")).slice(0, 120);
            throw new Error(`Durable session store read failed (HTTP ${sessionReadResponse.status})${detail ? `: ${detail}` : ""}`);
          }
          const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
          const expectedProjectId = access.keyless ? "" : String(access.projectId);
          const expectedDiscordUserId = access.keyless ? "" : String(access.discordUserId);
          if (!session || session.version !== 52 && session.version !== 53 || session.hash !== hash || session.keyDigest !== access.digest ||
              session.ownerId !== access.ownerId || session.projectId !== expectedProjectId ||
              session.discordUserId !== expectedDiscordUserId ||
              session.expiresAt <= now || session.issuedAt > now + 5 || session.expiresAt - session.issuedAt !== 90 ||
              session.ip !== (clientIp || "") || (!!session.keyless !== !!access.keyless)) {
            await audit(env, "get_payload_invalid_session", { hash, ip: clientIp });
            const tokenAttemptsAllowed = await durableSessionRateLimit(clientIp, "delivery_badtoken", 8, 60);
            if (!tokenAttemptsAllowed) return json({ error: "Too many invalid session tokens" }, 429);
            return json({ error: "Session expired or invalid" }, 403);
          }
          const message = `luavify-v5.2|${hash}|${access.ownerId}|${expectedProjectId}|${expectedDiscordUserId}|${access.digest}|${sessionId}|${session.issuedAt}|${session.expiresAt}|${session.ip}`;
          const expected = await hmacHex(message, AUTH_SECRET);
          if (!expected || !constantTimeEqual(expected, token)) {
            await audit(env, "get_payload_bad_session_token", { hash, ip: clientIp });
            const tokenAttemptsAllowed = await durableSessionRateLimit(clientIp, "delivery_badtoken", 8, 60);
            if (!tokenAttemptsAllowed) return json({ error: "Too many invalid session tokens" }, 429);
            return json({ error: "Invalid session token" }, 403);
          }

          payloadStage = "one-time-claim";
          const nonceStub = env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(hash));
          const claim = await nonceStub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/claim", {
            method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ nonce: sessionId })
          });
          if (claim.status === 409) {
            await audit(env, "get_payload_replay", { hash, ip: clientIp });
            return json({ error: "Token already used" }, 403);
          }
          if (!claim.ok && claim.status !== 204) {
            await audit(env, "get_payload_nonce_claim_fail", { hash, ip: clientIp, status: claim.status });
            return json({ error: "Replay protection unavailable" }, 503);
          }

          payloadStage = "payload-read";
          const code = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(hash);
          if (!code) return json({ error: "Payload not found" }, 404);
          payloadStage = "integrity-check";
          const metaRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`meta_${hash}`);
          if (!metaRaw) return json({ error: "Payload metadata missing" }, 403);
          const meta = JSON.parse(metaRaw);
          if (!hasVoltfuscatorProtectionMetadata(meta)) {
            await audit(env, "get_payload_unprotected_build_denied", { hash, ip: clientIp });
            return json({ error: "This script must be re-obfuscated with the current protection pipeline", stage: "protection-validation" }, 409);
          }
          if (!meta || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(String(meta.contentHash || "")) || await sha256HexStr(code) !== meta.contentHash) {
            await audit(env, "get_payload_integrity_fail", { hash, ip: clientIp });
            return json({ error: "Payload integrity check failed" }, 403);
          }

          payloadStage = "response";
          const deliveryId = randHex(16);
          const deliveredAt = new Date().toISOString();
          const deliveredCode = `-- Luavify delivery-id: ${deliveryId}\n${code}\n-- Luavify end-delivery-id: ${deliveryId}\n`;
          // Luarmor-like: never return plain Luau in JSON. Runtime XOR-decrypts with
          // session.deliveryKey. get-payload body alone is opaque base64.
          if (!session.deliveryKey || typeof session.deliveryKey !== "string") {
            return json({ error: "Session missing delivery key" }, 403);
          }
          const xorKey = b64ToBytes(session.deliveryKey);
          const blob = await xorEncryptToB64(deliveredCode, xorKey);
          // Keep JSON small for executors (large JSONDecode often fails in Roblox).
          // Blob is fetched from /api/delivery-blob with the same session.
          try {
            const blobStub = env.NONCE_GUARD.get(env.NONCE_GUARD.idFromName(`sessions-${sessionId.slice(0, 2)}`));
            const blobStoreResponse = await blobStub.fetch("https://nonce-guard.internal/blob-store", {
              method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
              body: JSON.stringify({ blob, hash, sessionId, deliveryId })
            });
            if (blobStoreResponse.status !== 201) {
              const detail = (await blobStoreResponse.text().catch(() => "")).slice(0, 160);
              throw new Error(`Durable delivery blob store rejected write (HTTP ${blobStoreResponse.status})${detail ? `: ${detail}` : ""}`);
            }
          } catch (blobErr) {
            console.error("Luavify blob store failed:", String(blobErr?.stack || blobErr).slice(0, 500));
            await audit(env, "delivery_blob_store_failed", { hash, ip: clientIp, deliveryId, error: String(blobErr?.message || blobErr).slice(0, 240) });
            return json({ error: "Delivery blob store failed", stage: "blob-store-do" }, 503);
          }
          try {
            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`delivery_${deliveryId}`, JSON.stringify({
              deliveryId, hash, deliveredAt, ip: clientIp, keyless: !!access.keyless,
              keyTag: access.keyless ? "keyless" : access.digest.slice(0, 12), contentHash: meta.contentHash
            }), { expirationTtl: 2592000 });
          } catch (storeError) {
            console.error("Luavify delivery attribution storage failed:", String(storeError).slice(0, 300));
          }
          await audit(env, "get_payload_served", {
            hash, ip: clientIp, deliveryId, keyTag: access.keyless ? "keyless" : access.digest.slice(0, 12), contentHash: meta.contentHash
          });
          // Links this delivery to a real execution confirmation (see /log-execution).
          // A served deliveryId with no matching "execution_confirmed" audit entry
          // within a few minutes means the payload was fetched but never run in
          // Roblox - the signature of someone replaying the HTTP calls directly.
          try {
            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`session_delivery_${sessionId}`, JSON.stringify({ hash, deliveryId, ip: clientIp }), { expirationTtl: 300 });
          } catch (_) {}
          return json({ v: 1, format: "xorb64", deliveryId, blobBytes: blob.length }, 200);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Luavify get-payload failure [" + payloadStage + "]:", String(error?.stack || error).slice(0, 1000));
          await audit(env, "get_payload_internal_error", { stage: payloadStage, ip: clientIp, error: String(error?.message || error).slice(0, 300) });
          return json({ error: "Payload request failed", stage: payloadStage }, 500);
        }
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/runtime/v1/init.lua") {
        if (request.method !== "GET") return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405, headers: { "Allow": "GET", "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
        const antiDumpLuaB64 = "";
        const antiDumpLuaSource = new TextDecoder().decode(
          Uint8Array.from(atob(antiDumpLuaB64), (ch) => ch.charCodeAt(0))
        );
        const runtimeLua = `-- Luavify Runtime v${LUAVIFY_RUNTIME_VERSION}
return function(H,A,K)
local LS=loadstring
local S=game:GetService("HttpService")
local R=(syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request or (fluxus and fluxus.request)
if type(R)~="function" then warn("[Luavify] Executor HTTP request is unavailable.") return end
-- Best-effort fail-closed check for the known loadstring forwarding dumper.
-- This checks exposed closure upvalues for the exact captured old compiler.
local function hasKnownLoadstringDumpHook()
  local candidates={}
  pcall(function() candidates[#candidates+1]=LS end)
  pcall(function() if type(getgenv)=="function" then local e=getgenv(); if type(e)=="table" then candidates[#candidates+1]=rawget(e,"loadstring") end end end)
  pcall(function() if type(_G)=="table" then candidates[#candidates+1]=rawget(_G,"loadstring") end end)
  local d=debug
  if type(d)~="table" then return false end
  for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
    if type(candidate)=="function" then
      if type(d.getupvalues)=="function" then
        local ok,ups=pcall(d.getupvalues,candidate)
        if ok and type(ups)=="table" then
          for name,value in pairs(ups) do
            if tostring(name)=="old" and type(value)=="function" then return true end
          end
        end
      end
      if type(d.getupvalue)=="function" then
        for i=1,32 do
          local ok,name,value=pcall(d.getupvalue,candidate,i)
          if not ok or name==nil then break end
          if tostring(name)=="old" and type(value)=="function" then return true end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return false
end
local function rejectKnownDumpHook()
  if not hasKnownLoadstringDumpHook() then return false end
  warn("[Luavify] Loadstring dump hook detected. Disconnecting before payload execution.")
  pcall(function()
    local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    if player then player:Kick("Unauthorized runtime modification detected.") end
  end)
  return true
end
if rejectKnownDumpHook() then return end
local function cleanKey(V)
  if type(V)~="string" then return "" end
  return (V:gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$",""))
end
local function readKey(T)
  if type(T)~="table" then return "" end
  local V=T.script_key or T.ScriptKey or T.key
  return cleanKey(V)
end
K=cleanKey(K)
local function readHwid()
  local getters={gethwid,get_hwid,getexecutorhwid}
  for _,fn in ipairs(getters) do
    if type(fn)=="function" then
      local ok,value=pcall(fn)
      if ok and type(value)=="string" and #value>=8 and #value<=256 then return value end
    end
  end
  return ""
end
local function readPlaceTicket()
  local env=nil
  pcall(function() if type(getgenv)=="function" then env=getgenv() end end)
  if type(env)=="table" and type(env.luavify_place_ticket)=="string" then return env.luavify_place_ticket end
  if type(shared)=="table" and type(shared.luavify_place_ticket)=="string" then return shared.luavify_place_ticket end
  local ok,remote=pcall(function()
    local replicated=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    return replicated:FindFirstChild("LuavifyTicket")
  end)
  if ok and remote then
    local invoked,ticket=pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer() end)
    if invoked and type(ticket)=="string" then return ticket end
  end
  return ""
end
local HWID=readHwid()
local PLACE_TICKET=readPlaceTicket()
if K=="" then pcall(function() if type(getgenv)=="function" then K=readKey(getgenv()) end end) end
if K=="" then pcall(function() K=readKey(_G) end) end
if K=="" then pcall(function() K=readKey(shared) end) end
if K=="" then pcall(function() K=cleanKey(script_key) end) end
local function responseParts(RES)
  if type(RES)=="string" then
    local GOOD,OBJ=pcall(function() return S:JSONDecode(RES) end)
    if GOOD and type(OBJ)=="table" and (OBJ.error or OBJ.message) then return 500,RES end
    return 200,RES
  end
  if type(RES)~="table" then return nil,"Executor returned an unsupported HTTP response" end
  local STATUS=tonumber(RES.StatusCode or RES.Status or RES.status_code or RES.status)
  local RAW=RES.Body or RES.body or RES.ResponseBody or RES.responseBody or RES.response_body or ""
  if type(RAW)~="string" then RAW=tostring(RAW or "") end
  if not STATUS and (RES.Success==true or RES.success==true) then STATUS=200 end
  if not STATUS then
    local GOOD,OBJ=pcall(function() return S:JSONDecode(RAW) end)
    if GOOD and type(OBJ)=="table" and (OBJ.error or OBJ.message) then return 500,RAW end
    return nil,"Executor response did not include an HTTP status"
  end
  return STATUS,RAW
end
local function send(METHOD,PATH,DATA)
  local HEADERS={ ["Content-Type"]="application/json" }
  local OUT=nil
  if type(DATA)=="table" then
    OUT={}
    for NAME,VALUE in pairs(DATA) do OUT[NAME]=VALUE end
    if K~="" then OUT.scriptKey=K end
  end
  if K~="" then HEADERS["X-Luavify-Key"]=K end
  local BODY=OUT and S:JSONEncode(OUT) or ""
  local OK,RES=pcall(function()
    return R({Url=A..PATH,Method=METHOD,Headers=HEADERS,Body=BODY})
  end)
  if not OK then return nil,"Executor HTTP request failed: "..tostring(RES):sub(1,120) end
  local STATUS,RAW=responseParts(RES)
  if not STATUS then return nil,tostring(RAW):sub(1,180) end
  if STATUS<200 or STATUS>=300 then
    local GOOD,OBJ=pcall(function() return S:JSONDecode(RAW) end)
    if GOOD and type(OBJ)=="table" then
      local MESSAGE=tostring(OBJ.error or OBJ.message or "request denied")
      if OBJ.stage then MESSAGE=MESSAGE.." ["..tostring(OBJ.stage).."]" end
      if OBJ.requestId then MESSAGE=MESSAGE.." [ref "..tostring(OBJ.requestId).."]" end
      return nil,MESSAGE.." (HTTP "..tostring(STATUS)..")"
    end
    return nil,(RAW~="" and RAW or ("HTTP "..tostring(STATUS)))
  end
  if RAW=="" then return nil,"Empty HTTP response (HTTP "..tostring(STATUS)..")" end
  return RAW
end
-- /api/init: one roundtrip replaces /api/session + /api/get-payload (was 2 sequential calls).
local localPlayer=nil
pcall(function() localPlayer=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer end)
local initRaw,initErr=send("POST","/api/init",{hash=H,scriptKey=K,placeId=(game and game.PlaceId) or 0,userId=(localPlayer and localPlayer.UserId) or 0,hwid=HWID,placeTicket=PLACE_TICKET})
if not initRaw then warn("[Luavify] Init failed: "..tostring(initErr):sub(1,240)) return end
local okInit,session=pcall(function() return S:JSONDecode(initRaw) end)
if not okInit or type(session)~="table" or type(session.sessionId)~="string" or type(session.token)~="string" or type(session.deliveryKey)~="string" or type(session.deliveryId)~="string" then
  warn("[Luavify] Invalid init response.") return
end
-- Synthesize a payload table matching the xorb64 format the decode block below expects.
local payload={format="xorb64",deliveryId=session.deliveryId}
local B64_CHARS='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
local B64_LOOKUP={}
for i=1,64 do B64_LOOKUP[B64_CHARS:byte(i)]=i-1 end
local function b64decode(data)
  data=tostring(data or '')
  local out={}
  local n=0
  local acc,bits=0,0
  for i=1,#data do
    local v=B64_LOOKUP[data:byte(i)]
    if v then
      acc=(acc*64+v)%16777216
      bits=bits+6
      if bits>=8 then
        bits=bits-8
        n=n+1
        out[n]=string.char(math.floor(acc/(2^bits))%256)
      end
    end
  end
  return table.concat(out)
end
local function bxor(a,b)
  if bit32 and bit32.bxor then return bit32.bxor(a,b) end
  local r,p=0,1
  while a>0 or b>0 do
    local ab,bb=a%2,b%2
    if ab~=bb then r=r+p end
    a,b,p=(a-ab)/2,(b-bb)/2,p*2
  end
  return r
end
-- The loader accepts encrypted Voltfuscator output only. There is no plaintext-code fallback.
local protectedPayload=nil
if payload.format=='xorb64' then
  local blob=payload.blob
  if type(blob)~='string' or blob=='' then
    if type(payload.deliveryId)~='string' then warn('[Luavify] Payload missing deliveryId.') return end
    local blobRaw,blobErr=send("POST","/api/delivery-blob",{hash=H,sessionId=session.sessionId,token=session.token,deliveryId=payload.deliveryId,scriptKey=K,hwid=HWID})
    if not blobRaw then warn('[Luavify] Blob download failed: '..tostring(blobErr):sub(1,200)) return end
    blob=blobRaw
  end
  local dk=session.deliveryKey
  if type(dk)~='string' or dk=='' then warn('[Luavify] Session missing delivery key.') return end
  local keyRaw=b64decode(dk)
  if type(keyRaw)~='string' or #keyRaw<16 then warn('[Luavify] Bad delivery key.') return end
  local key={}
  for i=1,#keyRaw do key[i]=string.byte(keyRaw,i) end
  local raw=b64decode(blob)
  if type(raw)~='string' or #raw<1 then warn('[Luavify] Bad delivery blob decode.') return end
  local out={}
  local kl=#key
  for i=1,#raw do out[i]=string.char(bxor(string.byte(raw,i), key[((i-1)%kl)+1])) end
  protectedPayload=table.concat(out)
else
  warn('[Luavify] Invalid payload response format: '..tostring(payload.format))
  return
end
if type(protectedPayload)~='string' or protectedPayload=='' then return end
-- Full AntiDump v4 gate. The module is embedded in this generated runtime,
-- so it does not need a separate client-side fetch or a second loadstring call.
local AntiDump = (function()
${antiDumpLuaSource}
end)()
-- Keep the supplied policy, but only enable continuous watch when this executor
-- actually exposes the task scheduler required by the module.
AntiDump.CONFIG.WATCH.ENABLED =
    type(task) == "table" and type(task.spawn) == "function" and type(task.wait) == "function"
if AntiDump.CONFIG.WATCH.ENABLED then
    AntiDump.watch()
end

local executionResult = nil
local allowed = AntiDump.protect(function()
    -- The canary and runtime checks happen before the real plaintext is compiled.
    -- Resolve the active global here, after AntiDump.protect installed its temporary
    -- forwarding shim. Using the earlier local LS reference would bypass that shim.
    local compiler = loadstring
    if type(compiler) ~= "function" then
        warn("[Luavify] Active loadstring compiler is unavailable.")
        return
    end
    local compileOK, fn = pcall(compiler, protectedPayload)
    protectedPayload = nil
    if not compileOK or type(fn) ~= "function" then
        warn("[Luavify] Protected payload compilation failed.")
        return
    end
    -- Hide the entry-stage loading badge immediately before protected execution.
    pcall(function()
        local env = type(getgenv)=="function" and getgenv() or _G
        local cleanup = type(env)=="table" and rawget(env,"__LuavifyLoadingCleanup")
        if type(cleanup)=="function" then cleanup(); rawset(env,"__LuavifyLoadingCleanup",nil) end
    end)
    local sid=session.sessionId
    local function sendHeartbeat()
        pcall(function() send("POST","/api/heartbeat",{hash=H,sessionId=sid,token=session.token}) end)
    end
    local function roblosId(v)
        local ok,s=pcall(function() return tostring(v) end)
        if not ok or type(s)~="string" then return "" end
        return (s:gsub("[^%w%-]",""))
    end
    local jobId=roblosId(game and game.JobId)
    local placeId=roblosId(game and game.PlaceId)
    local gameId=roblosId(game and game.GameId)
    local identity="&jobId="..jobId.."&placeId="..placeId.."&gameId="..gameId
    local spawnFn=(task and task.spawn) or spawn
    local waitFn=(task and task.wait) or wait
    pcall(function()
        spawnFn(function()
            send("GET","/log-execution?hash="..H.."&sid="..sid..identity,nil)
            while true do waitFn(60); sendHeartbeat() end
        end)
    end)
    executionResult = fn()
end)
if not allowed then
    protectedPayload = nil
    AntiDump.stopWatch()
    return
end
return executionResult
end`;
        return new Response(runtimeLua, {
          headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store, max-age=0", "CDN-Cache-Control": "no-store", "Pragma": "no-cache", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff" }
        });
      }

      const loaderMatch = url.pathname.match(/^\/files\/v4\/loaders\/([a-f0-9]{32})\.lua$/i);
      const shieldMatch = url.pathname.match(/^\/example\.shield\/protector\/([a-f0-9]{32})\.lua$/i);
      const isLoaderStage = !!loaderMatch;
      const isShieldStage = !!shieldMatch;
      const isLoaderPath = url.pathname.startsWith("/files/v4/loaders/");
      const isShieldPath = url.pathname.startsWith("/example.shield/protector/");
      if (isLoaderPath || isShieldPath) {
        if (request.method !== "GET") {
          return new Response("Method not allowed", {
            status: 405,
            headers: { "Allow": "GET", "Cache-Control": "no-store", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff" }

        if (!isLoaderStage && !isShieldStage) {

        const blockedLua = "-- Luavify: script unavailable or request blocked\n-- https://luavify.dpdns.org\nreturn nil\n";
        const blockedResponse = (status = 403) => new Response(blockedLua, {

        const userAgent = request.headers.get("User-Agent") || "";

        // default "Accept: text/html, image/gif, ...". That must NOT be mistaken for a browser (they'd get the HTML page instead of Lua).
        // A real browser tab always sends Sec-Fetch-* headers, or an Accept list with application/xhtml+xml.
        const executorAgent = /(?:Roblox|Synapse|Fluxus|Solara|Executor|Delta|Wave|Xeno|Krnl|Codex|Arceus|Hydrogen|Velocity|Cryptic|Ronix|okhttp|Dalvik|CFNetwork|Java|curl|python|libcurl|WinHttp|WinInet)/i.test(userAgent);
        const browserAccept = /text\/html[^,]*,\s*application\/xhtml\+xml/i.test(acceptHeader);
        const isBrowser = fetchMode === "navigate" || fetchDest === "document" || (browserAccept && !executorAgent);

        // Never fetch the full protected payload on the loader-entry request.
        // It may be several megabytes or a Supabase-backed value. This route
        // only needs an existence check plus compact protection metadata.

          env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`meta_${hash}`),
        ]);

        if (!hasCode) return blockedResponse(404);

        let loaderBuildMeta = null;

        if (await isScriptLocked(hash, scriptOwnerId)) return blockedResponse(403);

          const loaderMeta = scriptOwnerId ? await getDeliveryScriptMetadata(hash) : null;

          const browserKeyLine = loaderMode === "public" ? "" : loaderMode === "shared_key"

          return new Response(html, {
            status: 200,
            headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store", "Vary": "Accept, Sec-Fetch-Mode, Sec-Fetch-Dest", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff" }
          });

          await audit(env, "loader_auth_secret_missing", { hash, ip: clientIp });

        const shieldVersion = "1.0.1";
        const shieldUrl = `${SITE_URL}/example.shield/protector/${hash}.lua`;

-- Luavify loading indicator: positioned beside the mobile jump control.
local function createLuavifyLoadingIndicator()
    local gui, label
    local function makeGui(parent)
        local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        screen.Name = "LuavifyLoadingStatus"
        screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
        screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        screen.DisplayOrder = 100000
        screen.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

        local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        frame.Name = "Status"
        frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -245, 1, -135)
        frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 38)
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
        frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
        frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        frame.Parent = screen

        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
        corner.Parent = frame

        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 65)
        stroke.Transparency = 0.25
        stroke.Thickness = 1
        stroke.Parent = frame

        local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
        dot.Name = "LoadingDot"
        dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
        dot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0.5, 0)
        dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
        dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 75, 80)
        dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
        dot.Parent = frame

        local dotCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        dotCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        dotCorner.Parent = dot

        local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        text.Name = "Message"
        text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        text.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(27, 0)
        text.Size = UDim2.new(1, -34, 1, 0)
        text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        text.Text = "This Luavify script is loading. Please wait..."
        text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 248)
        text.TextSize = 11
        text.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        text.TextWrapped = true
        text.Parent = frame

        screen.Parent = parent
        return screen
    end

    pcall(function()
        local parent
        if type(gethui) == "function" then
            local ok, value = pcall(gethui)
            if ok then parent = value end
        end
        if not parent then
            local core = game:GetService("CoreGui")
            parent = core
        end
        gui = makeGui(parent)
    end)

    if not gui then
        pcall(function()
            local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
            if player then
                local playerGui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
                if playerGui then gui = makeGui(playerGui) end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function cleanup()
        pcall(function()
            if gui then gui:Destroy() end
        end)
    end

    -- Failsafe: never leave a stale loading badge on screen indefinitely.
    pcall(function()
        if type(task) == "table" and type(task.delay) == "function" then
            task.delay(45, cleanup)
        end
    end)
    return cleanup
end

-- Anti-dump preflight. This specifically checks the getgenv().loadstring
-- replacement used by common loadstring-to-file hooks.
local function hasForwardingUpvalue(fn)
    if type(debug) ~= "table" then return false end
    local function isOriginalCompilerUpvalue(name, value)
        local key = tostring(name):lower()
        return type(value) == "function" and
            (key == "old" or key == "original" or key == "orig" or key == "oldloadstring")
    end
    if type(debug.getupvalues) == "function" then
        local ok, values = pcall(debug.getupvalues, fn)
        if ok and type(values) == "table" then
            for name, value in pairs(values) do
                if isOriginalCompilerUpvalue(name, value) then return true end
            end
        end
    elseif type(debug.getupvalue) == "function" then
        for index = 1, 24 do
            local ok, name, value = pcall(debug.getupvalue, fn, index)
            if not ok or name == nil then break end
            if isOriginalCompilerUpvalue(name, value) then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function shieldHookDetected()
    local globalCompiler = LS
    if type(globalCompiler) ~= "function" then
        return true, "loadstring unavailable"
    end
    if hasForwardingUpvalue(globalCompiler) then
        return true, "loadstring wrapper captures an original compiler"
    end
    if type(_G) == "table" then
        local globalAlias = rawget(_G, "loadstring")
        if type(globalAlias) == "function" and globalAlias ~= LS then
            return true, "_G.loadstring differs from captured loadstring"
        end
    end
    if type(getgenv) == "function" then
        local ok, executorEnv = pcall(getgenv)
        if ok and type(executorEnv) == "table" then
            local executorCompiler = rawget(executorEnv, "loadstring")
            if type(executorCompiler) == "function" and executorCompiler ~= LS then
                return true, "getgenv().loadstring differs from captured loadstring"
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

if detected then
    warn("[Luavify Shield] Loadstring hook detected: " .. tostring(reason) .. ". Disconnecting.")
    pcall(function() local p=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer; if p then p:Kick("Unauthorized runtime modification detected.") end end)
    return
end

return result

-- Anti-dump monitor: snapshot compiler references before runtime delivery,
-- then continuously compare them while the protected runtime is active.
-- This detects replacements made after Shield starts; it cannot prove that a
-- function was clean before the snapshot or defeat a fully transparent hook.
local function readCompiler(env)
    if type(env) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local ok, value = pcall(rawget, env, "loadstring")
    if ok and type(value) == "function" then return value end
    return nil
end
local function getExecutorEnv()
    if type(getgenv) ~= "function" then return nil end
    local ok, value = pcall(getgenv)
    if ok and type(value) == "table" then return value end
    return nil
end
local executorEnv = getExecutorEnv()

local compilerSnapshots = {}
local function snapshotEnv(env, label)
    if type(env) ~= "table" then return true end
    local fn = readCompiler(env)
    -- _G/shared/getfenv aliases are optional in many executors.
    -- A missing alias must not block a valid global loadstring compiler.
    if not fn then return true end
    compilerSnapshots[#compilerSnapshots + 1] = { env = env, fn = fn, label = label }
    return true
end
local okSnapshot, snapshotError = snapshotEnv(executorEnv, "getgenv")
if not okSnapshot then return stop(snapshotError) end
if type(_G) == "table" then
    okSnapshot, snapshotError = snapshotEnv(_G, "_G")
    if not okSnapshot then return stop(snapshotError) end
end
if type(shared) == "table" then
    okSnapshot, snapshotError = snapshotEnv(shared, "shared")
    if not okSnapshot then return stop(snapshotError) end
end
if type(getfenv) == "function" then
    local envOk, currentEnv = pcall(getfenv, 0)
    if envOk and type(currentEnv) == "table" then
        okSnapshot, snapshotError = snapshotEnv(currentEnv, "getfenv(0)")
        if not okSnapshot then return stop(snapshotError) end
    end
end
-- The sample dump wrapper uses the compiler function saved before the wrapper was installed
-- in an upvalue. Some executors expose closure upvalues through debug.getupvalues;
-- when available, flag a compiler wrapper that captures another function.
-- This is heuristic because executor debug APIs differ and may hide C-closure data.
local function capturesFunctionUpvalue(fn)
    if type(debug) ~= "table" then return false end
    local function isOriginalCompilerUpvalue(name, value)
        local key = tostring(name):lower()
        return type(value) == "function" and
            (key == "old" or key == "original" or key == "orig" or key == "oldloadstring")
    end
    if type(debug.getupvalues) == "function" then
        local ok, values = pcall(debug.getupvalues, fn)
        if ok and type(values) == "table" then
            for name, value in pairs(values) do
                if isOriginalCompilerUpvalue(name, value) then return true end
            end
        end
    elseif type(debug.getupvalue) == "function" then
        for index = 1, 24 do
            local ok, name, value = pcall(debug.getupvalue, fn, index)
            if not ok or name == nil then break end
            if isOriginalCompilerUpvalue(name, value) then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function shieldHookDetected()
    if type(LS) == "function" and capturesFunctionUpvalue(LS) then
        return true, "loadstring wrapper captures a function upvalue"
    end
    if type(_G) == "table" then
        local globalAlias = rawget(_G, "loadstring")
        if type(globalAlias) == "function" and globalAlias ~= LS then
            return true, "_G.loadstring reference changed"
        end
    end
    local currentExecutorEnv = getExecutorEnv()
    if currentExecutorEnv then
        local executorAlias = readCompiler(currentExecutorEnv)
        if executorAlias and executorAlias ~= LS then
            return true, "getgenv().loadstring reference changed"
        end
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(compilerSnapshots) do
        local current = readCompiler(item.env)
        if current ~= item.fn then
            return true, item.label .. ".loadstring reference changed"
        end
    end
    return false
end

        return new Response(shieldLua, {

      const sha256Hex = async (value) => {
        const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(String(value)));
        return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
      };
      const randomAccessKey = () => "LV-" + randHex(12).toUpperCase().match(/.{1,4}/g).join("-");
      const randomRuntimeToken = () => "lvk_" + randHex(24);
      const accessExpires = (days) => Number.isInteger(days) && days > 0 ? new Date(Date.now() + days * 86400000).toISOString() : null;
      
      async function projectForHash(hash) {
        if (!hash) return null;
        let h = String(hash).trim().toLowerCase();
        // Accept 16â€“64 hex (legacy / alternate lengths), strip non-hex
        if (!/^[a-f0-9]{16,64}$/i.test(h)) {
          const stripped = h.replace(/[^a-f0-9]/gi, "");
          if (/^[a-f0-9]{16,64}$/i.test(stripped)) h = stripped.toLowerCase();
          else return null;
        }

        const matchInDoc = (doc, ownerId) => {
          if (!doc) return null;
          for (const project of doc.projects || []) {
            for (const script of project.scripts || []) {
              const sh = String(script.hash || script.id || "").trim().toLowerCase();
              if (sh && sh === h) return { owner: String(ownerId), project, script };
            }
          }
          return null;
        };

        // 1) Logged-in user's projects
        if (userId) {
          try {
            const mine = await getProjectsDoc(String(userId));
            const hit = matchInDoc(mine, userId);
            if (hit) return hit;
          } catch (_) {}
        }

        // 2) script_owner_* (try exact + lowercase key)
        let owner = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`script_owner_${h}`);
        if (!owner && h !== String(hash).trim()) {
          owner = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`script_owner_${String(hash).trim()}`);
        }
        if (owner) {
          const ownerId = String(owner);
          try {
            const doc = await getProjectsDoc(ownerId);
            const hit = matchInDoc(doc, ownerId);
            if (hit) return hit;
          } catch (_) {}
          // Orphan owner mapping â€” still valid

          try {
            const metaRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`meta_${h}`);
            const m = metaRaw ? JSON.parse(metaRaw) : null;
            if (m && m.name) name = String(m.name).slice(0, 100);
          } catch (_) {}
          return {
            owner: ownerId,
            project: { id: "orphan", name: "Project", scripts: [{ hash: h, name }] },
            script: { hash: h, name },
          };
        }

        // 3) meta_* alone (last resort)
        try {

          if (metaRaw) {
            let m = null;
            try { m = JSON.parse(metaRaw); } catch (_) {}
            const ownerId = String((m && m.ownerId) || userId || "");
            if (ownerId) {
              return {
                owner: ownerId,
                project: { id: "meta", name: "Project", scripts: [{ hash: h, name: (m && m.name) || "script" }] },
                script: { hash: h, name: (m && m.name) || "script" },
              };
            }
          }
        } catch (_) {}

        return null;
      }

async function ownsGuild(uid, guildId) {
        if (!uid || !/^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(guildId || ""))) return false;
        if (OWNER_IDS.has(uid)) return true;
        const g = String(guildId);
        const owns = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`guildowner_${g}`);
        if (owns && String(owns) === String(uid)) return true;
        const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`ownerguilds_${uid}`);
        let ids = [];
        try { ids = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : []; } catch (_) { ids = []; }
        if (ids.map(String).includes(g)) {
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`guildowner_${g}`, String(uid));
          return true;
        }
        return false;
      }

      
      async function botAuth() {
        const clean = (v) => String(v ?? "").trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "").trim();
        const supplied = clean((request.headers.get("Authorization") || "").replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, ""));
        const expected = clean(env.BOT_SECRET);
        if (!expected || supplied.length !== expected.length) return false;
        // constant-time comparison
        const enc = new TextEncoder(), a = enc.encode(supplied), b = enc.encode(expected);
        let diff = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) diff |= a[i] ^ b[i];
        return diff === 0;
      }
      
      // Panel access is per SERVER. A whitelist / redeem done from server A (guildId stored on the record)
      // does not count on the panel in server B. Records without a guildId (dashboard whitelist, older
      // records) still count everywhere.
      // Assign Discord buyer role for a script panel (if the server configured one).
      async function grantBuyerRole(guildId, userId, hash, expiresAt) {
        if (!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(guildId || "")) || !/^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(userId || "")) || !HASH_RE.test(String(hash || ""))) return false;
        const roleId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`buyerrole_${guildId}_${hash}`);
        if (!roleId || !/^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(roleId))) return false;
        try {
          await discordApi(`/guilds/${guildId}/members/${userId}/roles/${roleId}`, { method: "PUT" });
        } catch (_) {}
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(
          `buyerrolegrant_${guildId}_${userId}_${hash}`,
          JSON.stringify({
            roleId: String(roleId),
            hash: String(hash),
            guildId: String(guildId),
            userId: String(userId),
            expiresAt: expiresAt || null,
            grantedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          })
        );
        return true;
      }

      // Remove Discord buyer role when a duration key (or timed access) ends.
      async function revokeBuyerRole(guildId, userId, hash) {
        if (!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(guildId || "")) || !/^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(userId || ""))) return false;
        const grantKey = `buyerrolegrant_${guildId}_${userId}_${hash}`;
        let roleId = null;
        const grantRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(grantKey);
        try {
          const g = grantRaw ? JSON.parse(grantRaw) : null;
          if (g && g.roleId) roleId = String(g.roleId);
        } catch (_) {}
        if (!roleId) {
          const configured = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`buyerrole_${guildId}_${hash}`);
          if (configured) roleId = String(configured);
        }
        if (roleId && /^\d{15,22}$/.test(roleId)) {
          try {
            await discordApi(`/guilds/${guildId}/members/${userId}/roles/${roleId}`, { method: "DELETE" });
          } catch (_) {}
        }
        try { await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(grantKey); } catch (_) {}
        return true;
      }

      async function panelAccess(ownerId, projectId, target, guildId) {
        const pid = String(projectId);
        const tid = String(target);
        const oid = String(ownerId);
        const access = await getAccess(oid, pid, tid);
        // Prefer string keys; also try legacy number-shaped project ids if needed.
