        let wlRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`accesswl_${oid}_${pid}_${tid}`);
        if (!wlRaw && pid !== String(projectId)) wlRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`accesswl_${oid}_${projectId}_${tid}`);
        let blRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`accessbl_${oid}_${pid}_${tid}`);
        if (!blRaw) blRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`accessbl_${oid}_${projectId}_${tid}`);
        let wl = null; try { wl = wlRaw ? JSON.parse(wlRaw) : null; } catch (_) {}
        let bl = null; try { bl = blRaw ? JSON.parse(blRaw) : null; } catch (_) {}
        // Whitelist/blacklist are per-script (owner+project+user). Guild on the record is metadata only ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â
        // it must NOT block panel access on the script's panel in any server.
        const activeBl = !!bl && (!bl.expiresAt || Date.parse(bl.expiresAt) > Date.now());
        const activeWl = !activeBl && !!wl && (!wl.expiresAt || Date.parse(wl.expiresAt) > Date.now());
        const accessExpired = !!(access?.expiresAt && Date.parse(access.expiresAt) <= Date.now());
        const keyAccess = !activeBl && !!access?.accessToken && !accessExpired;
        // Duration key finished ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ã‚Â¢ drop Discord buyer role (lazy cleanup on access checks).
        if (accessExpired && access?.viaKey) {
          const g = String(access.guildId || guildId || "");
          const h = String(access.hash || "");
          if (g && h) {
            try { await revokeBuyerRole(g, tid, h); } catch (_) {}
          }
        }
        return { access, wl, bl, activeWl, activeBl, keyAccess, hasAccess: !activeBl && (keyAccess || activeWl), accessExpired };
      }

      async function linkedOwner(discordId) {
        const ownerId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`botlink_${discordId}`);
        if (!ownerId) return null;
        const user = await getUser(ownerId);
        return user ? { ownerId, user } : null;
      }

      // Links a guild to the owner who controls it (set on /linkapi-in-guild and on panel setup),
      // plus a reverse index so the dashboard can list "my connected servers".
      async function linkGuildToOwner(guildId, ownerId) {
        if (!guildId || !ownerId) return;
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`guildowner_${guildId}`, String(ownerId));
        const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`ownerguilds_${ownerId}`);
        let list = []; try { list = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : []; } catch (_) { list = []; }
        if (!list.includes(String(guildId))) { list.push(String(guildId)); await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`ownerguilds_${ownerId}`, JSON.stringify(list)); }
      }

      // Resolves who is allowed to act as a project owner for a moderation action:
      // either the linked owner themself, or a staff member whose Discord role is in
      // that guild's configured "manager roles" list.
      async function resolveManager(callerDiscordId, guildId, callerRoleIds) {
        const linked = await linkedOwner(String(callerDiscordId || ""));
        if (linked) return { ownerId: linked.ownerId, isOwner: true };
        if (!guildId) return null;
        const ownerId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`guildowner_${guildId}`);
        if (!ownerId) return null;
        const rolesRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`botperm_${guildId}`);
        let allowed = []; try { allowed = rolesRaw ? JSON.parse(rolesRaw) : []; } catch (_) { allowed = []; }
        if (!allowed.length) return null;
        const mine = Array.isArray(callerRoleIds) ? callerRoleIds.map(String) : [];
        if (!mine.some(r => allowed.includes(r))) return null;
        return { ownerId, isOwner: false };
      }

      // Calls the Discord REST API with the bot token (used for posting panels and
      // resolving usernames/avatars/channels/roles without the Render bot process).
      // The first segment of a bot token is the base64 of the bot's application ID (public info, the secret part is never read).
      function botTokenAppId() {
        try {
          const seg = String(env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN || "").split(".")[0];
          if (!seg) return null;
          const id = atob(seg.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/"));
          return /^\d{15,22}$/.test(id) ? id : null;
        } catch (_) { return null; }
      }
      // "Add bot" invites DISCORD_CLIENT_ID. If the bot token belongs to a different application, every server added
      // that way is invisible to this worker and would be shown as "removed".
      function botAppMismatch() {
        const tokenApp = botTokenAppId();
        return !!(tokenApp && env.DISCORD_CLIENT_ID && tokenApp !== String(env.DISCORD_CLIENT_ID));
      }

      async function discordApi(path, { method = "GET", body } = {}) {
        if (!env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN) return { ok: false, status: 0, data: { error: "Bot token not configured" } };
        const res = await fetch(`https://discord.com/api/v10${path}`, {
          method,
          headers: { "Authorization": `Bot ${env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
        });
        const text = await res.text();
        let data; try { data = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {}; } catch (_) { data = { raw: text }; }
        return { ok: res.ok, status: res.status, data };
      }

      // ---- Panel look: the 5 buttons can be renamed / re-emoji'd / recolored, but never removed. ----
      const PANEL_DEFAULT_TITLE = "Control Panel";
      const PANEL_DEFAULT_DESC = "This control panel is for the script: **{script}**\nIf you're a buyer, click on the buttons below to redeem your key, get the script or get your role";
      const PANEL_BUTTON_DEFAULTS = {
        redeem:     { label: "Redeem Key",  emoji: "\u{1F511}", style: "success" },
        loadstring: { label: "Get Script",  emoji: "\u{1F4C4}", style: "primary" },
        buyerrole:  { label: "Get Role",    emoji: "\u{1F464}", style: "primary" },
        resethwid:  { label: "Reset HWID",  emoji: "\u{2699}\u{FE0F}", style: "secondary" },
        info:       { label: "Get Stats",   emoji: "\u{1F4CA}", style: "secondary" },
      };
      // Match common buyer-panel layout: redeem / get script / get role, then hwid / stats
      const PANEL_BUTTON_ROWS = [["redeem", "loadstring", "buyerrole"], ["resethwid", "info"]];
      const PANEL_BUTTON_STYLES = { primary: 1, secondary: 2, success: 3, danger: 4 };
      const PANEL_LAYOUT_V2 = "components_v2";
      const PANEL_FLAG_COMPONENTS_V2 = 1 << 15; // IS_COMPONENTS_V2 - once a message has it, Discord won't let it go back to embeds
      const panelLayoutOf = (st) => (st?.layout === PANEL_LAYOUT_V2 ? PANEL_LAYOUT_V2 : "embed");

      // "<:name:id>" / "<a:name:id>" = custom emoji, otherwise a normal unicode emoji. Empty = no emoji.
      function parsePanelEmoji(e) {
        if (!e) return null;
        const m = e.match(/^<(a?):([A-Za-z0-9_]{2,32}):(\d{15,22})>$/);
        if (m) return { name: m[2], id: m[3], animated: !!m[1] };
        if ([...e].length <= 12 && /^(\p{Extended_Pictographic}|\p{Regional_Indicator}|[0-9#*]\uFE0F?\u20E3)/u.test(e)) return { name: e };
        return null;
      }
      // Always returns all 5 buttons (missing/blank labels fall back to the default - a button can't be deleted).
      function normalizePanelButtons(input) {
        const out = {};
        for (const id of Object.keys(PANEL_BUTTON_DEFAULTS)) {
          const def = PANEL_BUTTON_DEFAULTS[id];
          const src = (input && typeof input === "object" && input[id] && typeof input[id] === "object") ? input[id] : {};
          const label = (typeof src.label === "string" ? src.label.trim() : "").slice(0, 80) || def.label;
          let emoji = typeof src.emoji === "string" ? src.emoji.trim() : def.emoji;
          // Repair UTF-8 mojibake if a panel was saved with broken encoding
          if (emoji && /[\x80-\xff]|\u00f0|\u00c3/.test(emoji)) {
            try {
              const bytes = Uint8Array.from([...emoji].map(ch => ch.charCodeAt(0) & 0xff));
              const fixed = new TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(bytes);
              if (fixed && parsePanelEmoji(fixed)) emoji = fixed;
            } catch (_) {}
          }
          if (!emoji) emoji = def.emoji;
          if (emoji && !parsePanelEmoji(emoji)) return { error: `"${emoji.slice(0, 20)}" is not a valid emoji (button: ${def.label}). Use a normal emoji or a custom one like <:name:123456789012345678>.` };
          const style = PANEL_BUTTON_STYLES[src.style] ? src.style : def.style;
          out[id] = { label, emoji, style };
        }
        return { buttons: out };
      }

      // Links only: Discord embeds need an http(s) URL (max 2048 chars).
      function isHttpUrl(v) {
        const t = String(v || "").trim();
        if (!t || t.length > 2048) return false;
        try { const u = new URL(t); return u.protocol === "https:" || u.protocol === "http:"; } catch (_) { return false; }
      }
      function cleanUrl(v) { const t = String(v || "").trim(); return isHttpUrl(t) ? t : ""; }

      function discordUserAvatarUrl(u) {
        if (!u || !u.id) return null;
        if (u.avatar) {
          const ext = String(u.avatar).startsWith("a_") ? "gif" : "png";
          return `https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/${u.id}/${u.avatar}.${ext}?size=64`;
        }
        try {
          const idx = Number((BigInt(String(u.id)) >> 22n) % 6n);
          return `https://cdn.discordapp.com/embed/avatars/${idx}.png`;
        } catch (_) {
          return "https://cdn.discordapp.com/embed/avatars/0.png";
        }
      }

      function panelFooterFromStyle(style, poster) {
        const custom = String(style?.footer || "").trim();
        if (custom) return { text: custom.slice(0, 2048) };
        const name = String(poster?.username || poster?.global_name || poster?.displayName || "").trim();
        if (name) {
          const foot = { text: (`Sent by ${name}`).slice(0, 2048) };
          const icon = poster?.avatarUrl || discordUserAvatarUrl(poster);
          if (icon) {
            try {
              const u = new URL(icon);
              if (u.protocol === "https:" || u.protocol === "http:") foot.icon_url = icon;
            } catch (_) {}
          }
          return foot;
        }
        return { text: "Luavify" };
      }

      function buildPanelPayload(hash, title, description, style, buttons, poster) {
        const color = /^#?[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(style?.color || "") ? parseInt((style.color || "ef4444").replace("#", ""), 16) : 0xef4444;
        const scriptName = String(style?.scriptName || "").trim() || "script";
        const defTitle = `${scriptName} Control Panel`.slice(0, 256);
        const defDesc = PANEL_DEFAULT_DESC.replace(/\{script\}/g, scriptName);
        const embed = {
          title: (title && String(title).trim()) || defTitle,
          description: (description && String(description).trim()) || defDesc,
          color,
          footer: panelFooterFromStyle(style, poster),
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        if (style?.topLine) embed.author = { name: String(style.topLine).slice(0, 256) };
        if (isHttpUrl(style?.thumbnail)) embed.thumbnail = { url: String(style.thumbnail).trim() };
        if (isHttpUrl(style?.image)) embed.image = { url: String(style.image).trim() };
        const cfg = normalizePanelButtons(buttons).buttons || PANEL_BUTTON_DEFAULTS;
        const components = PANEL_BUTTON_ROWS.map(row => ({
          type: 1,
          components: row.map(id => {
            const btn = { type: 2, style: PANEL_BUTTON_STYLES[cfg[id].style], custom_id: `pl:${id}:${hash}`, label: cfg[id].label };
            const em = parsePanelEmoji(cfg[id].emoji);
            if (em) btn.emoji = em;
            return btn;
          }),
        }));

        // Components V2 layout: ONE card (container) that holds the text, image, separator, buttons and footer,
        // exactly like the dashboard's live preview. (V2 messages can't have `content` or `embeds`.)
        if (style?.layout === PANEL_LAYOUT_V2) {
          const inner = [];
          if (style?.topLine) inner.push({ type: 10, content: `-# ${String(style.topLine).slice(0, 256)}` });
          const head = `## ${embed.title}\n${embed.description}`.slice(0, 3900);
          if (isHttpUrl(style?.thumbnail)) {
            inner.push({ type: 9, components: [{ type: 10, content: head }], accessory: { type: 11, media: { url: String(style.thumbnail).trim() } } });
          } else {
            inner.push({ type: 10, content: head });
          }
          if (isHttpUrl(style?.image)) inner.push({ type: 12, items: [{ media: { url: String(style.image).trim() } }] });
          inner.push({ type: 14, divider: true, spacing: 1 });
          inner.push(...components);
          inner.push({ type: 10, content: `-# ${String(panelFooterFromStyle(style, poster).text || "Luavify").slice(0, 500)}` });
          return { flags: PANEL_FLAG_COMPONENTS_V2, components: [{ type: 17, accent_color: color, components: inner }] };
        }
        return { embeds: [embed], components };
      }

      // Posted in the /setlog channel when someone is whitelisted:
      //   you have been whitelisted to script *Name* (<@user>)
      //   --> you can get script <link to the script's panel message>
      // Only sent when the owner already ran /setlog (no log channel = nothing is posted).
      // Posts the whitelist / blacklist notice in the /setlog channel (nothing is posted when no log channel is set):
      //   whitelist -> @user You have been whitelisted!
      //                You can access the script via this message --> <link to the script's panel message>
      //   blacklist -> @user You have been blacklisted! ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂºÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â
      //                To find out why, go to <link to the panel message> and click on **<info button name>** button
      async function notifyAccessLogs(kind, ownerId, discordId, hash, guildId, channelId = "") {
        if (!env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN) return;
        try {
          let panelLink = "";
          let panelGuild = "";
          let panelChannelId = "";
          let infoLabel = PANEL_BUTTON_DEFAULTS.info.label;
          if (hash) {
            const found = await findPanel(hash);
            if (found?.rec?.channelId && found.rec.messageId) {
              panelGuild = String(found.guildId);
              panelChannelId = String(found.rec.channelId);
              panelLink = `https://discord.com/channels/${found.guildId}/${found.rec.channelId}/${found.rec.messageId}`;
              infoLabel = normalizePanelButtons(found.rec.buttons).buttons?.info?.label || infoLabel;
            }
          }
          // /whitelist: only ping the user; link directly to the panel message when available.
          const accessTarget = panelLink || (panelChannelId ? `<#${panelChannelId}>` : "the panel");
          const text = kind === "whitelist"
            ? (`<@${discordId}> **You have been whitelisted!** Access the script via this message --> ${accessTarget}`)
            : (`<@${discordId}> **You have been blacklisted!** \u26D4\nTo find out why, go to ${accessTarget} and click on **${infoLabel}** button`);
          const mentions = { users: [String(discordId)] };
          const msgBody = { content: text.slice(0, 1900), flags: 4, allowed_mentions: mentions };
          const posted = [];
          // 1) Post in the channel where the staff member ran the command (the bot passes it in).
          if (/^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(channelId || ""))) {
            const r = await discordApi(`/channels/${channelId}/messages`, { method: "POST", body: msgBody });
            if (r.ok && r.data?.id) posted.push({ c: String(channelId), m: String(r.data.id) });
            else console.warn(`${kind} notice could not be posted in the command channel:`, r.status, JSON.stringify(r.data).slice(0, 200));
          }
          // 2) Fallback (dashboard actions, or the command channel was not writable): the /setlog channel(s).
          if (!posted.length) {
            const targets = new Set();
            for (const g of [guildId, panelGuild]) {
              if (!g) continue;
              const ch = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`botlog_${g}`);
              if (ch) targets.add(ch);
            }
            if (!targets.size) {
              const channels = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: `botlogowner_${ownerId}_` });
              for (const item of channels.keys) {
                const ch = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(item.name);
                if (ch) targets.add(ch);
              }
            }
            for (const chId of targets) {
              const r = await discordApi(`/channels/${chId}/messages`, { method: "POST", body: msgBody });
              if (r.ok && r.data?.id) posted.push({ c: String(chId), m: String(r.data.id) });
            }
          }
          // Remember the message(s) so /unwhitelist and /unblacklist can delete them again.
          if (posted.length && hash) {
            const key = `accessmsg_${kind}_${hash}_${discordId}`;
            let prev = []; try { prev = JSON.parse((await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(key)) || "[]"); } catch (_) { prev = []; }
            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(key, JSON.stringify(prev.concat(posted).slice(-20)));
          }
        } catch (e) { console.warn(`${kind} log delivery failed:`, e?.message || e); }
      }
      const notifyWhitelistLogs = (ownerId, scriptName, discordId, hash, guildId, channelId) => notifyAccessLogs("whitelist", ownerId, discordId, hash, guildId, channelId);
      const notifyBlacklistLogs = (ownerId, scriptName, discordId, hash, guildId, channelId) => notifyAccessLogs("blacklist", ownerId, discordId, hash, guildId, channelId);

      // Deletes the "You have been whitelisted / blacklisted" message(s) posted earlier for this user + script.
      // Silent when there is nothing to delete (e.g. users added by /masswhitelist never got a message).
      async function deleteAccessMessages(kind, hash, discordId) {
        if (!env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN || !hash) return;
        const key = `accessmsg_${kind}_${hash}_${discordId}`;
        try {
          const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(key);
          if (!raw) return;
          let list = []; try { list = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) { list = []; }
          for (const x of list) {
            if (x?.c && x?.m) await discordApi(`/channels/${x.c}/messages/${x.m}`, { method: "DELETE" }).catch(() => {});
          }
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(key);
        } catch (e) { console.warn(`${kind} message cleanup failed:`, e?.message || e); }
      }
      
      // Posts a line in every log channel this owner configured with /setlog.
      async function notifyOwnerLogs(ownerId, content, mentionId) {
        if (!env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN) return;
        try {
          const channels = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: `botlogowner_${ownerId}_` });
          for (const item of channels.keys) {
            const channelId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(item.name);
            if (!channelId) continue;
            await discordApi(`/channels/${channelId}/messages`, { method: "POST", body: { content: String(content).slice(0, 1900), allowed_mentions: mentionId ? { users: [String(mentionId)] } : { parse: [] } } });
          }
        } catch (e) { console.warn("Log delivery failed:", e?.message || e); }
      }

      async function getAccess(ownerId, projectId, discordId) {
        const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`access_${ownerId}_${projectId}_${discordId}`);
        try { return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null; } catch (_) { return null; }
      }
      
      // viaKey = this access came from redeeming a key (so /unwhitelist must not take it away).
      async function issueRuntimeToken(hash, ownerId, projectId, discordId, expiresAt = null, viaKey = false) {
        const token = randomRuntimeToken();
        const digest = await sha256Hex(token);
        const tokenDoc = { hash, ownerId: String(ownerId), projectId: String(projectId), discordUserId: String(discordId), expiresAt };
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`usertoken_${digest}`, JSON.stringify(tokenDoc));
        const access = await getAccess(ownerId, projectId, discordId) || {};
        access.accessTokens = access.accessTokens || {}; access.accessTokens[hash] = token;
        access.projectId = String(projectId); access.discordUserId = String(discordId);
        access.hash = hash; access.accessToken = token; access.accessTokenHash = digest; access.ownerId = String(ownerId);
        access.expiresAt = expiresAt || access.expiresAt || null;
        if (viaKey) access.viaKey = true;
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`access_${ownerId}_${projectId}_${discordId}`, JSON.stringify(access));
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`access_required_${hash}`, "true");
        return token;
      }
      
      // Keys are looked up by SHA-256 digest, so the plaintext is also stored AES-GCM encrypted
      // (only when AUTH_SECRET/SIGNING_SECRET exists) so the owner can see it again in the dashboard.
      async function keyCipher() {
        const secret = AUTH_SECRET || SIGNING_SECRET;
        if (!secret) return null;
        const raw = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode("luavify-key-vault:" + secret));
        return crypto.subtle.importKey("raw", raw, "AES-GCM", false, ["encrypt", "decrypt"]);
      }
      async function sealKeyText(text) {
        try {
          const k = await keyCipher(); if (!k) return null;
          const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
          const ct = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: "AES-GCM", iv }, k, new TextEncoder().encode(text)));
          const out = new Uint8Array(12 + ct.length); out.set(iv); out.set(ct, 12);
          let bin = ""; out.forEach(b => bin += String.fromCharCode(b));
          return btoa(bin);
        } catch (_) { return null; }
      }
      async function openKeyText(b64) {
        try {
          if (!b64) return null;
          const k = await keyCipher(); if (!k) return null;
          const bin = atob(b64); const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
          for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
          const pt = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: "AES-GCM", iv: bytes.slice(0, 12) }, k, bytes.slice(12));
          return new TextDecoder().decode(pt);
        } catch (_) { return null; }
      }

      async function createAccessKey(hash, projectId, ownerId, options = {}) {
        const plaintext = randomAccessKey();
        const digest = await sha256Hex(plaintext);
        const rec = {
          id: crypto.randomUUID(), hash, projectId: String(projectId), ownerId: String(ownerId),
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), expiresAt: options.expiresAt || null,
          durationDays: Math.max(0, Math.min(3650, Number(options.durationDays) || 0)),
          assignedDiscordId: options.assignedDiscordId || null,
          maxRedemptions: Math.max(1, Math.min(10000, Number(options.maxRedemptions) || 1)),
          redeemedBy: [], type: options.type || "single", status: "active",
          digest, enc: await sealKeyText(plaintext)
        };
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`accesskey_${digest}`, JSON.stringify(rec));
        // Per-script index: lets the dashboard list a script's keys without scanning every key of every user.
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`accesskeyidx_${hash}_${rec.id}`, "1", { metadata: { d: digest } });
        if (options.markRequired !== false) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`access_required_${hash}`, "true");
        return { plaintext, record: rec };
      }

      // Public (dashboard) shape of a key record, with the decrypted key when we have it.
      async function publicKeyRecord(r) {
        return {
          id: r.id, createdAt: r.createdAt, expiresAt: r.expiresAt, assignedDiscordId: r.assignedDiscordId,
          maxRedemptions: r.maxRedemptions, redeemedBy: r.redeemedBy || [], status: r.status,
          key: await openKeyText(r.enc)
        };
      }
      // All keys of one script. Index first (fast, per script), then a bounded scan that also back-fills
      // the index for keys created before it existed.
      async function listScriptKeys(hash) {
        const out = []; const seen = new Set(); const knownDigests = new Set();
        let cursor;
        do {
          const page = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: `accesskeyidx_${hash}_`, cursor });
          for (const k of page.keys) {
            const d = k.metadata?.d; if (!d) continue;
            knownDigests.add(d);
            const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`accesskey_${d}`); if (!raw) continue;
            try { const r = JSON.parse(raw); if (r.hash === hash && r.status !== "deleted" && !seen.has(r.id)) { seen.add(r.id); out.push(r); } } catch (_) {}
          }
          cursor = page.list_complete ? undefined : page.cursor;
        } while (cursor && out.length < 500);
        let scanned = 0; cursor = undefined;
        do {
          const page = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: "accesskey_", cursor });
          for (const k of page.keys) {
            if (scanned >= 150) break;
            const d = k.name.slice("accesskey_".length);
            if (knownDigests.has(d)) continue;
            scanned++;
            const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(k.name); if (!raw) continue;
            try {
              const r = JSON.parse(raw);
              if (r.hash && r.id) { try { await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`accesskeyidx_${r.hash}_${r.id}`, "1", { metadata: { d } }); } catch (_) {} }
              if (r.hash === hash && r.status !== "deleted" && !seen.has(r.id)) { seen.add(r.id); out.push(r); }
            } catch (_) {}
          }
          cursor = page.list_complete || scanned >= 150 ? undefined : page.cursor;
        } while (cursor);
        out.sort((a, b) => Date.parse(b.createdAt || 0) - Date.parse(a.createdAt || 0));
        return out;
      }

      // Self-service HWID reset limiting, configured per-project via /api/discordbot/hwid-limit.
      // resets === null/undefined -> unlimited (legacy default). resets === 0 -> self-reset disabled.
      async function checkHwidResetLimit(ownerId, projectId, discordId) {
        const cfgRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`hwidlimit_${ownerId}_${projectId}`);
        let cfg = null; try { cfg = cfgRaw ? JSON.parse(cfgRaw) : null; } catch (_) { cfg = null; }
        if (!cfg || cfg.resets === null || cfg.resets === undefined) return { allowed: true };
        if (cfg.resets === 0) return { allowed: false, message: "Self-service HWID resets are disabled for this script. Ask the owner." };
        const logRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`hwidresetlog_${ownerId}_${projectId}_${discordId}`);
        let log = null; try { log = logRaw ? JSON.parse(logRaw) : null; } catch (_) { log = null; }
        const windowMs = cfg.days * 86400000;
        if (!log || (Date.now() - log.windowStart) >= windowMs) return { allowed: true };
        if (log.count < cfg.resets) return { allowed: true };
        return { allowed: false, message: `You've used all ${cfg.resets} HWID reset(s) for this window.`, nextResetAt: new Date(log.windowStart + windowMs).toISOString() };
      }
      async function recordHwidReset(ownerId, projectId, discordId) {
        const key = `hwidresetlog_${ownerId}_${projectId}_${discordId}`;
        const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(key);
        let log = null; try { log = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null; } catch (_) { log = null; }
        const cfgRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`hwidlimit_${ownerId}_${projectId}`);
        let cfg = null; try { cfg = cfgRaw ? JSON.parse(cfgRaw) : null; } catch (_) { cfg = null; }
        const windowMs = (cfg?.days || 5) * 86400000;
        if (!log || (Date.now() - log.windowStart) >= windowMs) log = { windowStart: Date.now(), count: 0 };
        log.count += 1;
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(key, JSON.stringify(log));
      }

      // ==========================================================
      // PANELS ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â a script can only ever have ONE panel.
      //   panel_<guild>_<hash>      the panel record (channel, message, title, style, buttons)
      //   scriptpanel_<hash>        index: which guild currently holds that script's panel
      //   panelowner_<guild>_<hash> owner (used by the panel buttons)
      // ==========================================================
      async function findPanel(hash) {
        const idxRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`scriptpanel_${hash}`);
        if (idxRaw) {
          try {
            const guildId = String(JSON.parse(idxRaw).guildId || "");
            const raw = guildId ? await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`panel_${guildId}_${hash}`) : null;
            if (raw) return { guildId, rec: JSON.parse(raw) };
          } catch (_) {}
        }
        // Panels posted before the index existed: find them once, then index them.
        let cursor, pages = 0;
        do {
          const page = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: "panel_", cursor });
          for (const k of page.keys) {
            if (!k.name.endsWith(`_${hash}`)) continue;
            const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(k.name);
            if (!raw) continue;
            try {
              const guildId = k.name.split("_")[1];
              await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`scriptpanel_${hash}`, JSON.stringify({ guildId }));
              return { guildId, rec: JSON.parse(raw) };
            } catch (_) {}
          }
          cursor = page.list_complete ? undefined : page.cursor;
        } while (cursor && ++pages < 10);
        return null;
      }
      // "live" = message still exists; "gone" = deleted / bot can't see it; "unknown" = Discord didn't answer properly.
      async function panelMessageState(rec) {
        if (!rec?.channelId || !rec?.messageId) return "gone";
        const r = await discordApi(`/channels/${rec.channelId}/messages/${rec.messageId}`);
        if (r.ok) return "live";
        if (r.status === 404) return "gone"; // 10008 Unknown Message / 10003 Unknown Channel
        return "unknown"; // 403 = bot can't read that channel's history; never treat that as "deleted"
      }
      async function forgetPanel(guildId, hash) {
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`panel_${guildId}_${hash}`);
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`panelowner_${guildId}_${hash}`);
        const idx = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`scriptpanel_${hash}`);
        try { if (idx && String(JSON.parse(idx).guildId) === String(guildId)) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`scriptpanel_${hash}`); } catch (_) {}
      }
      async function savePanel(hash, ownerId, guildId, rec) {
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`panel_${guildId}_${hash}`, JSON.stringify(rec));
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`panelowner_${guildId}_${hash}`, String(ownerId));
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`scriptpanel_${hash}`, JSON.stringify({ guildId: String(guildId) }));
      }
      // mode "setup"  (bot /panelsetup): refuse if the script already has a live panel.
      // mode "update" (dashboard):       ALWAYS edits the already-posted message in place.
      //                                  It only posts a new message when `move` is true (explicit "Move panel"),
      //                                  or when the old message was really deleted (Discord answered 404).
      async function publishPanel({ item, guildId, channelId, title, description, style, buttons, mode, move, poster }) {
        const hash = item.script.hash;
        style = { ...(style || {}), scriptName: String(item?.script?.name || style?.scriptName || "script") };
        const prev = await findPanel(hash);
        const sameSpot = (p) => p && p.guildId === String(guildId) && String(p.rec.channelId) === String(channelId);

        // ---------- setup (bot): one panel per script ----------
        if (mode === "setup") {
          let live = null;
          if (prev) {
            const state = await panelMessageState(prev.rec);
            if (state === "unknown") return { status: 502, body: { error: "Couldn't check the existing panel on Discord. Make sure the bot can view that channel and read its message history, then try again." } };
            if (state === "gone") await forgetPanel(prev.guildId, hash);
            else live = prev;
          }
          if (live) {
            return { status: 409, body: {
              error: "This script already has a panel.",
              existing: { guildId: live.guildId, channelId: live.rec.channelId, messageId: live.rec.messageId, url: `https://discord.com/channels/${live.guildId}/${live.rec.channelId}/${live.rec.messageId}` },
            } };
          }
          const payload = buildPanelPayload(hash, title, description, style, buttons ?? null, poster);
          const posted = await discordApi(`/channels/${channelId}/messages`, { method: "POST", body: payload });
          if (!posted.ok) return { status: 502, body: { error: posted.data?.message || "Discord rejected the panel. Check the bot's permissions in that channel." } };
          await savePanel(hash, item.owner, guildId, {
            channelId, messageId: posted.data.id, title, description, scriptHash: hash,
            style: style || {}, buttons: normalizePanelButtons(buttons ?? null).buttons, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          });
          return { status: 200, body: { success: true, channelId, messageId: posted.data.id, updated: false, moved: false } };
        }

        // ---------- update (dashboard) ----------
        const keepButtons = buttons ?? prev?.rec?.buttons ?? null;
        const payload = buildPanelPayload(hash, title, description, style, keepButtons, poster);
        const record = (gId, cId, mId) => ({
          channelId: cId, messageId: mId, title, description, scriptHash: hash,
          style: style || {}, buttons: normalizePanelButtons(keepButtons).buttons, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        });

        // Embed <-> Components V2 can't be switched by editing (Discord never lets a V2 message go back), so a layout
        // change posts the new look in the panel's own channel and deletes the old message. Still only ONE panel.
        const layoutChanged = !!(prev && prev.rec?.messageId && panelLayoutOf(prev.rec.style) !== panelLayoutOf(style));
        if (layoutChanged && !move) {
          const state = await panelMessageState(prev.rec);
          if (state === "unknown") return { status: 502, body: { error: "Couldn't reach the existing panel on Discord. Make sure the bot can view that channel and read its message history, then try again." } };
          if (state === "gone") {
            await forgetPanel(prev.guildId, hash);
            return { status: 404, body: { gone: true, error: "That panel message no longer exists on Discord (it was deleted). Press \"Post panel to channel\" to post it again." } };
          }
          const reposted = await discordApi(`/channels/${prev.rec.channelId}/messages`, { method: "POST", body: payload });
          if (!reposted.ok) return { status: 502, body: { error: reposted.data?.message || "Discord rejected the new panel layout. Check the bot's permissions in that channel." } };
          await discordApi(`/channels/${prev.rec.channelId}/messages/${prev.rec.messageId}`, { method: "DELETE" });
          await savePanel(hash, item.owner, prev.guildId, record(prev.guildId, prev.rec.channelId, reposted.data.id));
          return { status: 200, body: { success: true, action: "reposted", channelId: prev.rec.channelId, guildId: prev.guildId, messageId: reposted.data.id, updated: false, moved: false, messageUrl: `https://discord.com/channels/${prev.guildId}/${prev.rec.channelId}/${reposted.data.id}` } };
        }

        // An existing panel that is NOT being moved: edit that exact message, wherever it lives.
        if (prev && prev.rec?.messageId && (!move || sameSpot(prev))) {
          const edit = await discordApi(`/channels/${prev.rec.channelId}/messages/${prev.rec.messageId}`, { method: "PATCH", body: payload });
          if (edit.ok) {
            await savePanel(hash, item.owner, prev.guildId, record(prev.guildId, prev.rec.channelId, prev.rec.messageId));
            return { status: 200, body: { success: true, action: "edited", channelId: prev.rec.channelId, guildId: prev.guildId, messageId: prev.rec.messageId, updated: true, moved: false, messageUrl: `https://discord.com/channels/${prev.guildId}/${prev.rec.channelId}/${prev.rec.messageId}` } };
          }
          if (edit.status !== 404) {
            // 403 / 5xx / rate limit: the message is probably still there, so NEVER post a second panel.
            return { status: 502, body: { error: edit.status === 403
              ? "The bot can't edit the panel in that channel. Give the bot View Channel + Send Messages there and try again."
              : (edit.data?.message || "Discord refused to update the panel. Try again in a moment.") } };
          }
          // 404: the message (or its channel) was really deleted on Discord. "Update" must never post a second
          // message by itself, so forget the dead record and tell the dashboard; it then offers "Post panel".
          await forgetPanel(prev.guildId, hash);
          return { status: 404, body: { gone: true, error: "That panel message no longer exists on Discord (it was deleted). Press \"Post panel to channel\" to post it again." } };
        }

        // First post, a deleted panel being re-posted, or an explicit move.
        const posted = await discordApi(`/channels/${channelId}/messages`, { method: "POST", body: payload });
        if (!posted.ok) return { status: 502, body: { error: posted.data?.message || "Discord rejected the panel. Check the bot's permissions in that channel." } };
        let moved = false;
        if (prev && move && prev.rec?.messageId && !sameSpot(prev)) { // moving: remove the old one so there is still only ONE panel
          moved = true;
          await discordApi(`/channels/${prev.rec.channelId}/messages/${prev.rec.messageId}`, { method: "DELETE" });
          if (prev.guildId !== String(guildId)) await forgetPanel(prev.guildId, hash);
        }
        await savePanel(hash, item.owner, guildId, record(guildId, channelId, posted.data.id));
        return { status: 200, body: { success: true, action: moved ? "moved" : "posted", channelId, guildId: String(guildId), messageId: posted.data.id, updated: false, moved, messageUrl: `https://discord.com/channels/${guildId}/${channelId}/${posted.data.id}` } };
      }

      // Dashboard: the logged-in owner can manage access for their own scripts.
      if (url.pathname === "/api/access" && request.method === "GET") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const hash = url.searchParams.get("hash") || "";
        if (!HASH_RE.test(hash)) return json({ error: "Invalid script" }, 400);
        const item = await projectForHash(hash);
        if (!item) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);
          if (String(item.owner) !== String(userId) && !OWNER_IDS.has(String(userId))) return json({ error: "Forbidden â€” this script is not on your account" }, 403);
        const [wlPage, blPage, keyRecs] = await Promise.all([
          env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: `accesswl_${item.owner}_${item.project.id}_` }),
          env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: `accessbl_${item.owner}_${item.project.id}_` }),
          listScriptKeys(hash)
        ]);
        const keys = await Promise.all(keyRecs.map(publicKeyRecord));
        const readList = async (page) => { const out=[]; for (const k of page.keys) { const raw=await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(k.name); if(raw) { try { const r=JSON.parse(raw); if (!r.expiresAt || Date.parse(r.expiresAt)>Date.now()) out.push(r); } catch (_) {} } } return out; };
        return json({ projectId: String(item.project.id), scriptName: item.script.name, keys, whitelist: await readList(wlPage), blacklist: await readList(blPage) });
      }
      if (url.pathname === "/api/access/key" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({})); const hash = String(body.hash || "");
        if (!HASH_RE.test(hash)) return json({ error: "Invalid script" }, 400);
        const item = await projectForHash(hash);
        if (!item) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);
          if (String(item.owner) !== String(userId) && !OWNER_IDS.has(String(userId))) return json({ error: "Forbidden â€” this script is not on your account" }, 403);
        const days = Number(body.days) || 0;
        const created = await createAccessKey(hash, item.project.id, item.owner, { expiresAt: accessExpires(days), maxRedemptions: body.maxRedemptions || 1, type: "dashboard" });
        return json({ success: true, key: created.plaintext, id: created.record.id, record: { ...(await publicKeyRecord(created.record)), key: created.plaintext } });
      }
      if (url.pathname === "/api/access/key/delete" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({})); const hash = String(body.hash || ""); const id = String(body.id || "");
        const item = await projectForHash(hash);
        if (!item) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);
          if (String(item.owner) !== String(userId) && !OWNER_IDS.has(String(userId))) return json({ error: "Forbidden â€” this script is not on your account" }, 403);
        let found = false;
        for (const r of await listScriptKeys(hash)) {
          if (r.id !== id) continue;
          const d = r.digest || null;
          if (d) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`accesskey_${d}`);
          else { const pg = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: "accesskey_" }); for (const k of pg.keys) { const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(k.name); try { if (raw && JSON.parse(raw).id === id) { await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(k.name); break; } } catch (_) {} } }
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`accesskeyidx_${hash}_${id}`);
          found = true; break;
        }
        return found ? json({ success: true }) : json({ error: "Key not found" }, 404);
      }
      for (const action of ["whitelist", "blacklist"]) {
        if (url.pathname === `/api/access/${action}` && request.method === "POST") {
          if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
          const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({})); const hash=String(body.hash||""); const discordId=String(body.discordId||"");
          if (!HASH_RE.test(hash) || !/^\d{15,22}$/.test(discordId)) return json({ error: "Enter a valid script and Discord user ID" }, 400);
          const item=await projectForHash(hash);
          if (!item) return json({ error: "Script not found â€” re-select the script, or re-upload if it was deleted" }, 404);
          if (String(item.owner) !== String(userId) && !OWNER_IDS.has(String(userId))) return json({ error: "This script is not on your account" }, 403);
          const days=Number(body.days)||0; const expiresAt=accessExpires(days); const prefix=action === "whitelist" ? "accesswl" : "accessbl";
          const record={ projectId:String(item.project.id), discordUserId:discordId, hash, createdAt:new Date().toISOString(), expiresAt, reason:String(body.reason||"").slice(0,200) };
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`${prefix}_${item.owner}_${item.project.id}_${discordId}`, JSON.stringify(record));
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`access_required_${hash}`, "true");
          if (action === "whitelist") {
            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`accessbl_${item.owner}_${item.project.id}_${discordId}`);
            const made=await createAccessKey(hash,item.project.id,item.owner,{ assignedDiscordId:discordId, expiresAt, maxRedemptions:1, type:"whitelist" });
            await notifyWhitelistLogs(item.owner, item.script.name, discordId, hash, "");
            return json({ success:true, key:made.plaintext, expiresAt });
          }
          // Blacklist clears whitelist + runtime access
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`accesswl_${item.owner}_${item.project.id}_${discordId}`);
          const access=await getAccess(item.owner,item.project.id,discordId);
          for (const token of Object.values(access?.accessTokens||{})) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`usertoken_${await sha256Hex(token)}`);
          if (access?.accessTokenHash) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`usertoken_${access.accessTokenHash}`);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`access_${item.owner}_${item.project.id}_${discordId}`);
          await notifyBlacklistLogs(item.owner, item.script.name, discordId, hash, "");
          return json({ success:true, expiresAt });
        }
      }

      for (const action of ["unwhitelist", "unblacklist"]) {
        if (url.pathname === `/api/access/${action}` && request.method === "POST") {
          if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
          const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
          const hash = String(body.hash || ""); const target = String(body.discordId || "");
          if (!HASH_RE.test(hash) || !/^\d{15,22}$/.test(target)) return json({ error: "Enter a valid script and Discord user ID" }, 400);
          const item = await projectForHash(hash);
          if (!item) return json({ error: "Script not found â€” re-select the script, or re-upload if it was deleted" }, 404);
          if (String(item.owner) !== String(userId) && !OWNER_IDS.has(String(userId))) return json({ error: "This script is not on your account" }, 403);
          const ownerId = item.owner;

          if (action === "unwhitelist") {
            const wlKey = `accesswl_${ownerId}_${item.project.id}_${target}`;
            if (!(await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(wlKey))) return json({ error: "That user isn't whitelisted on this script." }, 404);
            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(wlKey);
            const access = await getAccess(ownerId, item.project.id, target);
            let stillHasAccess = false;
            if (access?.viaKey) stillHasAccess = true; // access earned by redeeming a key is kept
            else if (access) {
              for (const token of Object.values(access.accessTokens || {})) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`usertoken_${await sha256Hex(token)}`);
              if (access.accessTokenHash) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`usertoken_${access.accessTokenHash}`);
              await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`access_${ownerId}_${item.project.id}_${target}`);
            }
            await deleteAccessMessages("whitelist", hash, target);
            await notifyOwnerLogs(ownerId, `<@${target}> was removed from the whitelist of script *${String(item.script.name).slice(0,100)}*.`, target);
            return json({ success: true, stillHasAccess });
          }

          const blKey = `accessbl_${ownerId}_${item.project.id}_${target}`;
          if (!(await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(blKey))) return json({ error: "That user isn't blacklisted on this script." }, 404);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(blKey);
          let restored = false;
          const bakKey = `accessbak_${ownerId}_${item.project.id}_${target}`;
          const bakRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(bakKey);
          if (bakRaw) {
            try {
              const bak = JSON.parse(bakRaw);
              if (!bak.expiresAt || Date.parse(bak.expiresAt) > Date.now()) {
                for (const h of (bak.hashes || [])) { await issueRuntimeToken(h, ownerId, item.project.id, target, bak.expiresAt || null, true); restored = true; }
              }
            } catch (_) {}
            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(bakKey);
          }
          await deleteAccessMessages("blacklist", hash, target);
          await notifyOwnerLogs(ownerId, `<@${target}> was removed from the blacklist of script *${String(item.script.name).slice(0,100)}*.`, target);
          return json({ success: true, restored });
        }
      }

      // Private Worker API used by the Discord bot. All routes require BOT_SECRET.
      if (url.pathname.startsWith("/api/bot/")) {
        if (!(await botAuth())) return json({ error: "Unauthorized bot request" }, 401);
        const route = url.pathname.slice("/api/bot/".length);
        
        if (route === "link-api" && request.method === "POST") {
          const b=await request.json().catch(()=>({})); const discordId=String(b.discordId||""); const apikey=String(b.apikey||"");
          const ownerId=await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`apikey_${apikey}`); const owner=ownerId ? await getUser(ownerId) : null;
          if (!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(discordId) || !owner || owner.apiKey!==apikey) return json({ error:"API key not found" },401);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`botlink_${discordId}`,ownerId);
          if (/^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(b.guildId || ""))) await linkGuildToOwner(String(b.guildId), ownerId);
          const doc=await getProjectsDoc(ownerId);
          return json({ success:true, username:owner.username, plan:effectivePlan(owner), projects:(doc?.projects||[]).map(p=>({id:p.id,name:p.name,scripts:(p.scripts||[]).map(sc=>({id:sc.id,name:sc.name,hash:sc.hash}))})) });
        }
        
        if (route === "unlink" && request.method === "POST") { 
          const b=await request.json().catch(()=>({})); 
          const discordId=String(b.discordId||""); const guildId=String(b.guildId||"");
          // Without a guild: old behaviour (drop the caller's personal link).
          if(!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(guildId)){ await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`botlink_${discordId}`); return json({success:true}); }
          // With a guild: only the linked owner of that server may unlink it, and the server's settings are reset.
          const linked=await linkedOwner(discordId);
          const guildOwner=await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`guildowner_${guildId}`);
          if(!linked) return json({error:"Only the linked owner of this server can unlink it."},401);
          if(!guildOwner) return json({error:"This server isn't linked."},404);
          if(guildOwner!==linked.ownerId) return json({error:"This server is linked to a different Luavify account."},403);
          const del=async(prefix,extra)=>{ let cursor; do { const r=await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({prefix,cursor}); for(const k of r.keys){ if(extra) await extra(k.name); await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(k.name); } cursor=r.list_complete?undefined:r.cursor; } while(cursor); };
          await del(`panel_${guildId}_`, async(name)=>{ const hash=name.slice(`panel_${guildId}_`.length); const sp=await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`scriptpanel_${hash}`); try{ if(sp && String(JSON.parse(sp).guildId)===guildId) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`scriptpanel_${hash}`); }catch(_){} });
          await del(`panelowner_${guildId}_`);
          await del(`buyerrole_${guildId}_`);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`botperm_${guildId}`);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`botlog_${guildId}`);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`botlogowner_${linked.ownerId}_${guildId}`);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`guildowner_${guildId}`);
          const og=await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`ownerguilds_${linked.ownerId}`);
          try{ const ids=og?JSON.parse(og):[]; await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`ownerguilds_${linked.ownerId}`, JSON.stringify(ids.filter(x=>x!==guildId))); }catch(_){}
          return json({success:true}); 
        }
        
        if (route === "guild-status" && request.method === "GET") {
          const gid = String(url.searchParams.get("guildId") || "");
          if (!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(gid)) return json({ linked: false });
          const ownerId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`guildowner_${gid}`);
          return json({ linked: !!ownerId });
        }

        if (route === "projects" && request.method === "GET") {
          // Linked owner, or staff whose Discord role is one of this server's manager roles.
          const mgr=await resolveManager(String(url.searchParams.get("discordId")||""), String(url.searchParams.get("guildId")||""), String(url.searchParams.get("roleIds")||"").split(",").filter(Boolean));
          if(!mgr) return json({error:"Link your API key with /linkapi first, or ask the owner to give your role bot access in the dashboard."},401);
          const doc=await getProjectsDoc(mgr.ownerId);
          return json({projects:(doc?.projects||[]).map(p=>({id:p.id,name:p.name,scripts:(p.scripts||[]).map(sc=>({id:sc.id,name:sc.name,hash:sc.hash}))}))});
        }
        
        if (route === "panel-pending" && request.method === "POST") {
          const b = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
          const key = `panelpending_${b.discordId}_${b.guildId}`;
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(key, JSON.stringify({
            title: b.title || "Buyer Control Panel",
            description: b.description || "Use the buttons below to redeem a key, reset your HWID, get your loadstring, or view your info.",
          }), { expirationTtl: 600 });
          return json({ success: true });
        }
        
        if (route === "panel-pending" && request.method === "GET") {
          const key = `panelpending_${url.searchParams.get("discordId")}_${url.searchParams.get("guildId")}`;
          const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(key);
          return json(raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {});
        }

        // Posts the buyer panel for a script. A script can only have ONE panel (409 if it already has one).
        if (route === "post-panel" && request.method === "POST") {
          const b = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
          const linked = await linkedOwner(String(b.discordId || ""));
          if (!linked) return json({ error: "Link API key first" }, 401);
          const hash = String(b.scriptHash || ""), guildId = String(b.guildId || ""), channelId = String(b.channelId || "");
          if (!HASH_RE.test(hash) || !/^\d{15,22}$/.test(guildId) || !/^\d{15,22}$/.test(channelId)) return json({ error: "Invalid script, server or channel" }, 400);
          const item = await projectForHash(hash);
          if (!item || item.owner !== linked.ownerId) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);
          const title = String(b.title || "").trim().slice(0, 256) || PANEL_DEFAULT_TITLE;
          const description = String(b.description || "").trim().slice(0, 4000) || PANEL_DEFAULT_DESC;
          const out = await publishPanel({ item, guildId, channelId, title, description, style: {}, buttons: undefined, mode: "setup" });
          return json(out.body, out.status);
        }

        // Kept so an older bot build that posts the message itself still registers its panel.
        if (route === "panel-setup" && request.method === "POST") {
          const b = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
          const linked = await linkedOwner(String(b.discordId || ""));
          if (!linked) return json({ error: "Link API key first" }, 401);
          await savePanel(String(b.scriptHash), linked.ownerId, String(b.guildId), {
            channelId: b.channelId, messageId: b.messageId, title: b.title || PANEL_DEFAULT_TITLE,
            description: b.description || PANEL_DEFAULT_DESC, scriptHash: b.scriptHash, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          });
          return json({ success: true });
        }

        if (route === "set-buyer-role" && request.method === "POST") { 
          const b=await request.json().catch(()=>({})); 
          const mgr=await resolveManager(String(b.callerDiscordId||""), String(b.guildId||""), b.callerRoleIds); 
          if(!mgr)return json({error:"Link API key first, or ask the owner to grant your role manage permissions."},401); 
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`buyerrole_${b.guildId}_${b.scriptHash}`,String(b.roleId)); 
          return json({success:true}); 
        }
        
        if (route === "set-manager-roles" && request.method === "POST") {
          const b=await request.json().catch(()=>({}));
          const linked=await linkedOwner(String(b.callerDiscordId||""));
          if(!linked) return json({error:"Only the linked owner can set manager roles. Run /linkapi first."},401);
          const guildId=String(b.guildId||"");
          if(!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(guildId)) return json({error:"Invalid guild"},400);
          const roleIds=Array.isArray(b.roleIds)?b.roleIds.map(String).slice(0,10):[];
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`botperm_${guildId}`, JSON.stringify(roleIds));
          await linkGuildToOwner(guildId, linked.ownerId);
          return json({success:true});
        }

        if (route === "buyer-role" && request.method === "GET") { 
          const roleId=await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`buyerrole_${url.searchParams.get("guildId")}_${url.searchParams.get("scriptHash")}`); 
          return json({roleId:roleId||null}); 
        }

        if (route === "generate-key" && request.method === "POST") {
          const b=await request.json().catch(()=>({})); 
          const mgr=await resolveManager(String(b.callerDiscordId||""), String(b.guildId||""), b.callerRoleIds); 
          if(!mgr) return json({error:"Link your API key first, or ask the owner to grant your role manage permissions."},401);
          const hash=String(b.scriptHash||"");
          if(!HASH_RE.test(hash)) return json({error:"Invalid script hash"},400);
          const item=await projectForHash(hash);
          if (!item || item.owner !== mgr.ownerId) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);
          
          const lifetime=!!b.lifetime; const days=lifetime?0:Number(b.days)||0;
          const expiresAt=lifetime?null:accessExpires(days);
          const created=await createAccessKey(hash,item.project.id,mgr.ownerId,{expiresAt,durationDays:days,maxRedemptions:b.maxRedemptions||1,type:lifetime?"permanent":"time_limited"});
          return json({key:{plaintext:created.plaintext,id:created.record.id},scriptHash:hash});
        }

        if (route === "whitelist" && request.method === "POST") {
          const b=await request.json().catch(()=>({})); 
          const mgr=await resolveManager(String(b.callerDiscordId||""), String(b.guildId||""), b.callerRoleIds); 
          if(!mgr) return json({error:"Link your API key first, or ask the owner to grant your role manage permissions."},401);
          const hash=String(b.scriptHash||""); const target=String(b.targetDiscordId||"");
          if(!HASH_RE.test(hash) || !/^\d{15,22}$/.test(target)) return json({error:"Invalid script or user ID"},400);
          const item=await projectForHash(hash);
          if (!item || item.owner !== mgr.ownerId) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);
          
          const lifetime=!!b.lifetime; const days=lifetime?0:Number(b.days)||0;
          const expiresAt=lifetime?null:accessExpires(days);
          
          const wlPid = String(item.project.id);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`accesswl_${mgr.ownerId}_${wlPid}_${target}`, JSON.stringify({projectId:wlPid,discordUserId:String(target),hash,createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),expiresAt,reason:String(b.reason||"").slice(0,200),guildId:/^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(b.guildId||""))?String(b.guildId):undefined}));
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`accessbl_${mgr.ownerId}_${wlPid}_${target}`);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`access_required_${hash}`,"true");
          
          await notifyWhitelistLogs(mgr.ownerId, item.script.name, target, hash, String(b.guildId || ""), String(b.channelId || ""));
          return json({success:true, scriptName:item.script.name, projectName:item.project.name, lifetime, days, expiresAt});
        }

        if (route === "blacklist" && request.method === "POST") {
          const b=await request.json().catch(()=>({})); 
          const mgr=await resolveManager(String(b.callerDiscordId||""), String(b.guildId||""), b.callerRoleIds); 
          if(!mgr) return json({error:"Link your API key first, or ask the owner to grant your role manage permissions."},401);
          const hash=String(b.scriptHash||""); const target=String(b.targetDiscordId||"");
          if(!HASH_RE.test(hash) || !/^\d{15,22}$/.test(target)) return json({error:"Invalid script or user ID"},400);
          const item=await projectForHash(hash);
          if (!item || item.owner !== mgr.ownerId) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);
          
          const lifetime=!!b.lifetime; const days=lifetime?0:Number(b.days)||0;
          const expiresAt=lifetime?null:accessExpires(days);
          
          const blPid = String(item.project.id);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`accessbl_${mgr.ownerId}_${blPid}_${target}`, JSON.stringify({projectId:blPid,discordUserId:String(target),hash,createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),expiresAt,reason:String(b.reason||"").slice(0,200)}));
          // Blacklist wins: remove whitelist so Key Info / panel no longer show "whitelisted"
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`accesswl_${mgr.ownerId}_${blPid}_${target}`);
          try {
            const g = String(b.guildId || "");
            if (/^\d{15,22}$/.test(g)) await revokeBuyerRole(g, target, hash);
          } catch (_) {}
          
          const access=await getAccess(mgr.ownerId,blPid,target);
          if(access?.viaKey) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`accessbak_${mgr.ownerId}_${item.project.id}_${target}`, JSON.stringify({hashes:Object.keys(access.accessTokens||{}),expiresAt:access.expiresAt||null}));
          for(const token of Object.values(access?.accessTokens||{})) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`usertoken_${await sha256Hex(token)}`);
          if(access?.accessTokenHash) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`usertoken_${access.accessTokenHash}`);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`access_${mgr.ownerId}_${item.project.id}_${target}`);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`access_required_${hash}`,"true");
          
          await notifyBlacklistLogs(mgr.ownerId, item.script.name, target, hash, String(b.guildId || ""), String(b.channelId || ""));
          return json({success:true, scriptName:item.script.name, projectName:item.project.name, lifetime, days, expiresAt});
        }

        // Whitelists a batch of users at once (used by /masswhitelist). Sends NO log message.
        // Users who are currently blacklisted are skipped, not un-blacklisted. The bot sends batches of <= 20
        // Bot should batch; server accepts up to 50 ids per request.
        if (route === "masswhitelist" && request.method === "POST") {
          const b=await request.json().catch(()=>({}));
          const mgr=await resolveManager(String(b.callerDiscordId||""), String(b.guildId||""), b.callerRoleIds);
          if(!mgr) return json({error:"Link your API key first, or ask the owner to grant your role manage permissions."},401);
          const hash=String(b.scriptHash||"");
          if(!HASH_RE.test(hash)) return json({error:"Invalid script"},400);
          const ids=[...new Set((Array.isArray(b.userIds)?b.userIds:[]).map(String).filter(x=>/^\d{15,22}$/.test(x)))];
          if(!ids.length) return json({error:"No users given"},400);
          if(ids.length>50) return json({error:"Send at most 50 users per request"},400);
          const item=await projectForHash(hash);
          if (!item || item.owner !== mgr.ownerId) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);

          const lifetime=!!b.lifetime; const days=lifetime?0:Number(b.days)||0;
          const expiresAt=lifetime?null:accessExpires(days);
          const reason=String(b.reason||"").slice(0,200);
          const guildId=/^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(b.guildId||""))?String(b.guildId):undefined;

          let whitelisted=0, skippedBlacklisted=0;
          for(const target of ids) {
            const blRaw=await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`accessbl_${mgr.ownerId}_${item.project.id}_${target}`);
            let bl=null; try{bl=blRaw?JSON.parse(blRaw):null}catch(_){}
            if(bl && (!bl.expiresAt||Date.parse(bl.expiresAt)>Date.now())) { skippedBlacklisted++; continue; }
            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`accesswl_${mgr.ownerId}_${item.project.id}_${target}`, JSON.stringify({projectId:String(item.project.id),discordUserId:target,hash,createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),expiresAt,reason,guildId}));
            whitelisted++;
          }
          if(whitelisted) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`access_required_${hash}`,"true");
          // /masswhitelist group notice:
          //   @buyerrole **You have all been whitelisted!** Access the script via this channel ---> #panel
          if (whitelisted > 0 && env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN) {
            try {
              const g = String(b.guildId || "");
              let panelChannelId = "";
              let buyerRoleId = null;
              const found = await findPanel(hash);
              if (found?.rec?.channelId) panelChannelId = String(found.rec.channelId);
              const roleGuild = g || String(found?.guildId || "");
              if (/^\d{15,22}$/.test(roleGuild)) {
                const rid = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`buyerrole_${roleGuild}_${hash}`);
                if (rid && /^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(rid))) buyerRoleId = String(rid);
              }
              // Give buyer role to everyone just mass-whitelisted (when role is configured).
              if (buyerRoleId && /^\d{15,22}$/.test(g)) {
                for (const target of ids) {
                  try {
                    await discordApi(`/guilds/${g}/members/${target}/roles/${buyerRoleId}`, { method: "PUT" });
                    await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(
                      `buyerrolegrant_${g}_${target}_${hash}`,
                      JSON.stringify({ roleId: buyerRoleId, hash, guildId: g, userId: target, expiresAt: expiresAt || null, grantedAt: new Date().toISOString() })
                    );
                  } catch (_) {}
                }
              }
              const rolePart = buyerRoleId ? `<@&${buyerRoleId}> ` : "";
              const channelPart = panelChannelId ? `<#${panelChannelId}>` : "the panel";
              const content = `${rolePart}**You have all been whitelisted!** Access the script via this channel ---> ${channelPart}`;
              const mentions = buyerRoleId ? { roles: [buyerRoleId] } : { parse: [] };
              const msgBody = { content: content.slice(0, 1900), flags: 4, allowed_mentions: mentions };
              // Prefer: 1) channel where /masswhitelist was run  2) panel channel  3) /setlog channel
              const targets = new Set();
              if (/^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(b.channelId || ""))) targets.add(String(b.channelId));
              if (/^\d{15,22}$/.test(panelChannelId)) targets.add(panelChannelId);
              if (/^\d{15,22}$/.test(g)) {
                const ch = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`botlog_${g}`);
                if (ch) targets.add(String(ch));
              }
              if (!targets.size && found?.guildId) {
                const ch = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`botlog_${found.guildId}`);
                if (ch) targets.add(String(ch));
              }
              for (const chId of targets) {
                const r = await discordApi(`/channels/${chId}/messages`, { method: "POST", body: msgBody });
                if (!r.ok) console.warn("masswhitelist notice post failed", chId, r.status, JSON.stringify(r.data || {}).slice(0, 200));
              }
            } catch (e) { console.warn("masswhitelist notice failed:", e?.message || e); }
          }
          return json({success:true, scriptName:item.script.name, projectName:item.project.name, whitelisted, skippedBlacklisted, lifetime, days, expiresAt});
        }

        // Mass-whitelist everyone who currently has a Discord role (server-side member pagination).
        // Avoids Discord bot client timeouts when listing members with a role.
        // Body: { callerDiscordId, guildId, callerRoleIds, scriptHash, roleId, lifetime?, days?, channelId? }
        if (route === "masswhitelist-role" && request.method === "POST") {
          const b = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
          const mgr = await resolveManager(String(b.callerDiscordId || ""), String(b.guildId || ""), b.callerRoleIds);
          if (!mgr) return json({ error: "Link your API key first, or ask the owner to grant your role manage permissions." }, 401);
          const hash = String(b.scriptHash || "");
          const guildId = String(b.guildId || "");
          const roleId = String(b.roleId || "");
          if (!HASH_RE.test(hash)) return json({ error: "Invalid script" }, 400);
          if (!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(guildId)) return json({ error: "Invalid guild" }, 400);
          if (!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(roleId)) return json({ error: "Invalid role" }, 400);
          if (!env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN) return json({ error: "Bot token not configured" }, 500);
          const item = await projectForHash(hash);
          if (!item || item.owner !== mgr.ownerId) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);

          const lifetime = !!b.lifetime;
          const days = lifetime ? 0 : Number(b.days) || 0;
          const expiresAt = lifetime ? null : accessExpires(days);
          const reason = String(b.reason || "masswhitelist-role").slice(0, 200);

          // Paginate guild members (requires Server Members Intent on the bot)
          const memberIds = [];
          let after = "0";
          let pages = 0;
          const maxPages = 30; // up to ~30k members
          while (pages < maxPages) {
            pages++;
            const path = `/guilds/${guildId}/members?limit=1000` + (after !== "0" ? `&after=${after}` : "");
            const r = await discordApi(path, { method: "GET" });
            if (!r.ok) {
              const errMsg = (r.data && (r.data.message || r.data.error)) || ("Discord members fetch failed (" + r.status + ")");
              // Missing privileged intent
              if (r.status === 403) {
                return json({
                  error: "Cannot list members (403). Enable Server Members Intent for the bot in Discord Developer Portal, then re-invite the bot.",
                  discordStatus: 403,
                }, 403);
              }
              return json({ error: String(errMsg), discordStatus: r.status }, 502);
            }
            const list = Array.isArray(r.data) ? r.data : [];
            if (!list.length) break;
            for (const m of list) {
              const uid = m && m.user && m.user.id ? String(m.user.id) : "";
              const roles = Array.isArray(m && m.roles) ? m.roles.map(String) : [];
              if (uid && roles.includes(roleId)) memberIds.push(uid);
            }
            after = String(list[list.length - 1].user?.id || "");
            if (list.length < 1000) break;
            // brief yield between pages to reduce rate-limit hits
            await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 350));
          }

          const unique = [...new Set(memberIds)];
          let whitelisted = 0, skippedBlacklisted = 0, roleGranted = 0, roleFailed = 0;

          // Process in chunks of 25
          for (let i = 0; i < unique.length; i += 25) {
            const chunk = unique.slice(i, i + 25);
            for (const target of chunk) {
              const blRaw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`accessbl_${mgr.ownerId}_${item.project.id}_${target}`);
              let bl = null;
              try { bl = blRaw ? JSON.parse(blRaw) : null; } catch (_) {}
              if (bl && (!bl.expiresAt || Date.parse(bl.expiresAt) > Date.now())) {
                skippedBlacklisted++;
                continue;
              }
              await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(
                `accesswl_${mgr.ownerId}_${item.project.id}_${target}`,
                JSON.stringify({
                  projectId: String(item.project.id),
                  discordUserId: target,
                  hash,
                  createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                  expiresAt,
                  reason,
                  guildId,
                })
              );
              whitelisted++;
              // grant buyer role if different from the filter role, or same (ensure kept)
              try {
                let buyerRoleId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`buyerrole_${guildId}_${hash}`);
                if (!buyerRoleId) buyerRoleId = roleId;
                if (buyerRoleId && /^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(buyerRoleId))) {
                  const put = await discordApi(
                    `/guilds/${guildId}/members/${target}/roles/${buyerRoleId}`,
                    { method: "PUT" }
                  );
                  if (put.ok) {
                    roleGranted++;
                    await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(
                      `buyerrolegrant_${guildId}_${target}_${hash}`,
                      JSON.stringify({
                        roleId: String(buyerRoleId),
                        hash,
                        guildId,
                        userId: target,
                        expiresAt: expiresAt || null,
                        grantedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                      })
                    );
                  } else roleFailed++;
                }
              } catch (_) { roleFailed++; }
            }
            if (i + 25 < unique.length) await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 400));
          }

          if (whitelisted) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`access_required_${hash}`, "true");

          // Notice in channel
          if (whitelisted > 0) {
            try {
              let panelChannelId = "";
              const found = await findPanel(hash);
              if (found?.rec?.channelId) panelChannelId = String(found.rec.channelId);
              const channelPart = panelChannelId ? `<#${panelChannelId}>` : "the panel";
              const content = `<@&${roleId}> **You have all been whitelisted!** Access the script via this channel ---> ${channelPart}`;
              const msgBody = {
                content: content.slice(0, 1900),
                flags: 4,
                allowed_mentions: { roles: [roleId] },
              };
              const targets = new Set();
              if (/^\d{15,22}$/.test(String(b.channelId || ""))) targets.add(String(b.channelId));
              if (/^\d{15,22}$/.test(panelChannelId)) targets.add(panelChannelId);
              const logCh = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`botlog_${guildId}`);
              if (logCh) targets.add(String(logCh));
              for (const chId of targets) {
                await discordApi(`/channels/${chId}/messages`, { method: "POST", body: msgBody });
              }
            } catch (e) {
              console.warn("masswhitelist-role notice failed:", e?.message || e);
            }
          }

          return json({
            success: true,
            scriptName: item.script.name,
            projectName: item.project.name,
            scanned: unique.length,
            whitelisted,
            skippedBlacklisted,
            roleGranted,
            roleFailed,
            lifetime,
            days,
            expiresAt,
          });
        }

            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`access_${mgr.ownerId}_${item.project.id}_${target}`);
          }
          await deleteAccessMessages("whitelist", hash, target);
          await notifyOwnerLogs(mgr.ownerId, `<@${target}> was removed from the whitelist of script *${String(item.script.name).slice(0,100)}*.`, target);
          return json({success:true, scriptName:item.script.name, projectName:item.project.name, stillHasAccess});
        }

        if (route === "unblacklist" && request.method === "POST") {

        if (route === "redeem" && request.method === "POST") {

            blacklistExpiresAt: pa.activeBl ? (pa.bl?.expiresAt || null) : null,
            keyStatus: pa.keyAccess ? "Active" : "ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â",
            expiresAt: (pa.keyAccess ? access?.expiresAt : null) || (pa.activeWl ? wl?.expiresAt : null) || null,

        if (route === "set-log" && request.method === "POST") {
