      // ==========================================
      // Discord Bot settings ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â dashboard (session-authenticated) side.
      // Lets the owner connect servers, pick a channel to post the panel in,
      // style the panel, set the buyer role, cap self-service HWID resets,
      // and decide which Discord roles can use the bot's moderation commands.
      // ==========================================
      if (url.pathname.startsWith("/api/discordbot/")) {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const route = url.pathname.slice("/api/discordbot/".length);

        if (route === "servers" && request.method === "GET") {
          const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`ownerguilds_${userId}`);
          let ids = []; try { ids = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : []; } catch (_) { ids = []; }
          const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
          // Sequential guild fetches avoid Discord 429 when several servers are linked.
          const servers = [];
          let tokenMissing = false;
          for (const gid of ids) {
            let g = await discordApi(`/guilds/${gid}`);
            if (!g.ok && g.status === 0) {
              tokenMissing = true;
            }
            if (!g.ok && (g.status === 429 || g.status >= 500 || g.status === 0)) {
              await sleep(Math.min(2500, Math.ceil(Number(g.data?.retry_after || 1) * 1000)));
              g = await discordApi(`/guilds/${gid}`);
            }
            if (g.ok) {
              servers.push({
                id: gid,
                name: g.data.name,
                icon: g.data.icon
                  ? `https://cdn.discordapp.com/icons/${gid}/${g.data.icon}.${String(g.data.icon).startsWith("a_") ? "gif" : "png"}?size=128`
                  : null,
              });
              continue;
            }
            if (g.status === 404 || g.status === 403) {
              servers.push({ id: gid, name: `Server ${gid}`, icon: null, unreachable: true, status: g.status });
              continue;
            }
            // 401 = bad bot token; 429 after retry = rate limit; else unknown
            servers.push({
              id: gid,
              name: g.status === 401 ? "Bot token rejected" : `Server ${gid}`,
              icon: null,
              unknown: true,
              status: g.status,
              error: g.data?.message || g.data?.error || null,
            });
            await sleep(300);
          }
          return json({
            servers,
            appMismatch: botAppMismatch(),
            botAppId: botTokenAppId(),
            inviteAppId: String(env.DISCORD_CLIENT_ID || ""),
            tokenConfigured: !!env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN,
            tokenMissing,
          });
        }

        // Servers are linked automatically when the bot is added through /auth/bot-add
        // (which verifies the user can manage the server). Manual "connect by ID" was removed
        // because it let anyone claim a server the bot was in.
        if (route === "remove-server" && request.method === "POST") {
          const b = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));

          const [chRes, roleRes] = await Promise.all([discordApi(`/guilds/${guildId}/channels`), discordApi(`/guilds/${guildId}/roles`)]);

        if (route === "post-panel" && request.method === "POST") {

          if (!item) return json({ error: "Script not found â€” re-select the script, or re-upload if it was deleted" }, 404);
          if (String(item.owner) !== String(userId) && !OWNER_IDS.has(String(userId))) return json({ error: "This script is not on your account" }, 403);
          if (!(await ownsGuild(userId, guildId))) return json({ error: "Connect that server first â€” use Add bot" }, 403);

          const title = String(b.title || "").trim().slice(0, 256) || PANEL_DEFAULT_TITLE;

          if (b.thumbnail && !isHttpUrl(b.thumbnail)) return json({ error: "Thumbnail URL must be a valid http(s) link (max 2048 characters)." }, 400);
          if (b.image && !isHttpUrl(b.image)) return json({ error: "Image URL must be a valid http(s) link (max 2048 characters)." }, 400);
          const style = { color: b.color || "", topLine: String(b.topLine || "").slice(0, 256), footer: String(b.footer || "").slice(0, 2048), thumbnail: cleanUrl(b.thumbnail), image: cleanUrl(b.image), layout: b.layout === PANEL_LAYOUT_V2 ? PANEL_LAYOUT_V2 : "embed" };
          let buttons;
          if (b.buttons !== undefined) {
            const nb = normalizePanelButtons(b.buttons);
            if (nb.error) return json({ error: nb.error }, 400);
            buttons = nb.buttons;
          }
          // One panel per script: edits the posted message in place. It only moves when the dashboard asks for it (move: true).
          const ownerUser = await getUser(userId);
          const poster = ownerUser ? {
            id: ownerUser.id || userId,
            username: ownerUser.username || ownerUser.global_name || "user",
            global_name: ownerUser.global_name,
            avatar: ownerUser.avatar,
          } : { id: userId, username: "user" };
          const out = await publishPanel({ item, guildId, channelId, title, description, style, buttons, mode: "update", move: b.move === true, poster });
          return json(out.body, out.status);
        }

        if (route === "set-buyer-role" && request.method === "POST") {
          const b = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
          const hash = String(b.scriptHash || ""); const guildId = String(b.guildId || ""); const roleId = String(b.roleId || "");
          if (!HASH_RE.test(hash) || !/^\d{15,22}$/.test(guildId) || (roleId && !/^\d{15,22}$/.test(roleId))) return json({ error: "Invalid script, server or role" }, 400);
          const item = await projectForHash(hash);
          if (!item) return json({ error: "Script not found â€” re-select the script, or re-upload if it was deleted" }, 404);
          if (String(item.owner) !== String(userId) && !OWNER_IDS.has(String(userId))) return json({ error: "This script is not on your account" }, 403);
          if (!(await ownsGuild(userId, guildId))) return json({ error: "Connect that server first â€” use Add bot" }, 403);
          if (roleId) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`buyerrole_${guildId}_${hash}`, roleId);
          else await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`buyerrole_${guildId}_${hash}`); // "None" clears it
          return json({ success: true, roleId: roleId || null });
        }

        // Dashboard read of the saved buyer role (same key the bot's panel button uses).
        if (route === "buyer-role" && request.method === "GET") {
          const hash = url.searchParams.get("scriptHash") || ""; const guildId = url.searchParams.get("guildId") || "";
          if (!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(guildId)) return json({ roleId: null });
          const item = await projectForHash(hash);
          if (!item || (String(item.owner) !== String(userId) && !OWNER_IDS.has(String(userId)))) {
            return json({ roleId: null });
          }
          const roleId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`buyerrole_${guildId}_${hash}`);
          return json({ roleId: roleId || null });
        }

        if (route === "manager-roles" && request.method === "GET") {
          const guildId = url.searchParams.get("guildId") || "";
          if (!(await ownsGuild(userId, guildId))) return json({ error: "Forbidden â€” reconnect the bot with Add bot on this server" }, 403);
          const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`botperm_${guildId}`);
          let roleIds = []; try { roleIds = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : []; } catch (_) { roleIds = []; }
          return json({ roleIds });
        }

        if (route === "manager-roles" && request.method === "POST") {
          const b = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
          const guildId = String(b.guildId || "");
          if (!(await ownsGuild(userId, guildId))) return json({ error: "Forbidden â€” reconnect the bot with Add bot on this server" }, 403);
          const roleIds = Array.isArray(b.roleIds) ? b.roleIds.map(String).slice(0, 10) : [];
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`botperm_${guildId}`, JSON.stringify(roleIds));
          return json({ success: true });
        }

        // Log channel (same keys the bot's /setlog writes), so the website and the bot always agree.
        if (route === "log-channel" && request.method === "GET") {
          const guildId = url.searchParams.get("guildId") || "";
          if (!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(guildId)) return json({ error: "Invalid server" }, 400);
          if (!(await ownsGuild(userId, guildId))) return json({ error: "Forbidden â€” reconnect the bot with Add bot on this server" }, 403);
          const channelId = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`botlog_${guildId}`);
          return json({ channelId: channelId || null });
        }

        if (route === "log-channel" && request.method === "POST") {
          const b = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
          const guildId = String(b.guildId || ""); const channelId = String(b.channelId || "");
          if (!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(guildId) || (channelId && !/^\d{15,22}$/.test(channelId))) return json({ error: "Invalid server or channel" }, 400);
          if (!(await ownsGuild(userId, guildId))) return json({ error: "Forbidden â€” reconnect the bot with Add bot on this server" }, 403);
          const ownerId = (await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`guildowner_${guildId}`)) || userId;
          if (!channelId) { // "None" turns logging off
            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`botlog_${guildId}`);
            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`botlogowner_${ownerId}_${guildId}`);
            return json({ success: true, channelId: null });
          }
          const ch = await discordApi(`/channels/${channelId}`);
          if (!ch.ok || String(ch.data?.guild_id || "") !== guildId) return json({ error: "That channel isn't in this server, or the bot can't see it." }, 400);
          const sent = await discordApi(`/channels/${channelId}/messages`, { method: "POST", body: { content: "ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Â¦ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€œÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¦ Luavify logs will appear in this channel.", allowed_mentions: { parse: [] } } });
          if (!sent.ok) return json({ error: "The bot can't send messages in that channel. Give it View Channel + Send Messages there." }, 400);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`botlog_${guildId}`, channelId);
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`botlogowner_${ownerId}_${guildId}`, channelId);
          return json({ success: true, channelId });
        }

        if (route === "hwid-limit" && request.method === "GET") {
          const hash = url.searchParams.get("scriptHash") || "";
          const item = await projectForHash(hash);
          if (!item || (String(item.owner) !== String(userId) && !OWNER_IDS.has(String(userId)))) {
            return json({ resets: 1, days: 5 });
          }
          const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`hwidlimit_${item.owner}_${item.project.id}`);
          let cfg = { resets: 1, days: 5 }; try { cfg = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : cfg; } catch (_) {}
          return json(cfg);
        }

        if (route === "hwid-limit" && request.method === "POST") {
          const b = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
          const hash = String(b.scriptHash || "");
          const item = await projectForHash(hash);
          if (!item) return json({ error: "Script not found â€” re-select the script, or re-upload if it was deleted" }, 404);
          if (String(item.owner) !== String(userId) && !OWNER_IDS.has(String(userId))) return json({ error: "This script is not on your account" }, 403);
          const resets = Math.max(0, Math.min(1000, Number(b.resets) || 0));
          const days = Math.max(1, Math.min(365, Number(b.days) || 5));
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`hwidlimit_${item.owner}_${item.project.id}`, JSON.stringify({ resets, days }));
          return json({ success: true });
        }

        // The script's ONE panel (wherever it lives), with every button filled in.
        if (route === "panel-style" && request.method === "GET") {
          const hash = url.searchParams.get("scriptHash") || "";
          const item = await projectForHash(hash);
          if (!item) {
            // Soft empty so the Discord Bot page does not spam "Script not found"
            return json({ title: "", description: "", style: {}, buttons: PANEL_BUTTON_DEFAULTS, guildId: null, messageUrl: null });
          }
          if (String(item.owner) !== String(userId) && !OWNER_IDS.has(String(userId))) {
            return json({ title: "", description: "", style: {}, buttons: PANEL_BUTTON_DEFAULTS, guildId: null, messageUrl: null });
          }
          const found = await findPanel(hash);
          const rec = found?.rec || {};
          return json({ ...rec, guildId: found?.guildId || null, messageUrl: found && rec.messageId ? `https://discord.com/channels/${found.guildId}/${rec.channelId}/${rec.messageId}` : null, buttons: normalizePanelButtons(rec.buttons).buttons || PANEL_BUTTON_DEFAULTS });
        }

        return json({ error: "Unknown route" }, 404);
      }

      // Resolves Discord usernames + avatars for the dashboard (whitelist/blacklist tables, admin panel).
      // Batches up to 50 IDs per call and caches each lookup for a day to stay within Discord's rate limits.
      if (url.pathname === "/api/discord/resolve-users" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const b = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
        const ids = Array.isArray(b.ids) ? [...new Set(b.ids.map(String))].filter(id => /^\d{15,22}$/.test(id)).slice(0, 50) : [];
        const out = {};
        for (const id of ids) {
          const cached = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`discorduser_${id}`);
          if (cached) { try { out[id] = JSON.parse(cached); continue; } catch (_) {} }
          const res = await discordApi(`/users/${id}`);
          if (res.ok) {
            const info = { id, username: res.data.global_name || res.data.username || id, avatar: res.data.avatar ? `https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/${id}/${res.data.avatar}.png` : `https://cdn.discordapp.com/embed/avatars/${(Number(BigInt(id) % 6n))}.png` };
            out[id] = info;
            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`discorduser_${id}`, JSON.stringify(info), { expirationTtl: 86400 });
          } else {
            out[id] = { id, username: id, avatar: `https://cdn.discordapp.com/embed/avatars/0.png` };
          }
        }
        return json({ users: out });
      }

      // ==========================================
      // Panel Edit from Website
      // ==========================================
      if (url.pathname === "/api/panel/get" && request.method === "GET") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const hash = String(url.searchParams.get("scriptHash") || "");
        if (!HASH_RE.test(hash)) return json({ error: "Invalid script" }, 400);
        const item = await projectForHash(hash);
        if (!item) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);
          if (String(item.owner) !== String(userId) && !OWNER_IDS.has(String(userId))) return json({ error: "Forbidden â€” this script is not on your account" }, 403);
        const found = await findPanel(hash);
        if (!found) return json({ error: "No panel found for this script yet." });
        return json({ ...found.rec, guildId: found.guildId, buttons: normalizePanelButtons(found.rec.buttons).buttons });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/api/panel/edit" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const b = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
        const hash = String(b.scriptHash || "");
        if (!HASH_RE.test(hash)) return json({ error: "Invalid script" }, 400);
        const item = await projectForHash(hash);
        if (!item) return json({ error: "Script not found" }, 404);
          if (String(item.owner) !== String(userId) && !OWNER_IDS.has(String(userId))) return json({ error: "Forbidden â€” this script is not on your account" }, 403);
        const found = await findPanel(hash);
        if (!found) return json({ error: "Panel not found" }, 404);
        const title = typeof b.title === "string" && b.title.trim() ? b.title.trim().slice(0, 256) : found.rec.title;
        const description = typeof b.description === "string" && b.description.trim() ? b.description.trim().slice(0, 4000) : found.rec.description;
        let buttons;
        if (b.buttons !== undefined) { const nb = normalizePanelButtons(b.buttons); if (nb.error) return json({ error: nb.error }, 400); buttons = nb.buttons; }
        const out = await publishPanel({ item, guildId: found.guildId, channelId: found.rec.channelId, title, description, style: found.rec.style || {}, buttons, mode: "update", move: false });
        return json(out.body, out.status);
      }

      // ==========================================
      // 8. ADMIN
      // ==========================================
      if (url.pathname === "/api/admin/users") {
        if (!OWNER_IDS.has(userId)) return new Response("Forbidden", { status: 403, headers: corsHeaders });
        let list = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: "user_" });
        const users = [];
        while (true) {
          for (const key of list.keys) {
            // "user_" also prefixes unrelated keys like "usertoken_" ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â only accept the exact "user_<id>" shape.
            if (!/^user_\d{15,22}$/.test(key.name)) continue;
            const val = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(key.name);
            if (!val) continue;
            try { const pu = JSON.parse(val); delete pu.sessionToken; users.push(pu); }
            catch (e) { console.warn("Skipping corrupt user record", key.name, e?.message || e); }
          }
          if (list.list_complete || !list.cursor) break;
          list = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: "user_", cursor: list.cursor });
        }
        // Attach ban state to every user, and return the full IP ban list.
        const bannedIps = [];
        const bannedUsers = [];
        {
          let bl = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: "ban_ip_" });
          const ipMap = {};
          while (true) {
            for (const key of bl.keys) {
              const ip = key.name.slice("ban_ip_".length);
              const v = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(key.name);
              let rec = {}; try { rec = v ? JSON.parse(v) : {}; } catch (_) {}
              ipMap[ip] = rec;
              bannedIps.push({ ip, ...rec });
            }
            if (bl.list_complete || !bl.cursor) break;
            bl = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: "ban_ip_", cursor: bl.cursor });
          }
          let ul = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: "ban_user_" });
          const userBans = {};
          while (true) {
            for (const key of ul.keys) {
              const id = key.name.slice("ban_user_".length);
              const v = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(key.name);
              try { userBans[id] = v ? JSON.parse(v) : { reason: "No reason given" }; } catch (_) { userBans[id] = { reason: "No reason given" }; }
            }
            if (ul.list_complete || !ul.cursor) break;
            ul = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: "ban_user_", cursor: ul.cursor });
          }
          for (const [bid, rec] of Object.entries(userBans)) bannedUsers.push({ id: bid, ...rec });
          for (const u of users) {
            u.ban = userBans[u.id] || null;
            u.ips = (Array.isArray(u.ips) ? u.ips : []).map((e) => ({ ...e, banned: !!ipMap[e.ip] }));
          }
        }
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ users, bannedIps, bannedUsers }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }

      // Ban an account (optionally every IP it has used).  body: { targetUserId, reason, banIps }
      if (url.pathname === "/api/admin/ban" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!OWNER_IDS.has(userId)) return new Response("Forbidden", { status: 403, headers: corsHeaders });
        let b = {}; try { b = await request.json(); } catch (_) {}
        const target = String(b.targetUserId || "").trim();
        if (!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(target)) return json({ error: "Invalid user ID" }, 400);
        if (OWNER_IDS.has(target)) return json({ error: "You can't ban the admin account." }, 400);
        // The target does not have to be registered: banning an unknown Discord ID blocks them before they ever sign up.
        const tu = (await getUser(target)) || { ips: [], username: null };
        const reason = String(b.reason || "").replace(/[\u0000-\u001f]/g, " ").trim().slice(0, 300) || "No reason given";
        const ban = { reason, bannedAt: new Date().toISOString(), by: userId, username: tu.username || null, registered: !!(await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`user_${target}`)) };
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`ban_user_${target}`, JSON.stringify(ban));
        let ipsBanned = 0;
        if (b.banIps) {
          for (const e of (Array.isArray(tu.ips) ? tu.ips : [])) {
            const ip = normIp(e && e.ip);
            if (!ip || !IP_RE.test(ip)) continue;
            if (ip === normIp(clientIp)) continue; // never lock the admin out of their own panel
            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`ban_ip_${ip}`, JSON.stringify({ reason, bannedAt: ban.bannedAt, by: userId, userId: target, username: tu.username || null }));
            ipsBanned++;
          }
        }
        await audit(env, "admin_ban", { target, reason, ipsBanned });
        return json({ success: true, ipsBanned });
      }

      // Unban an account (optionally every IP it has used).  body: { targetUserId, unbanIps }
      if (url.pathname === "/api/admin/unban" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!OWNER_IDS.has(userId)) return new Response("Forbidden", { status: 403, headers: corsHeaders });
        let b = {}; try { b = await request.json(); } catch (_) {}
        const target = String(b.targetUserId || "").trim();
        if (!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(target)) return json({ error: "Invalid user ID" }, 400);
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`ban_user_${target}`);
        let ipsUnbanned = 0;
        if (b.unbanIps) {
          const tu = await getUser(target);
          for (const e of (tu && Array.isArray(tu.ips) ? tu.ips : [])) {
            const ip = normIp(e && e.ip);
            if (!ip || !IP_RE.test(ip)) continue;
            if (await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`ban_ip_${ip}`)) { await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`ban_ip_${ip}`); ipsUnbanned++; }
          }
        }
        await audit(env, "admin_unban", { target, ipsUnbanned });
        return json({ success: true, ipsUnbanned });
      }

      // Remove a user from the joined list.  body: { targetUserId }
      // Deletes the account record + API-key lookup, which also invalidates their session. Bans are kept.
      if (url.pathname === "/api/admin/delete-user" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!OWNER_IDS.has(userId)) return new Response("Forbidden", { status: 403, headers: corsHeaders });
        let b = {}; try { b = await request.json(); } catch (_) {}
        const target = String(b.targetUserId || "").trim();
        if (!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(target)) return json({ error: "Invalid user ID" }, 400);
        if (OWNER_IDS.has(target)) return json({ error: "You can't remove the admin account." }, 400);
        const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`user_${target}`);
        if (!raw) return json({ error: "That user is not in the joined list." }, 404);
        let rec = {}; try { rec = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) {}
        if (rec.apiKey) await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`apikey_${rec.apiKey}`);
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`user_${target}`);
        await audit(env, "admin_delete_user", { target, username: rec.username || null });
        return json({ success: true });
      }

      // Ban / unban a single IP.  body: { ip, reason }
      if (url.pathname === "/api/admin/ban-ip" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!OWNER_IDS.has(userId)) return new Response("Forbidden", { status: 403, headers: corsHeaders });
        let b = {}; try { b = await request.json(); } catch (_) {}
        const ip = normIp(b.ip);
        if (!IP_RE.test(ip) || !(ip.includes(".") || ip.includes(":"))) return json({ error: "Invalid IP address" }, 400);
        if (ip === normIp(clientIp)) return json({ error: "That's your own IP - you can't ban it." }, 400);
        const reason = String(b.reason || "").replace(/[\u0000-\u001f]/g, " ").trim().slice(0, 300) || "No reason given";
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`ban_ip_${ip}`, JSON.stringify({ reason, bannedAt: new Date().toISOString(), by: userId }));
        await audit(env, "admin_ban_ip", { ip, reason });
        return json({ success: true });
      }
      if (url.pathname === "/api/admin/unban-ip" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!OWNER_IDS.has(userId)) return new Response("Forbidden", { status: 403, headers: corsHeaders });
        let b = {}; try { b = await request.json(); } catch (_) {}
        const ip = normIp(b.ip);
        if (!IP_RE.test(ip)) return json({ error: "Invalid IP address" }, 400);
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`ban_ip_${ip}`);
        await audit(env, "admin_unban_ip", { ip });
        return json({ success: true });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/api/admin/update-plan" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!OWNER_IDS.has(userId)) return new Response("Forbidden", { status: 403, headers: corsHeaders });
        const { targetUserId, days, remove, plan: reqPlan } = await request.json();
        const newPlan = reqPlan === "Commercial" ? "Commercial" : "Premium";
        const userDataStr = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`user_${targetUserId}`);
        if (!userDataStr) return new Response("User not found", { status: 404, headers: corsHeaders });
        const user = JSON.parse(userDataStr);

        if (remove) {
          if (PAID_PLANS.includes(user.plan)) user.premiumExpiredAt = new Date().toISOString();
          user.plan = "Basic";
          user.premiumExpiry = null;
        } else {
          user.plan = newPlan;
          delete user.lockChoice;
          delete user.premiumExpiredAt;
          if (days === "lifetime") user.premiumExpiry = "lifetime";
          else {
            const cur = user.premiumExpiry && user.premiumExpiry !== "lifetime" ? new Date(user.premiumExpiry) : new Date();
            const base = cur > new Date() ? cur : new Date();
            base.setDate(base.getDate() + parseInt(days));
            user.premiumExpiry = base.toISOString();
          }
        }
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`user_${targetUserId}`, JSON.stringify(user));
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/api/generate-key" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!OWNER_IDS.has(userId)) return new Response("Forbidden", { status: 403, headers: corsHeaders });
        const { duration, plan: keyPlan } = await request.json();
        const newKey = "LUAV-" + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase() + "-" + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase();
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`key_${newKey}`, keyPlan === "Commercial" ? `${duration}|Commercial` : duration);
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ key: newKey, plan: keyPlan === "Commercial" ? "Commercial" : "Premium" }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }

      if (url.pathname === "/api/redeem" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!userId) return new Response("Unauthorized", { status: 401, headers: corsHeaders });
        const { key } = await request.json();
        const rawKey = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`key_${key}`);
        const [duration, keyPlanRaw] = rawKey ? rawKey.split("|") : [null, null];
        if (!duration) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Invalid key" }), { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`key_${key}`);
        const userDataStr = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`user_${userId}`);
        if (userDataStr) {
          const user = JSON.parse(userDataStr);
          user.plan = keyPlanRaw === "Commercial" ? "Commercial" : "Premium";
          delete user.lockChoice;
          delete user.premiumExpiredAt;
          if (duration === "lifetime") user.premiumExpiry = "lifetime";
          else {
            const daysMap = { "1d": 1, "7d": 7, "30d": 30 };
            const toAdd = daysMap[duration] || 30;
            const cur = user.premiumExpiry && user.premiumExpiry !== "lifetime" ? new Date(user.premiumExpiry) : new Date();
            const base = cur > new Date() ? cur : new Date();
            base.setDate(base.getDate() + toAdd);
            user.premiumExpiry = base.toISOString();
          }
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`user_${userId}`, JSON.stringify(user));
        }
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }


      // ==========================================
      // 9. STAFF ROLE (owner only)
      // ==========================================
      if (url.pathname === "/api/admin/set-role" && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!OWNER_IDS.has(userId)) return new Response("Forbidden", { status: 403, headers: corsHeaders });
        let b = {}; try { b = await request.json(); } catch (_) {}
        const target = String(b.targetUserId || "").trim();
        if (!/^\d{15,22}$/.test(target)) return json({ error: "Invalid user ID" }, 400);
        if (OWNER_IDS.has(target)) return json({ error: "The owner role can't be changed." }, 400);
        const tu = await getUser(target);
        if (!tu) return json({ error: "That user has not signed in yet." }, 404);
        if (b.role === "staff") tu.role = "staff"; else delete tu.role;
        await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`user_${target}`, JSON.stringify(tu));
        await audit(env, "admin_set_role", { target, role: tu.role || "user" });
        return json({ success: true, role: tu.role || "user" });
      }

      // Support-ticket feature removed from the website and API.
      if (url.pathname === "/api/tickets" || url.pathname.startsWith("/api/tickets/")) {
        return json({ error: "Not found" }, 404);
      }

      // ==========================================
      // 10. SUPPORT TICKETS (disabled; legacy handler retained below)
      //   ticket_<ownerId>_<TCK-XXXXXX>  -> full ticket incl. messages
      //   ticketidx_<TCK-XXXXXX>         -> ownerId
      // ==========================================
      if (url.pathname === "/api/tickets" || url.pathname.startsWith("/api/tickets/")) {
        if (!userId) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const me = await getUser(userId);
        if (!me) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        const myRole = OWNER_IDS.has(userId) ? "owner" : (me.role === "staff" ? "staff" : "user");
        const isStaffOrOwner = myRole !== "user";
        const CATEGORIES = ["Technical", "Billing", "Bug Report", "Script Inquiry", "General / Other"];
        const PRIORITIES = ["low", "medium", "high", "urgent"];
        const TID_RE = /^TCK-[A-F0-9]{6}$/;
        const clean = (v, max) => String(v == null ? "" : v).replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000b\u000c\u000e-\u001f]/g, "").trim().slice(0, max);
        const loadTicket = async (tid) => {
          const owner = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`ticketidx_${tid}`);
          if (!owner) return null;
          const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(`ticket_${owner}_${tid}`);
          if (!raw) return null;
          try { return JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) { return null; }
        };
        const saveTicket = (t) => env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`ticket_${t.ownerId}_${t.id}`, JSON.stringify(t));
        const summary = (t) => ({
          id: t.id, subject: t.subject, project: t.project || "", category: t.category, priority: t.priority, status: t.status,
          ownerId: t.ownerId, ownerName: t.ownerName, ownerAvatar: t.ownerAvatar, ownerRole: t.ownerRole || "user",
          createdAt: t.createdAt, updatedAt: t.updatedAt, messageCount: t.messages.length,
          lastReplyRole: t.messages.length ? t.messages[t.messages.length - 1].role : "user",
        });
        const canView = (t) => isStaffOrOwner || t.ownerId === userId;

        // list: mine by default; ?scope=all for staff/owner
        if (url.pathname === "/api/tickets" && request.method === "GET") {
          const scope = url.searchParams.get("scope") === "all" && isStaffOrOwner ? "all" : "mine";
          const prefix = scope === "all" ? "ticket_" : `ticket_${userId}_`;
          const out = [];
          let list = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix });
          while (true) {
            for (const k of list.keys) {
              if (!/^ticket_\d{15,22}_TCK-[A-F0-9]{6}$/.test(k.name)) continue;
              const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(k.name);
              if (!raw) continue;
              try { out.push(summary(JSON.parse(raw))); } catch (_) {}
            }
            if (list.list_complete || !list.cursor) break;
            list = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix, cursor: list.cursor });
          }
          out.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.updatedAt) - new Date(a.updatedAt));
          return json({ tickets: out, scope, role: myRole });
        }

        // create
        if (url.pathname === "/api/tickets" && request.method === "POST") {
          let b = {}; try { b = await request.json(); } catch (_) {}
          const category = CATEGORIES.includes(b.category) ? b.category : null;
          const priority = PRIORITIES.includes(b.priority) ? b.priority : null;
          const subject = clean(b.subject, 120);
          const message = clean(b.message, 3500);
          const project = clean(b.project, 100);
          if (!category || !priority) return json({ error: "Pick a category and priority." }, 400);
          if (subject.length < 3) return json({ error: "Subject needs at least 3 characters." }, 400);
          if (message.length < 5) return json({ error: "Message is too short." }, 400);
          // cap open tickets per user so nobody can flood the staff queue
          let open = 0;
          const ml = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.list({ prefix: `ticket_${userId}_` });
          for (const k of ml.keys) {
            const raw = await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.get(k.name);
            try { if (raw && JSON.parse(raw).status === "open") open++; } catch (_) {}
          }
          if (open >= 5 && !isStaffOrOwner) return json({ error: "You already have 5 open tickets. Wait for them to be resolved." }, 429);
          const id = "TCK-" + randHex(3).toUpperCase();
          const now = new Date().toISOString();
          const t = {
            id, ownerId: userId, ownerName: me.username, ownerAvatar: me.avatar || null, ownerRole: myRole,
            subject, category, priority, project, status: "open", createdAt: now, updatedAt: now,
            messages: [{ authorId: userId, authorName: me.username, authorAvatar: me.avatar || null, role: myRole, text: message, ts: now }],
          };
          await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.put(`ticketidx_${id}`, userId);
          await saveTicket(t);
          return json({ success: true, id });
        }

        const m = url.pathname.match(/^\/api\/tickets\/(TCK-[A-F0-9]{6})(?:\/(reply|status|delete))?$/i);
        if (m) {
          const tid = m[1].toUpperCase(), action = m[2] || "";
          if (!TID_RE.test(tid)) return json({ error: "Invalid ticket" }, 400);
          const t = await loadTicket(tid);
          if (!t || !canView(t)) return json({ error: "Ticket not found" }, 404);

          if (!action && request.method === "GET") {
            return json({ ticket: t, viewerRole: myRole, viewerId: userId });
          }
          if (action === "reply" && request.method === "POST") {
            if (t.status === "resolved") return json({ error: "This ticket is resolved and locked." }, 403);
            let b = {}; try { b = await request.json(); } catch (_) {}
            const text = clean(b.text, 3500);
            if (!text) return json({ error: "Message can't be empty." }, 400);
            if (t.messages.length >= 200) return json({ error: "This ticket has too many messages. Open a new one." }, 400);
            const now = new Date().toISOString();
            t.messages.push({ authorId: userId, authorName: me.username, authorAvatar: me.avatar || null, role: myRole, text, ts: now });
            t.updatedAt = now;
            await saveTicket(t);
            return json({ success: true, ticket: t });
          }
          if (action === "status" && request.method === "POST") {
            let b = {}; try { b = await request.json(); } catch (_) {}
            const next = b.status === "open" ? "open" : (b.status === "resolved" ? "resolved" : null);
            if (!next) return json({ error: "Invalid status" }, 400);
            // the owner of a ticket may close it; only staff/owner may reopen
            if (next === "open" && !isStaffOrOwner) return json({ error: "Only staff can reopen a ticket." }, 403);
            t.status = next;
            t.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
            await saveTicket(t);
            return json({ success: true, ticket: t });
          }
          if (action === "delete" && request.method === "POST") {
            if (myRole !== "owner") return json({ error: "Only the owner can delete tickets." }, 403);
            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`ticket_${t.ownerId}_${t.id}`);
            await env.LUAVIFY_SCRIPTS.delete(`ticketidx_${t.id}`);
            return json({ success: true });
          }
        }
        return json({ error: "Not found" }, 404);
      }

      return new Response(INDEX_HTML, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" } });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "Worker Error:",
        error && error.message ? error.message : String(error),
        error && error.stack ? error.stack : ""
      );
      const path = (() => { try { return new URL(request.url).pathname; } catch (_) { return ""; } })();
      // OAuth callback should never show a bare JSON 500 to humans in the browser.
      if (path === "/auth/callback") {
        const msg = String(error && error.message ? error.message : "unknown error").slice(0, 180);
        return new Response(`<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Sign-in failed - Luavify</title><style>body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#050508;color:#f4f4f5;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;padding:20px}.c{max-width:480px;width:100%;background:#0f1115;border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.35);border-radius:16px;padding:28px}h1{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:1.3rem}p{color:#a1a1aa;line-height:1.6}code{color:#fca5a5;font-size:.85rem}a{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px;background:#ef4444;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:10px}</style></head><body><div class="c"><h1>Sign-in failed</h1><p>The server hit an error while finishing Discord login.</p><p><code>${msg.replace(/[<>&]/g, "")}</code></p><p style="margin-top:10px">Check that <b>DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET</b> and <b>DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI</b> (= https://luavify.dpdns.org/auth/callback) are set on the Worker, and match the Discord Developer Portal.</p><a href="/auth/login">Try again</a></div></body></html>`, {
          status: 500,
          headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store" }
        });
      }
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Internal Server Error" }), {
        status: 500,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" }
      });
    }
  },
};
